name: 3/4 Abdominal
instructions: Lie down on floor e secure seu(s) feet. seu(s) legs should be bent at joelho(s). Place seu(s) hands behind or to side of seu(s) head. You will begin com seu(s) costas on ground. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Flex seu(s) quadril e spine to raise seu(s) torso toward seu(s) joelho(s). At top of contraction seu(s) torso should be perpendicular to ground. Reverse motion, going only ¾ of way down. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: 90/90 Hamstring
instructions: Deite-se de costas, com one leg extended straight out. com other leg, bend quadril e joelho(s) to 90 degrees. You may brace seu(s) leg com seu(s) hands if necessary. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Extend seu(s) leg straight em air, pausing briefly at top. Return leg até a posição inicial. Repeat for 10-20 repetições, e então switch to other leg.

name: Ab Abdominal Crunch Máquina
instructions: Select a light resistance e Sente-se on ab máquina placing seu(s) feet under pads provided e grabbing top pegadas. seu(s) arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle as you rest triceps on pads provided. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. At same time, begin to lift legs up as you crunch seu(s) upper torso. Breathe out as you perform this movement. Tip: Be sure to use a slow e controlled motion. Concentrate on using seu(s) abs to move weight enquanto relaxing seu(s) legs e feet. After a second pause, slowly Retorne à posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Ab Roller
instructions: Hold Ab Roller com both hands e kneel on floor. Now place ab roller on floor in front of you so that you are on all seu(s) hands e joelho(s) (as in a kneeling push up position). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Slowly roll ab roller straight forward, stretching seu(s) body em a straight position. Tip: Go down as far as you can without touching floor com seu(s) body. Breathe in during this portion of movement. After a pause at stretched position, start pulling yourself costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out. Tip: Go slowly e keep seu(s) abs tight at all times.

name: Adductor
instructions: Deite-se de bruços com one leg on a foam roll. Rotate leg so that foam roll contacts against seu(s) inner thigh. Shift as much weight onto foam roll as can be tolerated. enquanto trying to relax muscles if inner thigh, roll over foam between seu(s) quadril e joelho(s), holding points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat com other leg.

name: Adductor/groin
instructions: Deite-se de costas com seu(s) feet raised towards ceiling. Have seu(s) partner hold seu(s) feet or ankles. Abduct seu(s) legs as far as you can. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Attempt to squeeze seu(s) legs together for 10 or more seconds, enquanto seu(s) partner prevents you de doing so. Now, relax muscles in seu(s) legs as seu(s) partner pushes seu(s) feet apart, stretching as far as is comfortable for you. Be sure to let seu(s) partner know when stretch is adequate to prevent overstretching or injury.

name: Advanced Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Clean e press a kettlebell overhead com one arm. mantendo kettlebell locked out at all times, push seu(s) butt out in direction of locked out kettlebell. Keep non-working arm behind seu(s) costas e turn seu(s) feet out at a forty-five degree angle de arm com kettlebell. Lower yourself o máximo possível. Pause for a second e reverse motion costas até a posição inicial.

name: Air Bike
instructions: Lie flat on floor com seu(s) lower costas pressed to ground. For this exercise, you will need to put seu(s) hands beside seu(s) head. Be careful however to not strain com neck as you perform it. Now lift seu(s) ombro(s) em crunch position. Bring joelho(s) up to where they are perpendicular to floor, com seu(s) lower legs parallel to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now simultaneously, slowly go through a cycle pedal motion kicking forward com right leg e bringing in joelho(s) of left leg. Bring seu(s) right cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) left joelho(s) by crunching to side, as you breathe out. Go costas to initial position as you breathe in. Crunch to opposite side as you cycle seu(s) legs e bring closer seu(s) left cotovelo(s) to seu(s) right joelho(s) e Expire. Continue alternating in this manner até all of recommended repetições for each side have been completed.

name: All Fours Quad Alongamento
instructions: Start off on seu(s) hands e joelho(s), então lift seu(s) leg off floor e hold foot com seu(s) hand. Use seu(s) hand to hold foot or ankle, mantendo joelho(s) fully flexed, stretching quadriceps e quadril flexors. Focus on extending seu(s) quadril, thrusting them towards floor. Hold for 10-20 seconds e então switch sides.

name: Alternate Rosca Martelo
instructions: Stand up com seu(s) torso upright e a halter(es) in each hand being held at arms length. cotovelo(s) should be close to torso. palms of hands should be facing seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto holding upper arm stationary, curl right weight forward enquanto contracting biceps as you breathe out. Continue movement até seu(s) biceps is fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a second as you squeeze biceps. Tip: Only forearms should move. Slowly begin to bring halter(es) costas to posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Repeat movement com left hand. This equals one repetições. Continue alternating in this manner for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Alternate Heel Touchers
instructions: Lie on floor com joelho(s) bent e feet on floor around 18-24 inches apart. seu(s) arms should be extended by seu(s) side. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Crunch over seu(s) torso forward e up about 3-4 inches to right side e touch seu(s) right heel as you hold contraction for a second. Expire enquanto performing this movement. Now go costas slowly até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Now crunch over seu(s) torso forward e up around 3-4 inches to left side e touch seu(s) left heel as you hold contraction for a second. Expire enquanto performing this movement e então go costas até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Now that both heels have been touched, that is considered 1 repetições. Continue alternating sides in this manner até all prescribed repetições are done.

name: Alternate Inclinado Rosca Direta com Halteres
instructions: Sente-se on an incline banco com a halter(es) in each hand being held at arms length. Tip: Keep cotovelo(s) close to torso.This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto holding upper arm stationary, curl right weight forward enquanto contracting biceps as you breathe out. As you do so, rotate hand so that palm is facing up. Continue movement até seu(s) biceps is fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a second as you squeeze biceps. Tip: Only forearms should move. Slowly begin to bring halter(es) costas to posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Repeat movement com left hand. This equals one repetições. Continue alternating in this manner for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound
instructions: Assume a comfortable stance com one foot slightly in front of other. Begin by pushing off com front leg, driving opposite joelho(s) forward e as high as possible before landing. Attempt to cover as much distance to each side com each bound. It may help to use a line on ground to guage distance de side to side. Repeat sequence com other leg.

name: Alternado Cabo Desenvolvimento
instructions: Move cables to bottom of tower e select an appropriate weight. Grasp cables e hold them at ombro(s) height, palmas na direção indicada. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) head e peito up, extend through cotovelo(s) to press one side directly over head. After pausing at top, Retorne à posição inicial e repeat on opposite side.

name: Alternado Deltoid Elevação
instructions: In a standing position, hold a pair of halter(es) at seu(s) side. mantendo os cotovelos levemente flexionados, Eleve a cargas directly in front of you to ombro(s) height, avoiding any swinging or cheating. Return weights to seu(s) side. On next repetições, Eleve a cargas laterally, raising them out to seu(s) side to about ombro(s) height. Return weights até a posição inicial e continue alternating to front e side.

name: Alternado Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor com two kettlebells next to seu(s) ombro(s). Position one in place on seu(s) peito e então other, gripping kettlebells on pegadas com palmas na direção indicada. Extend both arms, so that kettlebells are being held above seu(s) peito. Lower one kettlebell, bringing it to seu(s) peito e turn wrist in direction of locked out kettlebell. Raise kettlebell e repeat on opposite side.

name: Alternado Hang Clean
instructions: Place two kettlebells between seu(s) feet. To get in posição inicial, push seu(s) butt costas e look straight ahead. Clean one kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) e hold on to other kettlebell in a hanging position. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so. Lower cleaned kettlebell to a hanging position e clean alternate kettlebell. Repeat.

name: Alternado Kettlebell Press
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebells towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrists as you do so. Press one directly overhead by extending through cotovelo(s), turning it so palm faces forward enquanto holding other kettlebell stationary . Lower pressed kettlebell até a posição inicial e immediately press com seu(s) other arm.

name: Alternado Kettlebell Remada
instructions: Place two kettlebells in front of seu(s) feet. Flexione os joelhos slightly e push seu(s) butt out as much as possible. As you bend over to get inaté a posição inicial grab both kettlebells by pegadas. Pull one kettlebell off of floor enquanto holding on to other kettlebell. Retract ombro(s) blade of working side, as you flex cotovelo(s), drawing kettlebell towards seu(s) stomach or rib cage. Lower kettlebell in working arm e repeat com seu(s) other arm.

name: Alternado Renegade Remada
instructions: Place two kettlebells on floor about ombro(s) width apart. Position yourself on seu(s) toes e seu(s) hands as though you were doing a pushup, com body straight e extended. Use pegadas of kettlebells to support seu(s) upper body. You may need to position seu(s) feet wide for support. Push one kettlebell em floor e row other kettlebell, retracting ombro(s) blade of working side as you flex cotovelo(s), pulling it to seu(s) side. então lower kettlebell to floor e begin kettlebell in opposite hand. Repeat for several repetições.

name: Ankle Circles
instructions: Use a sturdy object like a squat rack to hold yourself. Lift right leg in air (just around 2 inches de floor) e perform a circular motion com big toe. Pretend that you are drawing a big circle com it. Tip: One circle equals 1 repetições. Breathe normally as you perform movement. When you are done com right foot, então repeat com left leg.

name: Ankle no Knee
instructions: De a lying position, Flexione os joelhos e keep seu(s) feet on floor. Place seu(s) ankle of one foot on seu(s) opposite joelho(s). Grasp thigh or joelho(s) of bottom leg e pull both of seu(s) legs em peito. Relax seu(s) neck e ombro(s). Hold for 10-20 seconds e então switch sides.

name: Anterior Tibialis-smr
instructions: Begin seated on ground com seu(s) legs bent e seu(s) feet on floor. Using a Muscle Roller or a rolling pin, apply pressure to muscles on outside of seu(s) shins. Work de just below joelho(s) to above ankle, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on other leg.

name: Anti-gravity Press
instructions: Place a bar on ground behind head of an incline banco. Lay on banco face down. com a pronated grip, pick barra up de floor. Flex cotovelo(s), performing a reverse curl to bring bar near seu(s) peito. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. To begin, press barra out in front of seu(s) head by extending seu(s) cotovelo(s). Keep seu(s) arms parallel to ground throughout movement. Retorne à posição inicial e repeat to complete set.

name: Arm Circles
instructions: Stand up e extend seu(s) arms straight out by sides. arms should be parallel to floor e perpendicular (90-degree angle) to seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Slowly start to make circles of about 1 foot in diameter com each outstretched arm. Breathe normally as you perform movement. Continue circular motion of outstretched arms for about ten seconds. então reverse movement, going opposite direction.

name: Arnold Halter Press
instructions: Sit on an exercise banco com costas support e hold two halter(es) in front of you at about upper peito level com seu(s) palmas na direção indicada e seu(s) cotovelo(s) bent. Tip: seu(s) arms should be next to seu(s) torso. posição inicial should look like contracted portion of a halter(es) curl. Now to perform movement, Eleve a carga as you rotate palms of seu(s) hands até they are facing forward. Continue lifting halter(es) até seu(s) arms are extended above you in straight arm position. Breathe out as you perform this portion of movement. After a second pause at top, begin to Abaixe a carga to original position by rotating palms of seu(s) hands towards you. Tip: left arm will be rotated in a counter clockwise manner enquanto right one will be rotated clockwise. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Around Worlds
instructions: Lay down on a flat banco holding a halter(es) in each hand com palms of hands facing towards ceiling. Tip: seu(s) arms should be parallel to floor e next to seu(s) thighs. To avoid injury, make sure that you keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) slightly bent. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now move halter(es) by creating a semi-circle as you displace them de initial position to over head. All of movement should happen com arms parallel to floor at all times. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Reverse movement to return weight até a posição inicial as you Expire.

name: Atlas Stone Trainer
instructions: This trainer is effective for developing Atlas Stone strength for those who don't have access to stones, e are typically made de bar ends or heavy pipe. Begin by loading desired weight onto bar. Straddle weight, wrapping seu(s) arms around implement, bending at quadril. Begin by pulling weight up past joelho(s), extending through quadril. As weight clears joelho(s), it can be lapped by resting it on seu(s) thighs e sitting costas, hugging it tightly to seu(s) peito. Finish movement by extending through seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) to Eleve a carga as high as possible. weight can be returned to lap or to ground for successive repetições.

name: Atlas Stones
instructions: Begin com atlas stone between seu(s) feet. Bend at quadril to wrap seu(s) arms vertically around Atlas Stone, attempting to get seu(s) fingers underneath stone. Many stones will have a small flat portion on bottom, which will make stone easier to hold. Pulling stone em seu(s) torso, drive through costas half of seu(s) feet to pull stone de ground. As stone passes joelho(s), lap it by sitting backward, pulling stone on top of seu(s) thighs. Sit low, getting stone high onto seu(s) peito as you change seu(s) grip to reach over stone. Stand, driving through com seu(s) quadril. Close distance to loading platform, e lean costas, extending quadril to get stone as high as possible.

name: Axle Levantamento Terra
instructions: Approach bar so that it is centered over seu(s) feet. You feet should be about quadril width apart. Bend at quadril to grip bar at ombro(s) width, allowing seu(s) ombro(s) blades to protract. Typically, you would use an over/under grip. com seu(s) feet e seu(s) grip set, take a big breath e então lower seu(s) quadril e flex joelho(s) até seu(s) shins contact bar. Look forward com seu(s) head, keep seu(s) peito up e seu(s) costas arched, e begin driving through heels to move weight upward. After bar passes joelho(s), aggressively pull bar costas, pulling seu(s) ombro(s) blades together as you drive seu(s) quadril forward em bar. Lower bar by bending at quadril e guiding it to floor.

name: Back Crucifixo - com Bands
instructions: Run a band around a stationary post like that of a squat rack. Grab band by pegadas e stand costas so that tension in band rises. Extend e lift arms straight in front of you. Tip: seu(s) arms should be straight e parallel to floor enquanto perpendicular to seu(s) torso. seu(s) feet should be firmly planted on floor spread at ombro(s) width. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, move seu(s) arms to sides e costas. Keep seu(s) arms extended e parallel to floor. Continue movement até arms are extended to seu(s) sides. After a pause, go costas to original position as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Backward Drag
instructions: Load a sled com desired weight, attaching a rope or straps to sled that you can hold onto. Begin exercise by moving backwards for a given distance. Leaning costas, extend through legs for short steps to move as quickly as possible.

name: Backward Medicine Ball Throw
instructions: This exercise is best done com a partner. If you lack a partner, ball can be thrown e retrieved or thrown against a wall. Begin standing a few meters in front of seu(s) partner, both facing same direction. Begin holding ball between seu(s) legs. Squat down e então forcefully reverse direction, coming to full extension e you toss ball over seu(s) head to seu(s) partner. seu(s) partner can então roll ball costas to you. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: Balance Board
instructions: Place a balance board in front of you. Stand up on it e try to balance yourself. Hold balance for as long as desired.

name: Ball Mesa Flexora
instructions: Begin on floor laying on seu(s) costas com seu(s) feet on top of ball. Position ball so that when seu(s) legs are extended seu(s) ankles are on top of ball. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) quadril off of ground, mantendo seu(s) weight on ombro(s) blades e seu(s) feet. Flex joelho(s), pulling ball as close to you as you can, contracting hamstrings. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Elástico Assistido Barra Fixa
instructions: Choke band around center of pullup bar. You can use different bands to provide varying levels of assistance. Pull end of band down, e place one bent joelho(s) em loop, ensuring it won't slip out. Take a medium to wide grip on bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull yourself upward by contracting lats as you flex cotovelo(s). cotovelo(s) should be driven to seu(s) side. Pull to front, attempting to get seu(s) chin over bar. Avoid swinging or jerking movements. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Elástico Good Morning
instructions: Using a 41 inch band, stand on one end, spreading seu(s) feet a small amount. Bend at quadril to loop end of band behind seu(s) neck. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) legs straight, extend through quadril to come to a near vertical position. Ensure that you do not round seu(s) costas as you go down costas até a posição inicial.

name: Elástico Good Morning (pull Through)
instructions: Loop band around a post. Standing a little ways away, loop opposite end around neck. seu(s) hands can help hold band in position. Begin by bending at quadril, getting seu(s) butt costas o máximo possível. Keep seu(s) costas flat e bend forward to about 90 degrees. seu(s) joelho(s) should be only slightly bent. Retorne à posição inicial be driving through com quadril to come costas to a standing position.

name: Elástico Hip Adductions
instructions: Anchor a band around a solid post or other object. Stand com seu(s) left side to post, e put seu(s) right foot through band, getting it around ankle. Fique em pé ereto e hold onto post if needed. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo joelho(s) straight, raise seu(s) right legs out to side as far as you can. Retorne à posição inicial e repeat for desired repetições count. Switch sides.

name: Elástico Pull Apart
instructions: Begin com seu(s) arms extended straight out in front of you, holding band com both hands. Initiate movement by performing a reverse fly motion, moving seu(s) hands out laterally to seu(s) sides. Keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) extended as you perform movement, bringing band to seu(s) peito. Ensure that you keep seu(s) ombro(s) costas during exercise. Pause as you complete movement, returning até a posição inicial under control.

name: Elástico Tríceps Testa
instructions: Secure a band to base of a rack or banco. Lay on banco so that band is lined up com seu(s) head. Take hold of band, raising seu(s) cotovelo(s) so that upper arm is perpendicular to floor. com cotovelo(s) flexed, band should be above seu(s) head. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Extend through cotovelo(s) to straighten seu(s) arm, mantendo seu(s) upper arm in place. Pause at top of motion, e Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Barra Ab Rollout
instructions: For this exercise you will need to get em a pushup position, but instead of having seu(s) hands of floor, you will be grabbing on to an Olympic barra (loaded com 5-10 lbs on each side) instead. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo a slight arch on seu(s) costas, lift seu(s) quadril e roll barra towards seu(s) feet as you Expire. Tip: As you perform movement, seu(s) glúteo(s) should be coming up, you should be mantendo abs tight e should maintain seu(s) costas posture at all times. Also seu(s) arms should be staying perpendicular to floor throughout movement. If you don't, you will work out seu(s) ombro(s) e costas more than abs. After a second contraction at top, start to roll barra costas forward até a posição inicial slowly as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Barra Ab Rollout - no Knees
instructions: Hold an Olympic barra loaded com 5-10lbs on each side e kneel on floor. Now place barra on floor in front of you so that you are on all seu(s) hands e joelho(s) (as in a kneeling push up position). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Slowly roll barra straight forward, stretching seu(s) body em a straight position. Tip: Go down as far as you can without touching floor com seu(s) body. Breathe in during this portion of movement. After a second pause at stretched position, start pulling yourself costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out. Tip: Go slowly e keep seu(s) abs tight at all times.

name: Supino Reto com Barra - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie costas on a flat banco. Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in middle of movement between forearms e upper arms), lift bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. de posição inicial, breathe in e begin coming down slowly até bar touches seu(s) middle peito. After a brief pause, push bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out. Focus on pushing bar using seu(s) peito muscles. Lock seu(s) arms e squeeze seu(s) peito in contracted position at top of motion, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. Tip: Ideally, lowering weight should take about twice as long as raising it. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place bar costas in rack.

name: Rosca Direta com Barra
instructions: Stand up com seu(s) torso upright enquanto holding a barra at a ombro(s)-width grip. palm of seu(s) hands should be facing forward e cotovelo(s) should be close to torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto holding upper arms stationary, curl weights forward enquanto contracting biceps as you breathe out. Tip: Only forearms should move. Continue movement até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e bar is at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a second e squeeze biceps hard. Slowly begin to bring bar costas to posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Rosca Direta com Barras Deitado Against Inclinado
instructions: Lie against an incline banco, com seu(s) arms holding a barra e hanging down in a horizontal line. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo upper arms stationary, curl weight up as high as you can enquanto squeezing biceps. Breathe out as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Only forearms should move. Do not swing arms. After a second contraction, slowly go costas até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Tip: Make sure that you go all of way down. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Barra Levantamento Terra
instructions: Stand in front of a loaded barra. enquanto mantendo costas as straight as possible, Flexione os joelhos, bend forward e segure a barra/pegadas using a medium (ombro(s) width) overhand grip. This will be posição inicial of exercise. Tip: If it is difficult to hold on to bar com this grip, alternate seu(s) grip or use wrist straps. enquanto holding bar, start lift by pushing com seu(s) legs enquanto simultaneously getting seu(s) torso to upright position as you breathe out. In upright position, stick seu(s) peito out e contract costas by bringing ombro(s) blades costas. Think of how soldiers in military look when they are in standing in attention. Go costas até a posição inicial by bending at joelho(s) enquanto simultaneously leaning torso forward at waist enquanto mantendo costas straight. When weights on bar touch floor you are costas at posição inicial e ready to perform another repetições. Perform amount of repetições prescribed in program.

name: Barra Full Agachamento
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set bar on a rack just above ombro(s) level. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, step under bar e place costas of seu(s) ombro(s) (slightly below neck) across it. Hold on to bar using both arms at each side e lift it off rack by first pushing com seu(s) legs e at same time straightening seu(s) torso. Step away de rack e position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s)-width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head up at all times e maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin to Abaixe lentamente bar by bending joelho(s) e sitting costas com seu(s) quadril as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até seu(s) hamstrings are on seu(s) calves. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor com heel or middle of seu(s) foot as you straighten legs e extend quadril to go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Barra Ponte de Glúteo
instructions: Begin seated on ground com a loaded barra over seu(s) legs. Using a fat bar or having a pad on bar can greatly reduce discomfort caused by this exercise. Roll bar so that it is directly above seu(s) quadril, e lay down flat on floor. Begin movement by driving through com seu(s) heels, extending seu(s) quadril vertically through bar. seu(s) weight should be supported by seu(s) upper costas e heels of seu(s) feet. Extend o máximo possível, então reverse motion to Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Barra Guillotine Bench Press
instructions: Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in middle of movement between forearms e upper arms), lift bar de rack e hold it straight over seu(s) neck com seu(s) arms locked. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, bring bar down slowly até it is about 1 inch de seu(s) neck. After a second pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out e push bar using seu(s) peito muscles. Lock seu(s) arms e squeeze seu(s) peito in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place bar costas in rack.

name: Barra Hack Agachamento
instructions: Fique em pé ereto enquanto holding a barra behind you at arms length e seu(s) feet at ombro(s) width. Tip: A ombro(s) width grip is best com palms of seu(s) hands facing costas. You can use wrist wraps for this exercise for a better grip. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo seu(s) head e eyes up e costas straight, squat até seu(s) upper thighs are parallel to floor. Breathe in as you slowly go down. Pressing mainly com heel of foot e squeezing thighs, go costas up as you breathe out. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Barra Elevação de Quadril

name: Board Press
instructions: Begin by lying on banco, getting seu(s) head beyond bar if possible. One to five boards, made out of 2x6's, can be screwed together e held in place by a training partner, bands, or just tucked under seu(s) shirt. Tuck seu(s) feet underneath you e arch seu(s) costas. Using bar to help support seu(s) weight, lift seu(s) ombro(s) off banco e retract them, squeezing ombro(s) blades together. Use seu(s) feet to drive seu(s) traps em banco. Maintain this tight body position throughout movement. You can take a standard banco grip, or ombro(s) width to focus on triceps. Pull bar out of rack without protracting seu(s) ombro(s). bar, wrist, e cotovelo(s) should stay in line at all times. Focus on squeezing bar e trying to pull it apart. Lower bar to boards, e então drive bar up com as much force as possible. cotovelo(s) should be tucked in até lockout.

name: Body-up
instructions: Assume a plank position on ground. You should be supporting seu(s) bodyweight on seu(s) toes e forearms, mantendo seu(s) torso straight. seu(s) forearms should be na largura dos ombros. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pressing seu(s) palms firmly em ground, extend through cotovelo(s) to raise seu(s) body de ground. Keep seu(s) torso rigid as you perform movement. Abaixe lentamente seu(s) forearms costas to ground by allowing cotovelo(s) to flex. Repeat.

name: Body Tricep Press
instructions: Position a bar in a rack at peito height. Standing, take a ombro(s) width grip on bar e step a yard or two costas, feet together e arms extended so that you are leaning on bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by flexing cotovelo(s), lowering yourself towards bar. Pause, e então reverse motion by extending cotovelo(s). Progress de bodyweight by adding chains over seu(s) ombro(s).

name: Peso Corporal Crucifixo
instructions: Position two equally loaded EZ bars on ground next to each other. Ensure they are able to roll. Assume a push-up position over bars, supporting seu(s) weight on seu(s) toes e hands com seu(s) arms extended e body straight. Place seu(s) hands on bars. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Using a slow e controlled motion, move seu(s) hands away de midline of seu(s) body, rolling bars apart. Inspire during this portion of motion. After moving bars as far apart as you can, Retorne à posição inicial by pulling them costas together. Expire as you perform this movement.

name: Peso Corporal Mid Remada
instructions: Begin by taking a medium to wide grip on a pull-up apparatus com seu(s) palmas na direção indicada. de a hanging position, tuck seu(s) joelho(s) to seu(s) peito, leaning costas e getting seu(s) legs over seu(s) side of pull-up apparatus. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Beginning com seu(s) arms straight, flex cotovelo(s) e retract ombro(s) blades to raise seu(s) body up até seu(s) legs contact pull-up apparatus. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Peso Corporal Agachamento
instructions: Fique em pé com os pés ombro(s) width apart. You can place seu(s) hands behind seu(s) head. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin movement by flexing seu(s) joelho(s) e quadril, sitting costas com seu(s) quadril. Continue down to full depth if you are able,e quickly reverse motion até you Retorne à posição inicial. As you squat, keep seu(s) head e peito up e push seu(s) joelho(s) out.

name: Peso Corporal Walking Afundo
instructions: Begin standing com seu(s) feet ombro(s) width apart e seu(s) hands on seu(s) quadril. Step forward com one leg, flexing joelho(s) to drop seu(s) quadril. Descend até seu(s) rear joelho(s) nearly touches ground. seu(s) posture should remain upright, e seu(s) front joelho(s) should stay above front foot. Drive through heel of seu(s) lead foot e extend both joelho(s) to raise yourself costas up. Step forward com seu(s) rear foot, repeating lunge on opposite leg.

name: Bosu Ball Cabo Abdominal Crunch com Side Bends
instructions: Connect a standard pegadas to each arm of a cabo máquina, e position them in most downward position. Grab a Bosu Ball e position it in front e center of cabo máquina. Lie down on Bosu Ball com small of seu(s) costas arched around ball. seu(s) rear end should be close to floor without touching it. com both hands, reach costas e grab pegadas of each cabo. com seu(s) feet positioned in a wide stance, extend seu(s) arms straight out in front of you e in between seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) hands should be at joelho(s) level. Keep seu(s) arms straight e in-line com upward angle of cabo. Elevate seu(s) torso in a crunching motion without dropping or bending seu(s) arms. Maintain rigid position com seu(s) arms. Slowly descend costas até a posição inicial com seu(s) costas arched around Bosu Ball e seu(s) abdominals elongated. Repeat same series of movements to failure. Once you reach failure, keep seu(s) abs tight e raise seu(s) torso em plank position so seu(s) costas is elevated off Bosu Ball. Lower seu(s) arms down to seu(s) side; keep them straight. Start doing alternating side bends; reach for seu(s) heels! This finishing movement will focus on seu(s) obliques.

name: Bottoms-up Clean From Hang Position
instructions: Initiate exercise by standing upright com a kettlebell in one hand. Swing kettlebell costas forcefully e então reverse motion forcefully. Crush kettlebell pegadas as hard as possible e raise kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s).

name: Bottoms Up
instructions: Begin by lying on seu(s) costas on ground. seu(s) legs should be straight e seu(s) arms at seu(s) side. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. To perform movement, tuck joelho(s) toward seu(s) peito by flexing quadril e joelho(s). Following this, extend seu(s) legs directly above you so that they are perpendicular to ground. Rotate e elevate seu(s) pelvis to raise seu(s) glúteo(s) de floor. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Box Jump (multiple Response)
instructions: Assume a relaxed stance facing box or platform approximately an arm's length away. Arms should be down at sides e legs slightly bent. Using arms to aid in initial burst, jump upward e forward, landing com feet simultaneously on top of box or platform. Immediately drop or jump costas down to original starting place; então repeat sequence.

name: Box Skip
instructions: You will need several boxes lined up about 8 feet apart. Begin facing first box com one leg slightly behind other. Drive off costas leg, attempting to gain as much height com quadril as possible. Immediately upon landing on box, drive other leg forward e upward to gain height e distance, leaping de box. Land between first two boxes com same leg that landed on first box. então, step to next box e repeat.

name: Box Agachamento
instructions: Box squat allows you to squat to desired depth e develop explosive strength in squat movement. Begin in a power rack com a box at appropriate height behind you. Typically, you would aim for a box height that brings you to a parallel squat, but you can train higher or lower if desired. Begin by stepping under bar e placing it across costas of ombro(s). contraia a musculatura alvo together e rotate seu(s) cotovelo(s) forward, attempting to bend bar across seu(s) ombro(s). Remove bar de rack, creating a tight arch in seu(s) lower costas, e step costas em position. Place seu(s) feet wider for more emphasis on costas, glúteo(s), adductors, e hamstrings, or closer together for more quad development. Keep seu(s) head facing forward. com seu(s) costas, ombro(s), e core tight, push seu(s) joelho(s) e butt out e you begin seu(s) descent. Sit costas com seu(s) quadril até you are seated on box. Ideally, seu(s) shins should be perpendicular to ground. Pause when you reach box, e relax quadril flexors. Never bounce off of a box. mantendo weight on seu(s) heels e pushing seu(s) feet e joelho(s) out, drive upward off of box as you lead movement com seu(s) head. Continue upward, maintaining tightness head to toe.

name: Box Agachamento com Bands
instructions: Begin in a power rack com a box at appropriate height behind you. Set up bands on sleeves, secured to either band pegs, rack, or halter(es) so that there is appropriate tension. If halter(es) are used, secure them so that they don't move. Also, ensure that halter(es) you are using are heavy enough for bands that you are using. Additional plates can be used to hold halter(es) down. If more tension is needed, you can either widen base on floor or choke bands. Typically, you would aim for a box height that brings you to a parallel squat, but you can train higher or lower if desired. Begin by stepping under bar e placing it across costas of ombro(s). contraia a musculatura alvo together e rotate seu(s) cotovelo(s) forward, attempting to bend bar across seu(s) ombro(s). Remove bar de rack, creating a tight arch in seu(s) lower costas, e step costas em position. Place seu(s) feet wider for more emphasis on costas, glúteo(s), adductors, e hamstrings, or closer together for more quad development. Keep seu(s) head facing forward. com seu(s) costas, ombro(s), e core tight, push seu(s) joelho(s) e butt out e you begin seu(s) descent. Sit costas com seu(s) quadril até you are seated on box. Ideally, seu(s) shins should be perpendicular to ground. Pause when you reach box, e relax quadril flexors. Never bounce off of a box. mantendo weight on seu(s) heels e pushing seu(s) feet e joelho(s) out, drive upward off of box as you lead movement com seu(s) head. Continue upward, maintaining tightness head to toe. Use care to return barra to rack.

name: Box Agachamento com Chains
instructions: Begin in a power rack com a box at appropriate height behind you. Typically, you would aim for a box height that brings you to a parallel squat, but you can train higher or lower if desired. To set up chains, begin by looping leader chain over sleeves of bar. heavy chain should be attached using a snap hook. Adjust length of lead chain so that a few links are still on floor at top of movement. Begin by stepping under bar e placing it across costas of ombro(s). contraia a musculatura alvo together e rotate seu(s) cotovelo(s) forward, attempting to bend bar across seu(s) ombro(s). Remove bar de rack, creating a tight arch in seu(s) lower costas, e step costas em position. Place seu(s) feet wider for more emphasis on costas, glúteo(s), adductors, e hamstrings, or closer together for more quad development. Keep seu(s) head facing forward. com seu(s) costas, ombro(s), e core tight, push seu(s) joelho(s) e butt out e you begin seu(s) descent. Sit costas com seu(s) quadril até you are seated on box. Ideally, seu(s) shins should be perpendicular to ground. Pause when you reach box, e relax quadril flexors. Never bounce off of a box. mantendo weight on seu(s) heels e pushing seu(s) feet e joelho(s) out, drive upward off of box as you lead movement com seu(s) head. Continue upward, maintaining tightness head to toe.

name: Brachialis-smr
instructions: Lie on seu(s) side, com seu(s) upper arm against foam roller. upper arm should be more or less aligned com seu(s) body, com outside of bicep pressed against foam roller. Raise seu(s) quadril off of floor, supporting seu(s) weight on seu(s) arm e on seu(s) feet. Hold for 10-30 seconds, e então switch sides.

name: Bradford/rocky Presses
instructions: Sit on a Military Press banco com a bar at ombro(s) level com a pronated grip (palmas na direção indicada). Tip: seu(s) grip should be wider than ombro(s) width e it should create a 90-degree angle between forearm e upper arm as barra goes down. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Once you pick up barra com correct grip, lift bar up over seu(s) head by locking seu(s) arms. Now lower bar down to costas of head slowly as you Inspire. Lift bar costas up até a posição inicial as you Expire. Lower bar down até a posição inicial slowly as you Inspire. This is one repetições. Alternate in this manner até you complete recommended amount of repetições.

name: Butt-ups
instructions: Begin a pushup position but com seu(s) cotovelo(s) on ground e resting on seu(s) forearms. seu(s) arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle. Arch seu(s) costas slightly out rather than mantendo seu(s) costas completely straight. Raise seu(s) glúteo(s) toward ceiling, squeezing seu(s) abs tightly to close distance between seu(s) ribcage e quadril. end result will be that you'll end up in a high bridge position. Expire as you perform this portion of movement. Lower costas down slowly to seu(s) posição inicial as you breathe in. Tip: Don't let seu(s) costas sag downwards. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Butt Lift (bridge)
instructions: Lie flat on floor on seu(s) costas com hands by seu(s) side e seu(s) joelho(s) bent. seu(s) feet should be placed around ombro(s) width. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pushing mainly com seu(s) heels, lift seu(s) quadril off floor enquanto mantendo seu(s) costas straight. Breathe out as you perform this part of motion e hold at top for a second. Slowly go costas até a posição inicial as you breathe in.

name: Butterfly
instructions: Sit on máquina com seu(s) costas flat on pad. Take hold of pegadas. Tip: seu(s) upper arms should be positioned parallel to floor; adjust máquina accordingly. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Push pegadas together slowly as you squeeze seu(s) peito in middle. Breathe out during this part of motion e hold contraction for a second. Return costas até a posição inicial slowly as you Inspire até seu(s) peito muscles are fully stretched. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Chest Press
instructions: Adjust weight to an appropriate amount e be seated, grasping pegadas. seu(s) upper arms should be about 45 degrees to body, com seu(s) head e peito up. cotovelo(s) should be bent to about 90 degrees. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by extending through cotovelo(s), pressing pegadas together straight in front of you. Keep seu(s) ombro(s) blades retracted as you execute movement. After pausing at full extension, return to th posição inicial, mantendo tension on cables. You can also execute this movement com seu(s) costas off pad, at an incline or decline, or alternate hands.

name: Cruzamento de Cabos
instructions: To get yourself inaté a posição inicial, place pulleys on a high position (above seu(s) head), select resistance to be used e hold pulleys in each hand. Step forward in front of an imaginary straight line between both pulleys enquanto pulling seu(s) arms together in front of you. seu(s) torso should have a small forward bend de waist. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com a slight bend on seu(s) cotovelo(s) in order to prevent stress at biceps tendon, extend seu(s) arms to side (straight out at both sides) in a wide arc até you feel a stretch on seu(s) peito. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout movement, arms e torso should remain stationary; movement should only occur at ombro(s) joint. Return seu(s) arms costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out. Make sure to use same arc of motion used to Abaixe a cargas. Hold for a second at posição inicial e repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Abdominal Crunch
instructions: Kneel below a high pulley that contains a rope attachment. Grasp cabo rope attachment e lower rope até seu(s) hands are placed next to seu(s) face. Flex seu(s) quadril slightly e allow weight to hyperextend lower costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com quadril stationary, flex waist as you contract abs so that cotovelo(s) travel towards middle of thighs. Expire as you perform this portion of movement e hold contraction for a second. Slowly Retorne à posição inicial as you Inspire. Tip: Make sure that you keep constant tension on abs throughout movement. Also, do not choose a weight so heavy that lower costas pegadas brunt of work. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Levantamento Terras
instructions: Move cables to bottom of towers e select an appropriate weight. Stand directly in between uprights. To begin, squat down be flexing seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) até you can reach pegadas. After grasping them, begin seu(s) ascent. Driving through seu(s) heels extend seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) mantendo seu(s) hands hanging at seu(s) side. Keep seu(s) head e peito up throughout movement. After reaching a full standing position, Retorne à posição inicial e repeat.

name: Cabo Rosca Martelos - Rope Attachment
instructions: Attach a rope attachment to a low pulley e stand facing máquina about 12 inches away de it. Grasp rope com a neutral (palms-in) grip e Fique em pé ereto up mantendo natural arch of costas e seu(s) torso stationary. Put seu(s) cotovelo(s) in by seu(s) side e keep them there stationary during entire movement. Tip: Only forearms should move; not seu(s) upper arms. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Using seu(s) biceps, pull seu(s) arms up as you Expire até seu(s) biceps touch seu(s) forearms. Tip: Remember to keep cotovelo(s) in e seu(s) upper arms stationary. After a 1 second contraction where you contraia a musculatura alvo, slowly start to bring weight costas to original position. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Hip Adduction
instructions: Stand in front of a low pulley facing forward com one leg next to pulley e other one away. Attach ankle cuff to cabo e also to ankle of leg that is next to pulley. Now step out e away de stack com a wide stance e segure a barra/pegadas of pulley system. Stand on foot that does not have ankle cuff ( far foot) e allow leg com cuff to be pulled towards low pulley. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now perform movement by moving leg com ankle cuff in front of far leg by using inner thighs to abduct quadril. Breathe out during this portion of movement. Slowly Retorne à posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então repeat same movement com opposite leg.

name: Cabo Inclinado Extensão no Pulley
instructions: Lie on incline an banco facing away de a high pulley máquina that has a straight bar attachment on it. Grasp straight bar attachment overhead com a pronated (overhand; palms down) ombro(s) width grip e extend seu(s) arms in front of you. bar should be around 2 inches away de seu(s) upper thighs. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo upper arms stationary, lift seu(s) arms costas in a semi circle até bar is straight over seu(s) head. Breathe in during this portion of movement. Slowly go costas até a posição inicial using seu(s) lats e hold contraction once you reach posição inicial. Breathe out during execution of this movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Inclinado Triceps Extensão
instructions: Lie on incline an banco facing away de a high pulley máquina that has a straight bar attachment on it. Grasp straight bar attachment overhead com a pronated (overhand; palms down) narrow grip (less than ombro(s) width) e keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) tucked in to seu(s) sides. seu(s) upper arms should create around a 25 degree angle when measured de floor. mantendo upper arms stationary, extend arms as you flex triceps. Breathe out during this portion of movement e hold contraction for a second. Slowly go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Internal Rotation
instructions: Sit next to a low pulley sideways (com legs stretched in front of you or crossed) e grasp single hand cabo attachment com arm nearest to cabo. Tip: If you can adjust pulley's height, you can use a flat banco to sit on instead. Position cotovelo(s) against seu(s) side com cotovelo(s) bent at 90° e arm pointing towards pulley. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull single hand cabo attachment toward seu(s) body by internally rotating seu(s) ombro(s) até seu(s) forearm is across seu(s) abs. You will be creating an imaginary semi-circle. Tip: forearm should be perpendicular to seu(s) torso at all times. Slowly go costas to initial position. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então repeat movement com next arm.

name: Cabo Iron Cross
instructions: Begin by moving pulleys to high position, select resistance to be used, e take a pegadas in each hand. Stand directly between both pulleys com seu(s) arms extended out to seu(s) sides. seu(s) head e peito should be up enquanto seu(s) arms form a "T". This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo cotovelo(s) extended, pull seu(s) arms straight to seu(s) sides. Return seu(s) arms costas até a posição inicial after a pause at peak contraction. Continue movement for prescribed number of repetições.

name: Cabo Judo Flip
instructions: Connect a rope attachment to a tower, e move cabo to lowest pulley position. Stand com seu(s) side to cabo com a wide stance, e grab rope com both hands. Twist seu(s) body away de pulley as you bring rope over seu(s) ombro(s) like you're performing a judo flip. Shift seu(s) weight between seu(s) feet as you twist e crunch forward, pulling cabo downward. Retorne à posição inicial e repeat até failure. então, reposition e repeat same series of movements on opposite side.

name: Cabo Deitado Triceps Extensão
instructions: Lie on a flat banco e grasp straight bar attachment of a low pulley com a narrow overhand grip. Tip: easiest way to do this is to have someone hand you bar as you lay down. com seu(s) arms extended, position bar over seu(s) torso. seu(s) arms e seu(s) torso should create a 90-degree angle. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower bar by bending at cotovelo(s) enquanto mantendo upper arms stationary e cotovelo(s) in. Go down até bar lightly touches seu(s) forehead. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Flex triceps as you lift bar costas to its posição inicial. Expire as you perform this portion of movement. Hold for a second at contracted position e repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Unilateral Tricep Extensão
instructions: Com seu(s) right hand, grasp a single pegadas attached to high-cabo pulley using a supinated (underhand; palmas na direção indicada) grip. You should be standing directly in front of weight stack. Now pull pegadas down so that seu(s) upper arm e cotovelo(s) are locked in to side of seu(s) body. seu(s) upper arm e forearm should form an acute angle (less than 90-degrees). You can keep other arm by waist e you can have one leg in front of you e other one costas for better balance. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you contract triceps, move single pegadas attachment down to seu(s) side até seu(s) arm is straight. Breathe out as you perform this movement. Tip: Only forearms should move. seu(s) upper arms should remain stationary at all times. Squeeze triceps e hold for a second in this contracted position. Retorne lentamente pegadas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então perform same movement com other arm.

name: Cabo Rosca Scott
instructions: Place a preacher banco about 2 feet in front of a pulley máquina. Attach a straight bar to low pulley. Sit at preacher banco com seu(s) cotovelo(s) e upper arms firmly on top of banco pad e have someone hand you bar de low pulley. Grab bar e Estenda completamente os braços on top of preacher banco pad. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now start pilling weight up towards seu(s) ombro(s) e squeeze biceps hard at top of movement. Expire as you perform this motion. Also, hold for a second at top. Now slowly Abaixe a carga até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Crucifixo Inverso
instructions: Adjust pulleys to appropriate height e adjust weight. pulleys should be above seu(s) head. Grab left pulley com seu(s) right hand e right pulley com seu(s) left hand, crossing them in front of you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by moving seu(s) arms costas e outward, mantendo seu(s) arms straight as you execute movement. Pause at end of motion before returning pegadas to start position.

name: Cabo Invertido Abdominal Crunch
instructions: Connect an ankle strap attachment to a low pulley cabo e position a mat on floor in front of it. Sente-se com seu(s) feet toward pulley e attach cabo to seu(s) ankles. Lie down, elevate seu(s) legs e Flexione os joelhos at a 90-degree angle. seu(s) legs e cabo should be aligned. If not, adjust pulley up or down até they are. com seu(s) hands behind seu(s) head, bring seu(s) joelho(s) inward to seu(s) torso e elevate seu(s) quadril off floor. Faça uma pausa breve e in a slow e controlled manner drop seu(s) quadril e bring seu(s) legs costas to starting 90-degree angle. You should still have tension on seu(s) abs in resting position. Repeat same movement to failure.

name: Cabo Rope Acima da Cabeç Triceps Extensão
instructions: Attach a rope to bottom pulley of pulley máquina. Grasping rope com both hands, extend seu(s) arms com seu(s) hands directly above seu(s) head using a neutral grip (palmas na direção indicada). seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be in close to seu(s) head e arms should be perpendicular to floor com knuckles aimed at ceiling. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Abaixe lentamente rope behind seu(s) head as you hold upper arms stationary. Inspire as you perform this movement e pause when seu(s) triceps are fully stretched. Retorne à posição inicial by flexing seu(s) triceps as you breathe out. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Rope Rear-delt Rows
instructions: Sit in same position on a low pulley row station as you would if you were doing seated cabo rows for costas. Attach a rope to pulley e grasp it com an overhand grip. seu(s) arms should be extended e parallel to floor com cotovelo(s) flared out. Keep seu(s) lower costas upright e slide seu(s) quadril costas so that seu(s) joelho(s) are slightly bent. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull cabo attachment towards seu(s) upper peito, just below neck, as you keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) up e out to sides. Continue this motion as you Expire até cotovelo(s) travel slightly behind costas. Tip: Keep seu(s) upper arms horizontal, perpendicular to torso e parallel to floor throughout motion. Go costas to initial position where arms are extended e ombro(s) are stretched forward. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Rotação Russas
instructions: Connect a standard pegadas attachment, e position cabo to a middle pulley position. Lie on a stability ball perpendicular to cabo e grab pegadas com one hand. You should be approximately arm's length away de pulley, com tension of weight on cabo. Grab pegadas com both hands e Estenda completamente os braços above seu(s) peito. You hands should be directly in-line com pulley. If not, adjust pulley up or down até they are. Keep seu(s) quadril elevated e abs engaged. Rotate seu(s) torso away de pulley for a full-quarter rotation. seu(s) body should be flat de head to joelho(s). Faça uma pausa breve e in a slow e controlled manner reset até a posição inicial. You should still have side tension on cabo in resting position. Repeat same movement to failure. então, reposition e repeat same series of movements on opposite side.

name: Cabo Sentado Abdominal Crunch
instructions: Seat on a flat banco com seu(s) costas facing a high pulley. Grasp cabo rope attachment com both hands (com palms of hands facing each other) e place seu(s) hands securely over both ombro(s). Tip: Allow weight to hyperextend lower costas slightly. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com quadril stationary, flex waist so cotovelo(s) travel toward quadril. Breathe out as you perform this step. As you Inspire, go costas to initial position slowly. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Sentado Elevação Lateral
instructions: Stand in middle of two low pulleys that are opposite to each other e place a flat banco right behind you (in perpendicular fashion to you; narrow edge of banco should be one behind you). Select weight to be used on each pulley. Now sit at edge of flat banco behind you com seu(s) feet placed in front of seu(s) joelho(s). Bend forward enquanto mantendo seu(s) costas flat e rest seu(s) torso on thighs. Have someone give you single pegadas attached to pulleys. Grasp left pulley com right hand e right pulley com left after you select seu(s) weight. pulleys should run under seu(s) joelho(s) e seu(s) arms will be extended com palmas na direção indicada e a slight bend at cotovelo(s). This will be posição inicial. enquanto mantendo arms stationary, raise upper arms to sides até they are parallel to floor e at ombro(s) height. Expire during execution of this movement e hold contraction for a second. Abaixe lentamente seu(s) arms até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. Tip: Maintain upper arms perpendicular to torso e a fixed cotovelo(s) position (10 degree to 30 degree angle) throughout exercise.

name: Cabo Desenvolvimento
instructions: Move cables to bottom of towers e select an appropriate weight. Stand directly in between uprights. Grasp cables e hold them at ombro(s) height, palmas na direção indicada. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) head e peito up, extend through cotovelo(s) to press pegadas directly over head. After pausing at top, Retorne à posição inicial e repeat.

name: Cabo Shrugs
instructions: Grasp a cabo bar attachment that is attached to a low pulley com a ombro(s) width or slightly wider overhand (palmas na direção indicada) grip. Stand erect close to pulley com seu(s) arms extended in front of you holding bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lift bar by elevating ombro(s) as high as possible as you Expire. Hold contraction at top for a second. Tip: arms should remain extended at all times. Refrain de using biceps to help lift bar. Only ombro(s) should be moving up e down. Lower bar costas to original position. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cabo Wrist Rosca
instructions: Start out by placing a flat banco in front of a low pulley cabo that has a straight bar attachment. Use seu(s) arms to grab cabo bar com a narrow to ombro(s) width supinated grip (palms up) e bring them up so that seu(s) forearms are resting against top of seu(s) thighs. seu(s) wrists should be hanging just beyond seu(s) joelho(s). Start out by curling seu(s) wrist upwards e exhaling. Keep contraction for a second. Abaixe lentamente seu(s) wrists costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. seu(s) forearms should be stationary as seu(s) wrist is only movement needed to perform this exercise. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Calf-máquina Shoulder Encolhimento
instructions: Position yourself on calf máquina so that ombro(s) pads are above seu(s) ombro(s). seu(s) torso should be straight com arms extended normally by seu(s) side. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) ombro(s) up towards seu(s) ears as you Expire e hold contraction for a full second. Slowly Retorne à posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Calf Press
instructions: Adjust seat so that seu(s) legs are only slightly bent in start position. balls of seu(s) feet should be firmly on platform. Select an appropriate weight, e segure a barra/pegadas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Straighten legs by extending joelho(s), just barely lifting weight de stack. seu(s) ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute movement by pressing downward through balls of seu(s) feet o máximo possível. After a brief pause, reverse motion e repeat.

name: Calf Press no Leg Press Máquina
instructions: Using a leg press máquina, Sente-se on máquina e place seu(s) legs on platform directly in front of you at a medium (ombro(s) width) foot stance. Lower safety bars holding weighted platform in place e press platform all way up até seu(s) legs are fully extended in front of you sem travar os joelhos. (Note: In some leg press units you can leave safety bars on for increased safety. If seu(s) leg press unit allows for this, então this is preferred method of performing exercise.) seu(s) torso e legs should make perfect 90-degree angle. Now carefully place seu(s) toes e balls of seu(s) feet on lower portion of platform com heels extending off. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at beginning of chapter. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Press on platform by raising seu(s) heels as you breathe out by extending seu(s) ankles as high as possible e flexing seu(s) calf. Ensure that joelho(s) is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold contracted position by a second before you start to go costas down. Go costas slowly até a posição inicial as you breathe in by lowering seu(s) heels as you bend ankles até calves are stretched. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Elevação de Panturrilha no Halter
instructions: Hang on to a sturdy object for balance e stand on a halter(es) pegadas, preferably one com round plates so that it rolls as in this manner you have to work harder to stabilize yourself; thus increasing effectiveness of exercise. Now roll seu(s) foot slightly forward so that you can get a nice stretch of calf. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lift calf as you roll seu(s) foot over top of pegadas so that you get a full extension. Expire during execution of this movement. Contract calf hard at top e hold for a second. Tip: As you come up, roll halter(es) slightly backward. Now Inspire as you roll halter(es) slightly forward as you come down to get a better stretch. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Elevação de Panturrilhas - com Bands
instructions: Grab an exercise band e stand on it com seu(s) toes making sure that length of band between foot e arms is same for both sides. enquanto holding pegadas of band, raise arms to side of seu(s) head as if you were getting ready to perform a ombro(s) press. palms should be facing forward com cotovelo(s) bent e to sides. This movement will create tension on band. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo hands by seu(s) ombro(s), stand up on seu(s) toes as you Expire e contract calves hard at top of movement. After a one second contraction, slowly go costas down até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Calf Alongamento Elbows Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall de a couple feet away. Lean against wall, placing seu(s) weight on seu(s) forearms. Attempt to keep seu(s) heels on ground. Hold for 10-20 seconds. You may move further or closer wall, making it more or less difficult, respectively.

name: Calf Alongamento Hands Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall de several feet away. Stagger seu(s) stance, placing one foot forward. Lean forward e rest seu(s) hands on wall, mantendo seu(s) heel, quadril e head in a straight line. Attempt to keep seu(s) heel on ground. Hold for 10-20 seconds e então switch sides.

name: Calves-smr
instructions: Begin seated on floor. Place a foam roller underneath seu(s) lower leg. seu(s) other leg can either be crossed over opposite or be placed on floor, supporting some of seu(s) weight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Place seu(s) hands to seu(s) side or just behind you, e press down to raise seu(s) quadril off of floor, placing much of seu(s) weight against seu(s) calf muscle. Roll de below joelho(s) to above ankle, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat for other leg.

name: Car Levantamento Terra
instructions: This event apparatus typically has neutral grip pegadas, however some have a straight bar that you can approach like a normal deadlift. apparatus can be loaded com a vehicle or other heavy objects such as tractor tires or kegs. Center yourself between pegadas if you are a strong squatter, or costas a couple inches if you are a strong deadlifter. You feet should be about quadril width apart. Bend at quadril to grip pegadas. com seu(s) feet e seu(s) grip set, take a big breath e então lower seu(s) quadril e flex joelho(s). Look forward com seu(s) head, keep seu(s) peito up e seu(s) costas arched, e begin driving through heels to move weight upward. As weight comes up, pull seu(s) ombro(s) blades together as you drive seu(s) quadril forward. Abaixe a carga by bending at quadril e guiding it to floor.

name: Car Drivers
instructions: Enquanto standing upright, hold a barra plate in both hands at 3 e 9 o'clock positions. seu(s) palms should be facing each other e seu(s) arms should be extended straight out in front of you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by rotating plate as far to one side as possible. Use same type of movement you would use to turn a steering wheel to one side. Reverse motion, turning it all way to opposite side. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Carioca Quick Step
instructions: Begin com seu(s) feet a few inches apart e seu(s) left arm up in a relaxed, athletic position. com seu(s) right foot, quick step behind e pull joelho(s) up. Fire seu(s) arms costas up when you pull right joelho(s), being sure that seu(s) joelho(s) goes straight up e down. Avoid turning seu(s) feet as you move e continue to look forward as you move to side.

name: Cat Alongamento
instructions: Position yourself on floor on seu(s) hands e joelho(s). Pull seu(s) belly in e round seu(s) spine, lower costas, ombro(s), e neck, letting seu(s) head drop. Hold for 15 seconds.

name: Catch e Acima da Cabeç Throw
instructions: Begin standing enquanto facing a wall or a partner. Using both hands, position ball behind seu(s) head, stretching as much as possible, e forcefully throw ball forward. Ensure that you follow seu(s) throw through, being prepared to receive seu(s) rebound de seu(s) throw. If you are throwing against wall, make sure that you stand close enough to wall to receive rebound, e aim a little higher than you would com a partner.

name: Chain Handle Extensão
instructions: You will need two cabo pegadas attachments e a flat banco, as well as chains, for this exercise. Clip middle of chains to pegadas, e position yourself on flat banco. seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be pointing straight up. Begin by extending through cotovelo(s), mantendo seu(s) upper arm still, com seu(s) wrists pronated. Pause at lockout, e reverse motion to Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Chain Press
instructions: Begin by connecting chains to cabo pegadas attachments. Position yourself on flat banco in same position as for a halter(es) press. seu(s) wrists should be pronated e arms perpendicular to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower chains by flexing cotovelo(s), unloading some of chain onto floor. Continue até seu(s) cotovelo(s) forms a 90 degree angle, e então reverse motion by extending through cotovelo(s) to lockout.

name: Chair Leg Extended Alongamento
instructions: Sit upright in a chair e grip seat on sides. Raise one leg, extending joelho(s), flexing ankle as you do so. Slowly move that leg outward as far as you can, e então costas to center e down. Repeat for seu(s) other leg.

name: Chair Lower Back Alongamento
instructions: Sit upright on a chair. Bend to one side com seu(s) arm over seu(s) head. You can hold onto chair com seu(s) free hand. Hold for 10 seconds, e repeat for seu(s) other side.

name: Chair Agachamento
instructions: To begin, first set bar to a position that best matches seu(s) height. Once bar is loaded, step under it e position it across costas of seu(s) ombro(s). Take bar com seu(s) hands facing forward, unlock it e lift it off rack by extending seu(s) legs. Move seu(s) feet forward about 18 inches in front of bar. Position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s) width stance com toes slightly pointed out. Look forward at all times e maintain a neutral or slightly arched spine. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Abaixe lentamente bar by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até angle between upper e lower leg breaks 90 degrees. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor com heels of seu(s) feet, extending joelho(s) e returning até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Chair Upper Body Alongamento
instructions: Sit on edge of a chair, gripping costas of it. Estenda os braços, mantendo seu(s) costas straight, e pull seu(s) upper body forward so you feel a stretch. Hold for 20-30 seconds.

name: Chest e Front de Shoulder Alongamento
instructions: Start off by standing com seu(s) legs together, holding a bodybar or a broomstick. Take a slightly wider than ombro(s) width grip on pole e hold it in front of you com seu(s) palmas na direção indicada. Carefully lift pole up e behind seu(s) head.

name: Chest Push From 3 Point Stance
instructions: Begin in a three point stance, squatted down com seu(s) costas flat e one hand on ground. Place medicine ball directly in front of you. To begin, take seu(s) first step as you pull ball to seu(s) peito, positioning both hands to prepare for throw. As you execute second step, explosively release ball forward as hard as possible.

name: Chest Push (multiple Response)
instructions: Begin in a kneeling position facing a wall or utilize a partner. Hold ball com both hands tight em peito. Execute pass by exploding forward e outward com quadril enquanto pushing ball as hard as possible. Follow through by falling forward, catching yourself com seu(s) hands. Immediately return to an upright position. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: Chest Push (single Response)
instructions: Begin in a kneeling position holding medicine ball com both hands tightly em peito. Execute pass by exploding forward e outward com quadril enquanto pushing ball o máximo possível. Follow through by falling forward, catching yourself com seu(s) hands.

name: Chest Push com Run Release
instructions: Begin in an athletic stance com joelho(s) bent, quadril costas, e costas flat. Hold medicine ball near seu(s) legs. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto taking seu(s) first step draw medicine ball em seu(s) peito. As you take second step, explosively push ball forward, immediately sprinting for 10 yards after release. If you are really fast, you can catch seu(s) own pass!

name: Chest Alongamento no Stability Ball
instructions: Get on seu(s) hands e joelho(s) next to an exercise ball. Place seu(s) cotovelo(s) on top of ball, mantendo seu(s) arm out to seu(s) side. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower seu(s) torso towards floor, mantendo seu(s) cotovelo(s) on top of ball. Hold stretch for 20-30 seconds, e repeat com other arm.

name: Child's Pose
instructions: Get on seu(s) hands e joelho(s), walk seu(s) hands in front of you. Lower seu(s) buttocks down to sit on seu(s) heels. Let seu(s) arms drag along floor as you sit costas to stretch seu(s) entire spine. Once you settle onto seu(s) heels, bring seu(s) hands next to seu(s) feet e relax. "breathe" em seu(s) costas. Rest seu(s) forehead on floor. Avoid this position if you have joelho(s) problems.

name: Barra Fixa (pegada Supinada)
instructions: Grab pull-up bar com palms facing seu(s) torso e a grip closer than ombro(s) width. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding bar at chosen grip width, keep seu(s) torso as straight as possible enquanto creating a curvature on seu(s) lower costas e sticking seu(s) peito out. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: mantendo torso as straight as possible maximizes biceps stimulation enquanto minimizing costas involvement. As you breathe out, pull seu(s) torso up até seu(s) head is around level of pull-up bar. Concentrate on using biceps muscles in order to perform movement. Keep cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) body. Tip: upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work other than hold bar. After a second of squeezing biceps in contracted position, Abaixe lentamente seu(s) torso costas até a posição inicial; when seu(s) arms are fully extended. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat this motion for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Chin To Chest Alongamento
instructions: Get em a seated position on floor. Place both hands at rear of seu(s) head, fingers interlocked, thumbs pointing down e cotovelo(s) pointing straight ahead. Slowly pull seu(s) head down to seu(s) peito. Hold for 20-30 seconds.

name: Circus Bell
instructions: Circus bell is an oversized halter(es) com a thick pegadas. Begin com halter(es) between seu(s) feet, e grip pegadas com both hands. Clean halter(es) by extending through seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) to deliver implement to desired ombro(s), letting go com extra hand. Ensure that you get one of halter(es) heads behind ombro(s) to keep de being thrown off balance. To raise it overhead, dip by flexing joelho(s), e drive upwards as you extend halter(es) overhead, leaning slightly away de it as you do so. Carefully guide bell costas to floor, mantendo it under control as much as possible. It is best to perform this event on a thick rubber mat to prevent damage to floor.

name: Clean
instructions: Com a barra on floor close to shins, take an overhand (or hook) grip just outside legs. Lower seu(s) quadril com weight focused on heels, costas straight, head facing forward, peito up, com seu(s) ombro(s) just in front of bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through heels, extending seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) costas angle should stay same, e seu(s) arms should remain straight. Move weight com control as you continue to above joelho(s). Next comes second pull, main source of acceleration for clean. As bar approaches mid-thigh position, begin extending through quadril. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending quadril, joelho(s), e ankles, using speed to move bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through arms to accelerate weight; at end of second pull, body should be fully extended, leaning slightly costas, com arms still extended. As full extension is achieved, transition em third pull by aggressively shrugging e flexing arms com cotovelo(s) up e out. At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating seu(s) cotovelo(s) under bar as you do so. Receive bar in a front squat position, depth of which is dependent upon height of bar at end of third pull. bar should be racked onto protracted ombro(s), lightly touching throat com hands relaxed. Continue to descend to bottom squat position, which will help in recovery. Immediately recover by driving through heels, mantendo torso upright e cotovelo(s) up. Continue até you have risen to a standing position.

name: Clean Levantamento Terra
instructions: Begin standing com a barra close to seu(s) shins. seu(s) feet should be directly under seu(s) quadril com seu(s) feet turned out slightly. Grip bar com a double overhand grip or hook grip, about ombro(s) width apart. Squat down to bar. seu(s) spine should be in full extension, com a costas angle that places seu(s) ombro(s) in front of bar e seu(s) costas as vertical as possible. Begin by driving through floor through front of seu(s) heels. As bar travels upward, maintain a constant costas angle. Flare seu(s) joelho(s) out to side to help keep them out of bar's path. After bar crosses joelho(s), complete lift by driving quadril em bar até seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) are extended.

name: Clean Pull
instructions: Com a barra on floor close to shins, take an overhand or hook grip just outside legs. Lower seu(s) quadril com weight focused on heels, costas straight, head facing forward, peito up, com seu(s) ombro(s) just in front of bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through heels, extending seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) costas angle should stay same, e seu(s) arms should remain straight e cotovelo(s) out. Move weight com control as you continue to above joelho(s). Next comes second pull, main source of acceleration for clean. As bar approaches mid-thigh position, begin extending through quadril. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending quadril, joelho(s), e ankles, using speed to move bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through arms to accelerate weight; at end of second pull, body should be fully extended, leaning slightly costas, com arms still extended. Full extension should be violent e abrupt, e ensure that you do not prolong extension for longer than necessary.

name: Clean Encolhimento
instructions: Begin com a ombro(s) width, double overhand or hook grip, com bar hanging at mid thigh position. seu(s) costas should be straight e inclined slightly forward. Shrug seu(s) ombro(s) towards seu(s) ears. enquanto this exercise can usually by loaded com heavier weight than a clean, avoid overloading to point that execution slows down.

name: Clean e Jerk
instructions: Com a barra on floor close to shins, take an overhand or hook grip just outside legs. Lower seu(s) quadril com weight focused on heels, costas straight, head facing forward, peito up, com seu(s) ombro(s) just in front of bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through heels, extending seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) costas angle should stay same, e seu(s) arms should remain straight. Move weight com control as you continue to above joelho(s). Next comes second pull, main source of acceleration for clean. As bar approaches mid-thigh position, begin extending through quadril. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending quadril, joelho(s), e ankles, using speed to move bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through arms to accelerate weight; at end of second pull, body should be fully extended, leaning slightly costas, com arms still extended. As full extension is achieved, transition em third pull by aggressively shrugging e flexing arms com cotovelo(s) up e out. At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating seu(s) cotovelo(s) under bar as you do so. Receive bar in a front squat position, depth of which is dependent upon height of bar at end of third pull. bar should be racked onto protracted ombro(s), lightly touching throat com hands relaxed. Continue to descend to bottom squat position, which will help in recovery. Immediately recover by driving through heels, mantendo torso upright e cotovelo(s) up. Continue até you have risen to a standing position. second phase is jerk, which raises weight overhead. Standing com weight racked on front of ombro(s), begin com dip. com seu(s) feet directly under seu(s) quadril, flex joelho(s) without moving quadril backward. Go down only slightly, e reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through heels create as much speed e force as possible, e be sure to move seu(s) head out of way as bar leaves ombro(s).
