At this moment as feet leave floor, feet must be placed em receiving position as quickly as possible. In brief moment feet are not actively driving against platform, athletes effort to push bar up will drive them down. feet should be split, com one foot forward, e one foot costas. Receive bar com arms locked out overhead. Return to a standing position.

name: Clean e Press
instructions: Assume a ombro(s)-width stance, com joelho(s) inside arms. Now enquanto mantendo costas flat, bend at joelho(s) e quadril so that you can grab bar com arms fully extended e a pronated grip that is slightly wider than ombro(s) width. Point cotovelo(s) out to sides. bar should be close to shins. Position ombro(s) over or slightly ahead of bar. Establish a flat costas posture. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin to pull bar by extending joelho(s). Move seu(s) quadril forward e raise ombro(s) at same rate enquanto mantendo angle of costas constant; continue to lift bar straight up enquanto mantendo it close to seu(s) body. As bar passes joelho(s), extend at ankles, joelho(s), e quadril forcefully, similar to a jumping motion. As you do so, continue to guide bar com seu(s) hands, shrugging seu(s) ombro(s) e using momentum de seu(s) movement to pull bar as high as possible. bar should travel close to seu(s) body, e you should keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) out. At maximum elevation, seu(s) feet should clear floor e you should start to pull yourself under bar. mechanics of this could change slightly, depending on weight used. You should descend em a squatting position as you pull yourself under bar. As bar hits terminal height, rotate seu(s) cotovelo(s) around e under bar. Rack bar across front of ombro(s) enquanto mantendo torso erect e flexing quadril e joelho(s) to absorb weight of bar. Stand to full height, holding bar in clean position. Without moving seu(s) feet, press bar overhead as you Expire. Lower bar under control .

name: Clean From Blocks
instructions: Com a barra on boxes or stands of desired height, take an overhand or hook grip just outside legs. Lower seu(s) quadril com weight focused on heels, costas straight, head facing forward, peito up, com seu(s) ombro(s) just in front of bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through heels, extending seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) costas angle should stay same, e seu(s) arms should remain straight com cotovelo(s) pointed out. As full extension is achieved, transition em receiving position by aggressively shrugging e flexing arms com cotovelo(s) up e out. Aggressively pull yourself down, rotating seu(s) cotovelo(s) under bar as you do so. Receive bar in a front squat position, depth of which is dependent upon height of bar at end of third pull. bar should be racked onto protracted ombro(s), lightly touching throat com hands relaxed. Continue to descend to bottom squat position, which will help in recovery. Immediately recover by driving through heels, mantendo torso upright e cotovelo(s) up. Continue até you have risen to a standing position. Return weight to boxes for next repetições.

name: Clock Flexão de Braço
instructions: Move em a prone position on floor, supporting seu(s) weight on seu(s) hands e toes. seu(s) arms should be fully extended com hands around ombro(s) width. Keep seu(s) body straight throughout movement. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Descend by flexing at cotovelo(s), lowering seu(s) peito toward ground. At bottom, reverse motion by pushing yourself up through cotovelo(s) extension as quickly as possible até you are air borne. Aim to "jump" 12-18 inches to one side. As you accelerate up, move seu(s) outside foot away de seu(s) direction of travel. Leaving ground, shift seu(s) body about 30 degrees for next repetições. Retorne à posição inicial e repeat exercise, working all way around até you are costas where you started.

name: Pegada Fechada Supino Reto com Barra
instructions: Lie costas on a flat banco. Using a close grip (around ombro(s) width), lift bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, come down slowly até you feel bar on seu(s) middle peito. Tip: Make sure that - as opposed to a regular banco press - you keep cotovelo(s) close to torso at all times in order to maximize triceps involvement. After a second pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out e push bar using seu(s) triceps muscles. Lock seu(s) arms in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place bar costas in rack.

name: Pegada Fechada Halter Press
instructions: Place a halter(es) standing up on a flat banco. Ensuring that halter(es) stays securely placed at top of banco, lie perpendicular to banco com only seu(s) ombro(s) lying on surface. quadril should be below banco e seu(s) legs bent com seu(s) feet firmly on floor. Grasp halter(es) com both hands e hold it straight over seu(s) peito at arm's length. Both palms should be pressing against underside of sides of halter(es). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by lowering halter(es) to seu(s) peito. Retorne à posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s).

name: Pegada Fechada Ez-bar Rosca com Elástico
instructions: Attach a band to each end of bar. Take bar, placing a foot on middle of band. Stand upright com a narrow, supinated grip on EZ bar. cotovelo(s) should be close to torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo upper arms in place, flex cotovelo(s) to execute curl. Expire as weight is lifted. Continue movement até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e bar is at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a second e squeeze biceps hard. Slowly begin to bring bar costas to posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Fechada Ez-bar Press
instructions: Lie on a flat banco com an EZ bar loaded to an appropriate weight. Using a narrow grip lift bar e hold it straight over seu(s) torso com seu(s) cotovelo(s) in. arms should be perpendicular to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now lower bar down to seu(s) lower peito as you breathe in. Keep cotovelo(s) in as you perform this movement. Using triceps to push bar costas up, press it costas até a posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s) as you Expire. Repeat.

name: Pegada Fechada Ez Bar Rosca
instructions: Stand up com seu(s) torso upright enquanto holding an E-Z Curl Bar at closer inner pegadas. palm of seu(s) hands should be facing forward e they should be slightly tilted inwards due to shape of bar. cotovelo(s) should be close to torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto holding upper arms stationary, curl weights forward enquanto contracting biceps as you breathe out. Tip: Only forearms should move. Continue movement até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e bar is at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a second e squeeze biceps hard. Slowly begin to bring bar costas to posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Fechada Front Puxada Alta
instructions: Sente-se on a pull-down máquina com a wide bar attached to top pulley. Make sure that you adjust joelho(s) pad of máquina to fit seu(s) height. These pads will prevent seu(s) body de being raised by resistance attached to bar. Grab bar com palmas na direção indicada using prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, seu(s) hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than seu(s) ombro(s) width. For a medium grip, seu(s) hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to seu(s) ombro(s) width e for a close grip at a distance smaller than seu(s) ombro(s) width. As you have both arms extended in front of you - enquanto holding bar at chosen grip width - bring seu(s) torso costas around 30 degrees or so enquanto creating a curvature on seu(s) lower costas e sticking seu(s) peito out. This is seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, bring bar down até it touches seu(s) upper peito by drawing ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. upper torso should remain stationary (only arms should move). forearms should do no other work except for holding bar; therefore do not try to pull bar down using forearms. After a second in contracted position, enquanto squeezing seu(s) ombro(s) blades together, slowly raise bar costas até a posição inicial when seu(s) arms are fully extended e lats are fully stretched. Inspire during this portion of movement. 6. Repeat this motion for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Fechada Flexão de Braço Off de Halter
instructions: Lie on floor e place seu(s) hands on an upright halter(es). Supporting seu(s) weight on seu(s) toes e hands, keep seu(s) torso rigid e seu(s) cotovelo(s) in com seu(s) arms straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower seu(s) body, allowing cotovelo(s) to flex enquanto you Inspire. Keep seu(s) body straight, not allowing seu(s) quadril to rise or sag. Press yourself costas up até a posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s). Breathe out as you perform this step. After a pause at contracted position, repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Fechada em Pé Rosca Direta com Barra
instructions: Hold a barra com both hands, palms up e a few inches apart. Stand com seu(s) torso straight e seu(s) head up. seu(s) feet should be about ombro(s) width e seu(s) cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: You will keep seu(s) upper arms e cotovelo(s) stationary throughout movement. Curl bar up in a semicircular motion até forearms touch seu(s) biceps. Expire as you perform this portion of movement e contract seu(s) biceps hard for a second at top. Tip: Avoid bending costas or using swinging motions as you lift weight. Only forearms should move. Slowly go costas down até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cocoons
instructions: Begin by lying on seu(s) costas on ground. seu(s) legs should be straight e seu(s) arms extended behind seu(s) head. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. To perform movement, tuck joelho(s) toward seu(s) peito, rotating seu(s) pelvis to lift seu(s) glúteo(s) de floor. As you do so, flex spine, bringing seu(s) arms costas over seu(s) head to perform a simultaneous crunch motion. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Conan's Wheel
instructions: Com weight loaded, take a zurcher hold on end of implement. Place bar in crook of cotovelo(s) e hold onto seu(s) wrist. Try to keep weight off of forearms. Begin by lifting weight de ground. Keep a tight, upright posture as you being to walk, taking short, fast steps. Look up e away as you turn in a circle. Do not hold seu(s) breath during event. Continue walking até you complete one or more complete turns.

name: Rosca Concentradas
instructions: Sente-se on a flat banco com one halter(es) in front of you between seu(s) legs. seu(s) legs should be spread com seu(s) joelho(s) bent e feet on floor. Use seu(s) right arm to pick halter(es) up. Place costas of seu(s) right upper arm on top of seu(s) inner right thigh. Rotate palm of seu(s) hand até it is facing forward away de seu(s) thigh. Tip: seu(s) arm should be extended e halter(es) should be above floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto holding upper arm stationary, curl weights forward enquanto contracting biceps as you breathe out. Only forearms should move. Continue movement até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) level. Tip: At top of movement make sure that little finger of seu(s) arm is higher than seu(s) thumb. This guarantees a good contraction. Hold contracted position for a second as you squeeze biceps. Slowly begin to bring halter(es) costas to posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Caution: Avoid swinging motions at any time. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. então repeat movement com left arm.

name: Cross-body Abdominal Crunch
instructions: Lie flat on seu(s) costas e Flexione os joelhos about 60 degrees. Keep seu(s) pés firmes no chão e place seu(s) hands loosely behind seu(s) head. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now curl up e bring seu(s) right cotovelo(s) e ombro(s) across seu(s) body enquanto bring seu(s) left joelho(s) in toward seu(s) left ombro(s) at same time. Reach com seu(s) cotovelo(s) e try to touch seu(s) joelho(s). Expire as you perform this movement. Tip: Try to bring seu(s) ombro(s) up towards seu(s) joelho(s) rather than just seu(s) cotovelo(s) e remember that key is to contract abs as you perform movement; not just to move cotovelo(s). Now go costas down até a posição inicial as you Inspire e repeat com left cotovelo(s) e right joelho(s). Continue alternating in this manner até all prescribed repetições are done.

name: Cross Body Rosca Martelo
instructions: Fique em pé ereto com a halter(es) in each hand. seu(s) hands should be down at seu(s) side com seu(s) palms facing in. enquanto mantendo seu(s) palms facing in e without twisting seu(s) arm, curl halter(es) of right arm up towards seu(s) left ombro(s) as you Expire. Touch top of halter(es) to seu(s) ombro(s) e hold contraction for a second. Slowly Abaixe a carga along same path as you Inspire e então repeat same movement for left arm. Continue alternating in this fashion até recommended amount of repetições is performed for each arm.

name: Cross Over - com Bands
instructions: Secure an exercise band around a stationary post. enquanto facing away de post, grab pegadas on both ends of band e step forward enough to create tension on band. Raise seu(s) arms to sides, parallel to floor, perpendicular to seu(s) torso (seu(s) torso e arms should resemble letter "T") e com palmas na direção indicada. Have them extended com a slight bend at cotovelo(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo seu(s) arms straight, bring them across seu(s) peito in a semicircular motion to front as you Expire e flex seu(s) pecs. Hold contraction for a second. Slowly Retorne à posição inicial as you Inspire. Perform for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Crossover Invertido Afundo
instructions: Fique em pé com os pés ombro(s) width apart. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Perform a rear lunge by stepping costas com one foot e flexing quadril e front joelho(s). As you do so, rotate seu(s) torso across front leg. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial e repeat on other side, continuing in an alternating fashion.

name: Crucifix
instructions: In crucifix, you statically hold weights out to side for time. enquanto event can be practiced using halter(es), it is best to practice com one of various implements used, such as axes e hammers, as it feels different. Begin standing, e raise seu(s) arms out to side holding implements. seu(s) arms should be parallel to ground. In competition, judges or sensors are used to let you know when you break parallel. Hold for as long as you can. Typically, weights should be heavy enough that you fail in 30-60 seconds.

name: Abdominal Crunch - Hands Acima da Cabeç
instructions: Lie on floor com seu(s) costas flat e joelho(s) bent com around a 60-degree angle between hamstrings e calves. Keep seu(s) pés firmes no chão e stretch seu(s) arms overhead com seu(s) palms crossed. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Curl seu(s) upper body forward e bring seu(s) ombro(s) blades just off floor. At all times, keep seu(s) arms aligned com seu(s) head, neck e ombro(s). Don't move them forward de that position. Expire as you perform this portion of movement e hold contraction for a second. Abaixe lentamente down até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Abdominal Crunch - Legs no Exercise Ball
instructions: Lie flat on seu(s) costas com seu(s) feet resting on an exercise ball e seu(s) joelho(s) bent at a 90 degree angle. Place seu(s) feet three to four inches apart e point seu(s) toes inward so they touch. Place seu(s) hands lightly on either side of seu(s) head mantendo seu(s) cotovelo(s) in. Tip: Don't lock seu(s) fingers behind seu(s) head. Push small of seu(s) costas down in floor in order to better isolate seu(s) abdominal muscles. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin to roll seu(s) ombro(s) off floor e continue to push down as hard as you can com seu(s) lower costas. seu(s) ombro(s) should come up off floor only about four inches, e seu(s) lower costas should remain on floor. Breathe out as you execute this portion of movement. Squeeze seu(s) abdominals hard at top of contraction e hold for a second. Tip: Focus on a slow, controlled movement. Refrain de using momentum at any time. Slowly go costas down até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Abdominal Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on seu(s) costas com seu(s) pés firmes no chão, or resting on a banco com seu(s) joelho(s) bent at a 90 degree angle. If you are resting seu(s) feet on a banco, place them three to four inches apart e point seu(s) toes inward so they touch. Now place seu(s) hands lightly on either side of seu(s) head mantendo seu(s) cotovelo(s) in. Tip: Don't lock seu(s) fingers behind seu(s) head. enquanto pushing small of seu(s) costas down in floor to better isolate seu(s) abdominal muscles, begin to roll seu(s) ombro(s) off floor. Continue to push down as hard as you can com seu(s) lower costas as you contract seu(s) abdominals e Expire. seu(s) ombro(s) should come up off floor only about four inches, e seu(s) lower costas should remain on floor. At top of movement, contract seu(s) abdominals hard e keep contraction for a second. Tip: Focus on slow, controlled movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum. After one second contraction, begin to come down slowly again até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Cuban Press
instructions: Take a halter(es) in each hand com a pronated grip in a standing position. Raise seu(s) upper arms so that they are parallel to floor, allowing seu(s) lower arms to hang in "scarecrow" position. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. To initiate movement, externally rotate ombro(s) to move upper arm 180 degrees. Keep upper arms in place, rotating upper arms até wrists are directly above cotovelo(s), forearms perpendicular to floor. Now press halter(es) by extending at cotovelo(s), straightening seu(s) arms overhead. Retorne à posição inicial as you breathe in by reversing steps. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Dancer's Alongamento
instructions: Sit up on floor. Cross seu(s) right leg over seu(s) left, mantendo joelho(s) bent. seu(s) left leg is straight e down on floor. Place seu(s) left arm on seu(s) right leg e seu(s) right hand on floor. Rotate seu(s) upper body to right, e hold for 10-20 seconds. Switch sides.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Begin lying on seu(s) costas com seu(s) hands extended above you toward ceiling. Bring seu(s) feet, joelho(s), e quadril up to 90 degrees. Expire hard to bring seu(s) ribcage down e flatten seu(s) costas onto floor, rotating seu(s) pelvis up e squeezing seu(s) glúteo(s). Hold this position throughout movement. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate exercise by extending one leg, straightening joelho(s) e quadril to bring leg just above ground. Maintain position of seu(s) lumbar e pelvis as you perform movement, as seu(s) costas is going to want to arch. Stay tight e return working leg até a posição inicial. Repeat on opposite side, alternating até set is complete.

name: Levantamento Terra com Bands
instructions: To deadlift com short bands, simply loop them over bar before you start, e step em them to set up. For long bands, they will need to be anchored to a secure base, such as heavy halter(es) or a rack. com seu(s) feet, e seu(s) grip set, take a big breath e então lower seu(s) quadril e bend joelho(s) até seu(s) shins contact bar. Look forward com seu(s) head, keep seu(s) peito up e seu(s) costas arched, e begin driving through heels to move weight upward. After bar passes joelho(s), aggressively pull bar costas, pulling seu(s) ombro(s) blades together as you drive seu(s) quadril forward em bar. Lower bar by bending at quadril e guiding it to floor.

name: Levantamento Terra com Chains
instructions: You can attach chains to sleeves of bar, or just drape middle over bar so there is a greater weight increase as you lift. Approach bar so that it is centered over seu(s) feet. You feet should be about quadril width apart. Bend at quadril to grip bar at ombro(s) width, allowing seu(s) ombro(s) blades to protract. Typically, you would use an overhand grip or an over/under grip on heavier sets. com seu(s) feet, e seu(s) grip set, take a big breath e então lower seu(s) quadril e bend joelho(s) até seu(s) shins contact bar. Look forward com seu(s) head, keep seu(s) peito up e seu(s) costas arched, e begin driving through heels to move weight upward. After bar passes joelho(s), aggressively pull bar costas, pulling seu(s) ombro(s) blades together as you drive seu(s) quadril forward em bar. Lower bar by bending at quadril e guiding it to floor.

name: Declinado Supino Reto com Barra
instructions: Secure seu(s) legs at end of decline banco e slowly lay down on banco. Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in middle of movement between forearms e upper arms), lift bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked. arms should be perpendicular to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: In order to protect seu(s) rotator cuff, it is best if you have a spotter help you lift barra off rack. As you breathe in, come down slowly até you feel bar on seu(s) lower peito. After a second pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out e push bar using seu(s) peito muscles. Lock seu(s) arms e squeeze seu(s) peito in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up). Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place bar costas in rack.

name: Declinado Pegada Fechada Bench To Tríceps Testa
instructions: Secure seu(s) legs at end of decline banco e slowly lay down on banco. Using a close grip (a grip that is slightly less than ombro(s) width), lift bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked e cotovelo(s) in. arms should be perpendicular to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: In order to protect seu(s) rotator cuff, it is best if you have a spotter help you lift barra off rack. Now lower bar down to seu(s) lower peito as you breathe in. Keep cotovelo(s) in as you perform this movement. Using triceps to push bar costas up, press it costas até a posição inicial as you Expire. As you breathe in e you keep upper arms stationary, bring bar down slowly by moving seu(s) forearms in a semicircular motion towards you até you feel bar slightly touch seu(s) forehead. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Lift bar costas até a posição inicial by contracting triceps e exhaling. Repeat steps 3-6 até recommended amount of repetições is performed.

name: Declinado Abdominal Crunch
instructions: Secure seu(s) legs at end of decline banco e lie down. Now place seu(s) hands lightly on either side of seu(s) head mantendo seu(s) cotovelo(s) in. Tip: Don't lock seu(s) fingers behind seu(s) head. enquanto pushing small of seu(s) costas down in banco to better isolate seu(s) abdominal muscles, begin to roll seu(s) ombro(s) off it. Continue to push down as hard as you can com seu(s) lower costas as you contract seu(s) abdominals e Expire. seu(s) ombro(s) should come up off banco only about four inches, e seu(s) lower costas should remain on banco. At top of movement, contract seu(s) abdominals hard e keep contraction for a second. Tip: Focus on slow, controlled movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum. After one second contraction, begin to come down slowly again até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Declinado Supino com Halteres
instructions: Secure seu(s) legs at end of decline banco e lie down com a halter(es) on each hand on top of seu(s) thighs. palms of seu(s) hand will be facing each other. Once you are laying down, move halter(es) in front of you at ombro(s) width. Once at ombro(s) width, rotate seu(s) wrists forward so that palms of seu(s) hands are facing away de you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Bring down weights slowly to seu(s) side as you breathe out. Keep full control of halter(es) at all times. Tip: Throughout motion, forearms should always be perpendicular to floor. As you breathe out, push halter(es) up using seu(s) pectoral muscles. Lock seu(s) arms in contracted position, squeeze seu(s) peito, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições of seu(s) training program.

name: Declinado Crucifixo com Haltereses
instructions: Secure seu(s) legs at end of decline banco e lie down com a halter(es) on each hand on top of seu(s) thighs. palms of seu(s) hand will be facing each other. Once you are laying down, move halter(es) in front of you at ombro(s) width. palms of hands should be facing each other e arms should be perpendicular to floor e fully extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com a slight bend on seu(s) cotovelo(s) in order to prevent stress at biceps tendon, lower seu(s) arms out at both sides in a wide arc até you feel a stretch on seu(s) peito. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout movement, arms should remain stationary; movement should only occur at ombro(s) joint. Return seu(s) arms costas até a posição inicial as you squeeze seu(s) peito muscles e breathe out. Tip: Make sure to use same arc of motion used to Abaixe a cargas. Hold for a second at contracted position e repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Declinado Halter Triceps Extensão
instructions: Secure seu(s) legs at end of decline banco e lie down com a halter(es) on each hand on top of seu(s) thighs. palms of seu(s) hand will be facing each other. Once you are laying down, move halter(es) in front of you at ombro(s) width. palms of hands should be facing each other e arms should be perpendicular to floor e fully extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in e you keep upper arms stationary (e cotovelo(s) in), bring halter(es) down slowly by moving seu(s) forearms in a semicircular motion towards you até seu(s) thumbs are next to seu(s) ears. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Lift halter(es) costas até a posição inicial by contracting triceps e exhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Declinado Ez Bar Triceps Extensão
instructions: Secure seu(s) legs at end of decline banco e slowly lay down on banco. Using a close grip (a grip that is slightly less than ombro(s) width), lift EZ bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked e cotovelo(s) in. arms should be perpendicular to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: In order to protect seu(s) rotator cuff, it is best if you have a spotter help you lift barra off rack. As you breathe in e you keep upper arms stationary, bring bar down slowly by moving seu(s) forearms in a semicircular motion towards you até you feel bar slightly touch seu(s) forehead. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Lift bar costas até a posição inicial by contracting triceps e exhaling. Repeat até recommended amount of repetições is performed.

name: Declinado Oblique Abdominal Crunch
instructions: Secure seu(s) legs at end of decline banco e slowly lay down on banco. Raise seu(s) upper body off banco até seu(s) torso is about 35-45 degrees if measured de floor. Put one hand beside seu(s) head e other on seu(s) thigh. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) upper body slowly de posição inicial enquanto turning seu(s) torso to left. Continue crunching up as you Expire até seu(s) right cotovelo(s) touches seu(s) left joelho(s). Hold this contracted position for a second. Tip: Focus on mantendo seu(s) abs tight e mantendo movement slow e controlled. Lower seu(s) body costas down slowly até a posição inicial as you Inspire. After completing one set on right for recommended amount of repetições, switch to seu(s) left side. Tip: Focus on really twisting seu(s) torso e feeling contraction when you are in up position.

name: Declinado Flexão de Braço
instructions: Lie on floor face down e place seu(s) hands about 36 inches apart enquanto holding seu(s) torso up at arms length. Move seu(s) feet up to a box or banco. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Next, lower yourself downward até seu(s) peito almost touches floor as you Inspire. Now breathe out e press seu(s) upper body costas up até a posição inicial enquanto squeezing seu(s) peito. After a brief pause at top contracted position, you can begin to lower yourself downward again for as many repetições as needed.

name: Declinado Invertido Abdominal Crunch
instructions: Deite-se de costas on a decline banco e hold on to top of banco com both hands. Don't let seu(s) body slip down de this position. Hold seu(s) legs parallel to floor using seu(s) abs to hold them there enquanto mantendo seu(s) joelho(s) e feet together. Tip: seu(s) legs should be fully extended com a slight bend on joelho(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto exhaling, move seu(s) legs towards torso as you roll seu(s) pelvis backwards e you raise seu(s) quadril off banco. At end of this movement seu(s) joelho(s) will be touching seu(s) peito. Hold contraction for a second e move seu(s) legs costas até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Declinado Smith Press
instructions: Place a decline banco underneath Smith máquina. Now place barra at a height that you can reach when lying down e seu(s) arms are almost fully extended. Using a pronated grip that is wider than ombro(s) width, unlock bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Inspire, lower bar under control by allowing cotovelo(s) to flex, lightly contacting torso. After a brief pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s), exhaling as you do so. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When set is complete, lock bar costas in rack.

name: Deficit Levantamento Terra
instructions: Begin by having a platform or weight plates that you can stand on, usually 1-3 inches in height. Approach bar so that it is centered over seu(s) feet. You feet should be about quadril width apart. Bend at quadril to grip bar at ombro(s) width, allowing seu(s) ombro(s) blades to protract. Typically, you would use an overhand grip or an over/under grip on heavier sets. com seu(s) feet, e seu(s) grip set, take a big breath e então lower seu(s) quadril e bend joelho(s) até seu(s) shins contact bar. Look forward com seu(s) head, keep seu(s) peito up e seu(s) costas arched, e begin driving through heels to move weight upward. After bar passes joelho(s), aggressively pull bar costas, pulling seu(s) ombro(s) blades together as you drive seu(s) quadril forward em bar. Lower bar by bending at quadril e guiding it to floor.

name: Depth Jump Leap
instructions: For this drill you will need two boxes or benches, one 12 to 16 inches high e other 22 to 26 inches high. Stand on one of two boxes com arms at sides; feet should be together e slightly off edge as in depth jump. Place other box approximately two or three feet in front of e facing performer. Begin by dropping off initial box, landing e simultaneously taking off com both feet. Rebound by driving upward e outward as intensely as possible, using arms e full extension of body to jump onto higher box. Again, allow legs to absorb impact.

name: Paralelas Máquina
instructions: Sit securely in a dip máquina, select weight e firmly segure a barra/pegadas. Now keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) in at seu(s) sides in order to place emphasis on triceps. cotovelo(s) should be bent at a 90 degree angle. As you contract triceps, extend seu(s) arms downwards as you Expire. Tip: At bottom of movement, focus on mantendo a little bend in seu(s) arms to keep tension on triceps muscle. Now slowly let seu(s) arms come costas up até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Dips - Chest Version
instructions: For this exercise you will need access to parallel bars. To get yourself inaté a posição inicial, hold seu(s) body at arms length (arms locked) above bars. enquanto breathing in, lower yourself slowly com seu(s) torso leaning forward around 30 degrees or so e seu(s) cotovelo(s) flared out slightly até you feel a slight stretch in peito. Once you feel stretch, use seu(s) peito to bring seu(s) body costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out. Tip: Remember to squeeze peito at top of movement for a second. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Dips - Triceps Version
instructions: To get inaté a posição inicial, hold seu(s) body at arm's length com seu(s) arms nearly locked above bars. Now, Inspire e Abaixe lentamente yourself downward. seu(s) torso should remain upright e seu(s) cotovelo(s) should stay close to seu(s) body. This helps to better focus on tricep involvement. Lower yourself até there is a 90 degree angle formed between upper arm e forearm. então, Expire e push seu(s) torso costas up using seu(s) triceps to bring seu(s) body costas até a posição inicial. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Donkey Elevação de Panturrilhas
instructions: For this exercise you will need access to a donkey calf raise máquina. Start by positioning seu(s) lower costas e quadril under padded lever provided. tailbone area should be one making contact com pad. Place both of seu(s) arms on side pegadas e place balls of seu(s) feet on calf block com heels extending off. Align toes forward, inward or outward, depending on area you wish to target, e straighten joelho(s) without locking them. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) heels as you breathe out by extending seu(s) ankles as high as possible e flexing seu(s) calf. Ensure that joelho(s) is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold contracted position by a second before you start to go costas down. Go costas slowly até a posição inicial as you breathe in by lowering seu(s) heels as you bend ankles até calves are stretched. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Double Kettlebell Alternado Hang Clean
instructions: Place two kettlebells between seu(s) feet. To get in posição inicial, push seu(s) butt costas e look straight ahead. Clean one kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) e hold on to other kettlebell. com a fluid motion, lower top kettlebell enquanto driving bottom kettlebell up.

name: Double Kettlebell Jerk
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by pegadas in each hand. Clean kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebells towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrists as you do so, so that palms face forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Dip seu(s) body by bending joelho(s), mantendo seu(s) torso upright. Immediately reverse direction, driving through heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press kettlebells overhead to lockout by extending arms, using seu(s) body's momentum to move weights. Return seu(s) feet to ground in a split fashion, com one foot forward e one foot costas. mantendo weights overhead, return to a standing position, bringing seu(s) feet together. Abaixe a cargas to perform next repetições.

name: Double Kettlebell Push Press
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s). Squat down a few inches e reverse motion rapidly. Use momentum de legs to drive kettlebells overhead. Once kettlebells are locked out, lower kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s) e repeat.

name: Double Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Place two kettlebells behind seu(s) feet. Flexione os joelhos e sit costas to pick up kettlebells. Swing kettlebells between seu(s) legs forcefully e reverse direction. Drive through com seu(s) quadril e lock ketttlebells overhead in one uninterrupted motion.

name: Double Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Place a kettlebell in front of seu(s) front foot e clean e press a kettlebell overhead com seu(s) opposite arm. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so, so that palm faces forward. mantendo kettlebell locked out at all times, push seu(s) butt out in direction of locked out kettlebell. Turn seu(s) feet out at a forty-five degree angle de arm com locked out kettlebell. Bending at quadril to one side, sticking seu(s) butt out, slowly lean até you can retrieve kettlebell de floor. Keep seu(s) eyes on kettlebell that you hold over seu(s) head at all times. Pause for a second after retrieving kettlebell de ground e reverse motion costas até a posição inicial.

name: Double Leg Butt Kick
instructions: Begin standing com seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent. Quickly squat a short distance, flexing quadril e joelho(s), e immediately extend to jump for maximum vertical height. As you go up, tuck seu(s) heels by flexing joelho(s), attempting to touch buttocks. Finish motion by landing com joelho(s) only partially bent, using seu(s) legs to absorb impact.

name: Downward Facing Balance
instructions: Lie facedown on top of an exercise ball. enquanto resting on seu(s) stomach on ball, walk seu(s) hands forward along floor e lift seu(s) legs, extending seu(s) cotovelo(s) e joelho(s).

name: Drag Rosca
instructions: Grab a barra com a supinated grip (palmas na direção indicada) e get seu(s) cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) torso e costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, curl bar up enquanto mantendo cotovelo(s) to costas as you "Drag" bar up by mantendo it in contact com seu(s) torso. Tip: As you can see, you will not be mantendo cotovelo(s) pinned to seu(s) sides, but instead you will be bringing them costas. Also, do not lift seu(s) ombro(s). Slowly go costas até a posição inicial as you keep bar in contact com torso at all times. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Drop Push
instructions: Position low boxes or other platforms 2-3 feet apart. Move to a pushup position between them, supporting yourself by placing seu(s) hands on boxes. com good posture, drop de platforms by pressing up e moving seu(s) hands to ombro(s) width, cushioning seu(s) landing by absorbing impact through arm.

name: Halter Alternate Bicep Rosca
instructions: Stand (torso upright) com a halter(es) in each hand held at arms length. cotovelo(s) should be close to torso e palms of seu(s) hand should be facing seu(s) thighs. enquanto holding upper arm stationary, curl right weight as you rotate palm of hands até they are facing forward. At this point continue contracting biceps as you breathe out até seu(s) biceps is fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a second as you squeeze biceps. Tip: Only forearms should move. Slowly begin to bring halter(es) costas até a posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Tip: Remember to twist palms costas até a posição inicial (facing seu(s) thighs) as you come down. Repeat movement com left hand. This equals one repetições. Continue alternating in this manner for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Supino com Halteres
instructions: Lie down on a flat banco com a halter(es) in each hand resting on top of seu(s) thighs. palms of seu(s) hands will be facing each other. então, using seu(s) thighs to help Eleve a carga up, lift halter(es) one at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at ombro(s) width. Once at ombro(s) width, rotate seu(s) wrists forward so that palms of seu(s) hands are facing away de you. halter(es) should be just to sides of seu(s) peito, com seu(s) upper arm e forearm creating a 90 degree angle. Be sure to maintain full control of halter(es) at all times. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. então, as you breathe out, use seu(s) peito to push halter(es) up. Lock seu(s) arms at top of lift e squeeze seu(s) peito, hold for a second e então begin coming down slowly. Tip: Ideally, lowering weight should take about twice as long as raising it. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições of seu(s) training program.

name: Supino com Halteres com Pegada Neutra
instructions: Take a halter(es) in each hand e lay costas onto a flat banco. seu(s) feet should be flat on floor e seu(s) ombro(s) blades retracted. Maintaining a neutral grip, palmas na direção indicada, begin com seu(s) arms extended directly above you, perpendicular to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin movement by flexing cotovelo(s), lowering upper arms to side. Descend até halter(es) are to seu(s) torso. Pause, então extend cotovelo(s) e Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Halter Bicep Rosca
instructions: Fique em pé ereto com a halter(es) in each hand at arm's length. Keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) torso e rotate palms of seu(s) hands até they are facing forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now, mantendo upper arms stationary, Expire e curl weights enquanto contracting seu(s) biceps. Continue to Eleve a cargas até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) level. Segure a posição por alguns segundos as you contraia a musculatura alvo. então, Inspire e slowly begin to Abaixe a carga costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Halter Clean
instructions: Begin standing com a halter(es) in each hand com seu(s) feet ombro(s) width apart. Abaixe a cargas to floor by flexing at quadril e joelho(s), pushing seu(s) quadril costas até halter(es) reach floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. To initiate movement, violently jump upward by extending quadril, joelho(s), e ankles to acclerate weights upward. Maintaining a neutral grip on halter(es), keep arms straight até full extension is reached. After full extension, rebend quadril e joelho(s) to receive weight in a squat position. Allow arms to bend, guiding halter(es) to seu(s) ombro(s). Upon receiving weight in squat position, extend quadril e joelho(s) to finish in a standing position com weights on seu(s) ombro(s).

name: Halter Floor Press
instructions: Lay on floor holding halter(es) in seu(s) hands. seu(s) joelho(s) can be bent. Begin com weights fully extended above you. Abaixe a cargas até seu(s) upper arm comes in contact com floor. You can tuck seu(s) cotovelo(s) to emphasize triceps size e strength, or to focus on seu(s) peito angle seu(s) arms to side. Pause at bottom, e então bring weight together at top by extending through cotovelo(s).

name: Crucifixo com Haltereses
instructions: Lie down on a flat banco com a halter(es) on each hand resting on top of seu(s) thighs. palms of seu(s) hand will be facing each other. então using seu(s) thighs to help Eleve a carga, lift halter(es) one at a time so you can hold them in front of you at ombro(s) width com palms of seu(s) hands facing each other. Eleve a carga up like you're pressing them, but stop e hold just before you lock out. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com a slight bend on seu(s) cotovelo(s) in order to prevent stress at biceps tendon, lower seu(s) arms out at both sides in a wide arc até you feel a stretch on seu(s) peito. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout movement, arms should remain stationary; movement should only occur at ombro(s) joint. Return seu(s) arms costas até a posição inicial as you squeeze seu(s) peito muscles e breathe out. Tip: Make sure to use same arc of motion used to Abaixe a cargas. Hold for a second at contracted position e repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Halter Inclinado Remada
instructions: Using a neutral grip, lean em an incline banco. Take a halter(es) in each hand com a neutral grip, beginning com arms straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Retract ombro(s) blades e flex cotovelo(s) to row halter(es) to seu(s) side. Pause at top of motion, e então Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Halter Inclinado Shoulder Elevação
instructions: Sit on an Incline banco enquanto holding a halter(es) on each hand on top of seu(s) thighs. Lift seu(s) legs up to kick weights to seu(s) ombro(s) e lean costas. Position halter(es) above seu(s) ombro(s) com seu(s) arms extended. arms should be perpendicular to floor com seu(s) palmas na direção indicada e knuckles pointing towards ceiling. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo arms straight e locked, lift halter(es) by raising ombro(s) de banco as you breathe out. Bring costas halter(es) até a posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Halter Afundo
instructions: Stand com seu(s) torso upright holding two halter(es) in seu(s) hands by seu(s) sides. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Step forward com seu(s) right leg around 2 feet or so de foot being left stationary behind e lower seu(s) upper body down, enquanto mantendo torso upright e maintaining balance. Inspire as you go down. Note: As in other exercises, do not allow seu(s) joelho(s) to go forward beyond seu(s) toes as you come down, as this will put undue stress on joelho(s) joint. Make sure that you keep seu(s) front shin perpendicular to ground. Using mainly heel of seu(s) foot, push up e go costas até a posição inicial as you Expire. Repeat movement for recommended amount of repetições e então perform com left leg.

name: Halter Deitado One-arm Rear Elevação Lateral
instructions: Enquanto holding a halter(es) in one hand, lay com seu(s) peito down on a slightly inclined (around 15 degrees when measured de floor) adjustable banco. other hand can be used to hold to leg of banco for stability. Position palm of hand that is holding halter(es) in a neutral manner (palms facing seu(s) torso) as you keep arm extended com cotovelo(s) slightly bent. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now raise arm com halter(es) to side até seu(s) cotovelo(s) is at ombro(s) height e seu(s) arm is roughly parallel to floor as you Expire. Tip: Maintain seu(s) arm perpendicular to torso enquanto mantendo seu(s) arm extended throughout movement. Also, keep contraction at top for a second. Slowly Abaixe a carga até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Halter Deitado Pronation
instructions: Lie on a flat banco face down com one arm holding a halter(es) e other hand on top of banco folded so that you can rest seu(s) head on it. Bend cotovelo(s) of arm holding halter(es) so that it creates a 90-degree angle between upper arm e forearm. Now raise upper arm so that forearm is perpendicular to floor e upper arm is perpendicular to seu(s) torso. Tip: upper arm should be parallel to floor e also creating a 90-degree angle com seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, externally rotate seu(s) forearm so that halter(es) is lifted forward as you maintain 90 degree angle bend between upper arms e forearm. You will continue this external rotation até forearm is parallel to floor. At this point you will hold contraction for a second. As you breathe in, slowly go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Halter Deitado Rear Elevação Lateral
instructions: Enquanto holding a halter(es) in each hand, lay com seu(s) peito down on a slightly inclined (around 15 degrees when measured de floor) adjustable banco. Position palms of hands in a neutral manner (palms facing seu(s) torso) as you keep arms extended com cotovelo(s) slightly bent. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now raise arms to side até seu(s) cotovelo(s) are at ombro(s) height e seu(s) arms are roughly parallel to floor as you Expire. Tip: Maintain seu(s) arms perpendicular to torso enquanto mantendo them extended throughout movement. Also, keep contraction at top for a second. Slowly Abaixe a carga até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então switch to other arm.

name: Halter Deitado Supination
instructions: Lie sideways on a flat banco com one arm holding a halter(es) e other hand on top of banco folded so that you can rest seu(s) head on it. Bend cotovelo(s) of arm holding halter(es) so that it creates a 90-degree angle between upper arm e forearm. Now raise upper arm so that forearm is parallel to floor e perpendicular to seu(s) torso (Tip: So forearm will be directly in front of you). upper arm will be stationary by seu(s) torso e should be parallel to floor (aligned com seu(s) torso at all times). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, externally rotate seu(s) forearm so that halter(es) is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain 90 degree angle bend between upper arms e forearm. You will continue this external rotation até forearm is perpendicular to floor e torso pointing towards ceiling. At this point you will hold contraction for a second. As you breathe in, slowly go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então switch to other arm.

name: Halter One-arm Desenvolvimento
instructions: Grab a halter(es) e either sit on a military press banco or a utility banco that has a costas support on it as you place halter(es) upright on top of seu(s) thighs or Fique em pé ereto. Clean halter(es) up to bring it to ombro(s) height. other hand can be kept fully extended to side, by waist or grabbing a fixed surface. Rotate wrist so that palm of seu(s) hand is facing forward. This is seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, push halter(es) up até seu(s) arm is fully extended. After a second pause, slowly come down costas até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então switch arms.

name: Halter One-arm Triceps Extensão
instructions: Grab a halter(es) e either sit on a military press banco or a utility banco that has a costas support on it as you place halter(es) upright on top of seu(s) thighs or Fique em pé ereto. Clean halter(es) up to bring it to ombro(s) height e então extend arm over seu(s) head so that whole arm is perpendicular to floor e next to seu(s) head. halter(es) should be on top of you. other hand can be kept fully extended to side, by waist, supporting upper arm that has halter(es) or grabbing a fixed surface. Rotate wrist so that palm of seu(s) hand is facing forward e pinkie is facing ceiling. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Slowly Abaixe a carga behind seu(s) head as you hold upper arm stationary. Inspire as you perform this movement e pause when seu(s) triceps are fully stretched. Retorne à posição inicial by flexing seu(s) triceps as you breathe out. Tip: It is imperative that only forearm moves. upper arm should remain at all times stationary next to seu(s) head. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e switch arms.

name: Halter One-arm Upright Remada
instructions: Grab a halter(es) e Fique em pé ereto com seu(s) arm extended in front of you com a slight bend at cotovelo(s) e seu(s) costas straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: halter(es) should be resting on top of seu(s) thigh com palm of seu(s) hands facing seu(s) thighs. Keep other hand can be kept fully extended to side, by waist or grabbing a fixed surface. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Use seu(s) side ombro(s) to lift halter(es) as you Expire. halter(es) should be close to body as you move it up. Continue to lift it até halter(es) is nearly in line com seu(s) chin. Tip: seu(s) cotovelo(s) should drive motion. As you lift halter(es), seu(s) cotovelo(s) should always be higher than seu(s) forearm. Also, keep seu(s) torso stationary e pause for a second at top of movement. Abaixe a carga costas down slowly até a posição inicial. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e switch arms.

name: Halter de Bruços Inclinado Rosca
instructions: Grab a halter(es) on each hand e Deite-se de bruços on an incline banco com seu(s) ombro(s) near top of incline. seu(s) joelho(s) can rest on seat or seu(s) legs can be straddled to sides (my preferred way). Let seu(s) arms extend e hang naturally in front of you so that they are perpendicular to floor. Now keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) in by seu(s) side e face palms forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Eleve a carga by contracting biceps até seu(s) arms are fully flexed. Expire as you perform this portion of movement e ensure that only forearms move. upper arms should remain stationary at all times. Abaixe a carga até seu(s) arms are fully extended. Repeat for recommended amount of times.

name: Halter Elevação
instructions: Grab a halter(es) in each arm e Fique em pé ereto com seu(s) arms extended by seu(s) sides com a slight bend at cotovelo(s) e seu(s) costas straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: halter(es) should be next to seu(s) thighs com palm of seu(s) hands facing costas. Use seu(s) side ombro(s) to lift halter(es) as you Expire. halter(es) should be to side of body as you move them up. Continue to lift it até halter(es) are nearly in line com seu(s) chin. Tip: seu(s) cotovelo(s) should drive motion. As you lift halter(es), seu(s) cotovelo(s) should always be higher than seu(s) forearm. Also, keep seu(s) torso stationary e pause for a second at top of movement. Abaixe a carga costas down slowly até a posição inicial. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Halter Rear Afundo
instructions: Stand com seu(s) torso upright holding two halter(es) in seu(s) hands by seu(s) sides. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Step backward com seu(s) right leg around two feet or so de left foot e lower seu(s) upper body down, enquanto mantendo torso upright e maintaining balance. Inspire as you go down. Tip: As in other exercises, do not allow seu(s) joelho(s) to go forward beyond seu(s) toes as you come down, as this will put undue stress on joelho(s) joint. Make sure that you keep seu(s) front shin perpendicular to ground. Keep torso upright during lunge; flexible quadril flexors are important. A long lunge emphasizes Gluteus Maximus; a short lunge emphasizes Quadriceps. Push up e go costas até a posição inicial as you Expire. Tip: Use ball of seu(s) feet to push in order to accentuate quadriceps. To focus on glúteo(s), press com seu(s) heels. Now repeat com opposite leg.

name: Halter Scaption
instructions: This corrective exercise strengthens muscles that stabilize seu(s) ombro(s) blade. Hold a light weight in each hand, hanging at seu(s) sides. seu(s) thumbs should pointing up. Begin movement raising seu(s) arms out in front of you, about 30 degrees off center. seu(s) arms should be fully extended as you perform movement. Continue até seu(s) arms are parallel to ground, e então Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Halter Sentado Box Jump
instructions: Position a box a couple feet to side of a banco. Hold a halter(es) to seu(s) peito com both hands e seat yourself on banco facing box. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Plant seu(s) feet firmly on ground as you lean forward, extending through quadril e joelho(s) to jump up e forward. Land on box com both feet, absorbing impact by allowing quadril e joelho(s) to bend. Step down e Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Halter Sentado One-leg Elevação de Panturrilha
instructions: Place a block on floor about 12 inches de a flat banco. Sit on a flat banco e place a halter(es) on seu(s) upper left thigh about 3 inches above seu(s) joelho(s). Now place ball of seu(s) left foot on block. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) toes up as high as possible as you Expire e you contract seu(s) calf muscle. Hold contraction for a second. Slowly Retorne à posição inicial, stretching as far down as possible. Repeat for seu(s) prescribed number of repetições e então repeat com right leg.

name: Halter Desenvolvimento
instructions: Enquanto holding a halter(es) in each hand, sit on a military press banco or utility banco that has costas support. Place halter(es) upright on top of seu(s) thighs. Now Eleve a carga to ombro(s) height one at a time using seu(s) thighs to help propel them up em position. Make sure to rotate seu(s) wrists so that palms of seu(s) hands are facing forward. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Now, Expire e push halter(es) upward até they touch at top. então, after a brief pause at top contracted position, slowly Abaixe a cargas costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Halter Encolhimento
instructions: Stand erect com a halter(es) on each hand (palms facing seu(s) torso), arms extended on sides. Lift halter(es) by elevating ombro(s) as high as possible enquanto you Expire. Hold contraction at top for a second. Tip: arms should remain extended at all times. Refrain de using biceps to help lift halter(es). Only ombro(s) should be moving up e down. Abaixe a carga costas to original position. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Halter Side Bend
instructions: Fique em pé ereto enquanto holding a halter(es) on left hand (palms facing torso) as you have right hand holding seu(s) waist. seu(s) feet should be placed at ombro(s) width. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo seu(s) costas straight e seu(s) head up, bend only at waist to right o máximo possível. Breathe in as you bend to side. então hold for a second e come costas up até a posição inicial as you Expire. Tip: Keep rest of body stationary. Now repeat movement but bending to left instead. Hold for a second e come costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então change hands.

name: Halter Agachamento
instructions: Fique em pé ereto enquanto holding a halter(es) on each hand (palms facing side of seu(s) legs). Position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s) width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance e also maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances discussed in foot stances section. Begin to Abaixe lentamente seu(s) torso by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até seu(s) thighs are parallel to floor. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise seu(s) torso as you Expire by pushing floor com heel of seu(s) foot mainly as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Halter Agachamento To Bench
instructions: Fique em pé ereto com a flat banco behind you enquanto holding a halter(es) on each hand (palms facing side of seu(s) legs). Position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s) width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance e also maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances discussed in foot stances section. Begin to Abaixe lentamente seu(s) torso by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até you slightly touch banco behind you. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor com heel of seu(s) foot mainly as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Halter Step Ups
instructions: Fique em pé ereto enquanto holding a halter(es) on each hand (palms facing side of seu(s) legs). Place right foot on elevated platform. Step on platform by extending quadril e joelho(s) of seu(s) right leg. Use heel mainly to lift rest of seu(s) body up e place foot of left leg on platform as well. Breathe out as you execute force required to come up. Step down com left leg by flexing quadril e joelho(s) of right leg as you Inspire. Return to original standing position by placing right foot of to next to left foot on initial position. Repeat com right leg for recommended amount of repetições e então perform com left leg.

name: Halter Tricep Extensão -pronated Grip
instructions: Lie down on a flat banco holding two halter(es) directly above seu(s) ombro(s). seu(s) arms should be fully extended e form a 90 degree angle de seu(s) torso e floor. palms of seu(s) hands should be facing forward, e seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be tucked in. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now, Inspire e slowly Abaixe a carga até they are near seu(s) ears. Be sure to keep seu(s) upper arms stationary e seu(s) cotovelo(s) tucked in. então, Expire e use seu(s) triceps to return weight até a posição inicial.

name: Dynamic Back Alongamento
instructions: Fique em pé com os pés ombro(s) width apart. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) arms straight, swing them straight up in front of you 5-10 times, increasing range of motion each time até seu(s) arms are above seu(s) head.

name: Dynamic Chest Alongamento
instructions: Stand com seu(s) hands together, arms extended directly in front of you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) arms straight, quickly move seu(s) arms costas o máximo possível e costas in again, similar to an exaggerated clapping motion. Repeat 5-10 times, increasing speed as you do so.

name: Ez-bar Rosca
instructions: Fique em pé ereto enquanto holding an EZ curl bar at wide outer pegadas. palms of seu(s) hands should be facing forward e slightly tilted inward due to shape of bar. Keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now, enquanto mantendo seu(s) upper arms stationary, Expire e curl weights forward enquanto contracting biceps. Focus on only moving seu(s) forearms. Continue to Eleve a carga até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e bar is at ombro(s) level. Hold top contracted position for a moment e squeeze biceps. então Inspire e Abaixe lentamente bar costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Ez-bar Skullcrusher
instructions: Using a close grip, lift EZ bar e hold it com seu(s) cotovelo(s) in as you Deite-se em um banco. seu(s) arms should be perpendicular to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo upper arms stationary, lower bar by allowing cotovelo(s) to flex. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Pause once bar is directly above forehead. Lift bar costas até a posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s) e exhaling. Repeat.

name: Elbow Circles
instructions: Sit or Fique em pé com os pés slightly apart. Place seu(s) hands on seu(s) ombro(s) com seu(s) cotovelo(s) at ombro(s) level e pointing out. Slowly make a circle com seu(s) cotovelo(s). Breathe out as you start circle e breathe in as you complete circle.

name: Elbow To Knee
instructions: Lie on floor, crossing seu(s) right leg across seu(s) bent left joelho(s). Clasp seu(s) hands behind seu(s) head, beginning com seu(s) ombro(s) blades on ground. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Perform motion by flexing spine e rotating seu(s) torso to bring left cotovelo(s) to right joelho(s). Retorne à posição inicial e repeat movement for número desejado de repetições before switching sides.

name: Elbows Back
instructions: Fique em pé ereto. Place both hands on seu(s) lower costas, fingers pointing downward e cotovelo(s) out. então gently pull seu(s) cotovelo(s) costas aiming to touch them together.

name: Elevated Back Afundo
instructions: Position a bar onto a rack at ombro(s) height loaded to an appropriate weight. Place a short, raised platform behind you. Rack bar onto seu(s) upper costas, mantendo seu(s) costas arched e tight. Step onto seu(s) raised platform com both feet. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by stepping backwards com one leg. Descend by flexing seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) até seu(s) joelho(s) touches floor. Pause, e extend through quadril e joelho(s) to rise up, returning all way até a posição inicial before alternating.

name: Elevated Cabo Rows
instructions: Get a platform of some sort (it can be an aerobics or calf raise platform) that is around 4-6 inches in height. Place it on seat of cabo row máquina. Sente-se on máquina e place seu(s) feet on front platform or crossbar provided making sure that seu(s) joelho(s) are slightly bent e not locked. Lean over as you keep natural alignment of seu(s) costas e grab V-bar pegadas. com seu(s) arms extended pull costas até seu(s) torso is at a 90-degree angle de seu(s) legs. seu(s) costas should be slightly arched e seu(s) peito should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on seu(s) lats as you hold bar in front of you. This is posição inicial of exercise. mantendo torso stationary, pull pegadas costas towards seu(s) torso enquanto mantendo arms close to it até you touch abdominals. Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing seu(s) costas muscles hard. Hold that contraction for a second e slowly go costas to original position enquanto breathing in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: To begin, step onto elliptical e select desired option de menu. Most ellipticals have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter seu(s) age e weight to estimate amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change intensity of workout. pegadas can be used to monitor seu(s) heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

name: Exercise Ball Abdominal Crunch
instructions: Lie on an exercise ball com seu(s) lower costas curvature pressed against spherical surface of ball. seu(s) feet should be bent at joelho(s) e pressed firmly against floor. upper torso should be hanging off top of ball. arms should either be kept alongside body or crossed on top of seu(s) peito as these positions avoid neck strains (as opposed to hands behind costas of head position). Lower seu(s) torso em a stretch position mantendo neck stationary at all times. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com quadril stationary, flex waist by contracting abdominals e curl ombro(s) e trunk upward até you feel a nice contraction on seu(s) abdominals. arms should simply slide up side of seu(s) legs if you have them at side or just stay on top of seu(s) peito if you have them crossed. lower costas should always stay in contact com ball. Expire as you perform this movement e hold contraction for a second. As you Inspire, go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Exercise Ball Pull-in
instructions: Place an exercise ball nearby e lay on floor in front of it com seu(s) hands on floor ombro(s) width apart in a push-up position. Now place seu(s) lower shins on top of an exercise ball. Tip: At this point seu(s) legs should be fully extended com shins on top of ball e upper body should be in a push-up type of position being supported by seu(s) two extended arms in front of you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo seu(s) costas completely straight e upper body stationary, pull seu(s) joelho(s) in towards seu(s) peito as you Expire, allowing ball to roll forward under seu(s) ankles. contraia a musculatura alvo e hold that position for a second. Now slowly straighten seu(s) legs, rolling ball costas até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Extended Range One-arm Kettlebell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor e position a kettlebell for one arm to press. kettlebell should be held by pegadas. leg on same side that you are pressing should be bent, com joelho(s) crossing over midline of body. Press kettlebell by extending cotovelo(s) e adducting arm, pressing it above seu(s) body. Retorne à posição inicial.

name: External Rotation
instructions: Lie sideways on a flat banco com one arm holding a halter(es) e other hand on top of banco folded so that you can rest seu(s) head on it. Bend cotovelo(s) of arm holding halter(es) so that it creates a 90-degree angle between upper arm e forearm. Tip: Keep arm parallel to seu(s) torso. Now bend cotovelo(s) enquanto mantendo upper arm stationary. In this manner, forearm will be parallel to floor e perpendicular to seu(s) torso (Tip: So forearm will be directly in front of you). upper arm will be stationary by seu(s) torso e should be parallel to floor (aligned com seu(s) torso at all times). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, externally rotate seu(s) forearm so that halter(es) is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain 90 degree angle bend between upper arms e forearm. You will continue this external rotation até forearm is perpendicular to floor e torso pointing towards ceiling. At this point you will hold contraction for a second. As you breathe in, slowly go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então switch to other arm.

name: External Rotation com Elástico
instructions: Choke band around a post. band should be at same height as seu(s) cotovelo(s). Stand com seu(s) left side to band a couple of feet away. Grasp end of band com seu(s) right hand, e keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) pressed firmly to seu(s) side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place com seu(s) cotovelo(s) to keep it firmly in position. com seu(s) upper arm in position, seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be flexed to 90 degrees com seu(s) hand reaching across front of seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Execute movement by rotating seu(s) arm in a backhand motion, mantendo seu(s) cotovelo(s) in place. Continue as far as you are able, pause, e então Retorne à posição inicial.

name: External Rotation com Cabo
instructions: Adjust cabo to same height as seu(s) cotovelo(s). Stand com seu(s) left side to band a couple of feet away. segure a barra/pegadas com seu(s) right hand, e keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) pressed firmly to seu(s) side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place com seu(s) cotovelo(s) to keep it firmly in position. com seu(s) upper arm in position, seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be flexed to 90 degrees com seu(s) hand reaching across front of seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Execute movement by rotating seu(s) arm in a backhand motion, mantendo seu(s) cotovelo(s) in place.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Facing a high pulley com a rope or dual pegadas attached, pull weight directly towards seu(s) face, separating seu(s) hands as you do so. Keep seu(s) upper arms parallel to ground.

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: There are various implements that can be used for farmers walk. These can also be performed com heavy halter(es) or short bars if these implements aren't available. Begin by standing between implements. After gripping pegadas, lift them up by driving through seu(s) heels, mantendo seu(s) costas straight e seu(s) head up. Walk taking short, quick steps, e don't forget to breathe. Move for a given distance, typically 50-100 feet, as fast as possible.

name: Fast Skipping
instructions: Start in a relaxed position com one leg slightly forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Skip by executing a step-hop pattern of right-right-step to left-left-step, e so on, alternating costas e forth. Perform fast skips by maintaining close contact com ground e reduce air time, moving as quickly as possible.

name: Finger Curls
instructions: Hold a barra com both hands e seu(s) palmas na direção indicada; hands spaced about ombro(s) width. Place seu(s) pés firmes no chão, at a distance that is slightly wider than ombro(s) width apart. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower bar o máximo possível by extending fingers. Allowing bar to roll down hands, catch bar com final joint in fingers. Now curl bar up as high as possible by closing seu(s) hands enquanto exhaling. Hold contraction at top.

name: Reto Bench Cabo Crucifixo
instructions: Position a flat banco between two low pulleys so that when you are laying on it, seu(s) peito will be lined up com cabo pulleys. Lay flat on banco e keep seu(s) feet on ground. Have someone hand you pegadas on each hand. You will grab each single pegadas attachment com a palms up grip. Extend seu(s) arms by seu(s) side com a slight bend on seu(s) cotovelo(s). Tip: You will keep this bend constant through whole movement. seu(s) arms should be parallel to floor. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Now start lifting arms in a semi-circle motion directly in front of you by pulling cables together até both hands meet at top of movement. Squeeze seu(s) peito as you perform this motion e breathe out during this movement. Also, hold contraction for a second at top. Tip: When performed correctly, at top position of this movement, seu(s) arms should be perpendicular to seu(s) torso e floor touching above seu(s) peito. Slowly come costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Reto Bench Leg Pull-in
instructions: Lie on an exercise mat or a flat banco com seu(s) legs off end. Place seu(s) hands either under seu(s) glúteo(s) com seu(s) palms down or by sides holding on to banco (or com palms down by side on an exercise mat). Also extend seu(s) legs straight out. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Flexione os joelhos e pull seu(s) upper thighs em seu(s) midsection as you breathe out. Continue this movement até seu(s) joelho(s) are near seu(s) peito. Hold contracted position for a second. As you breathe in, slowly Retorne à posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Reto Bench Deitado Leg Elevação
instructions: Lie com seu(s) costas flat on a banco e seu(s) legs extended in front of you off end. Place seu(s) hands either under seu(s) glúteo(s) com seu(s) palms down or by sides holding on to banco. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you keep seu(s) legs extended, straight as possible com seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent but locked raise seu(s) legs até they make a 90-degree angle com floor. Expire as you perform this portion of movement e hold contraction at top for a second. Now, as you Inspire, Abaixe lentamente seu(s) legs costas down até a posição inicial.

name: Flexor Inclinado Rosca Direta com Halteress
instructions: Hold halter(es) towards side farther de you so that you have more weight on side closest to you. (This can be done for a good effect on all bicep halter(es) exercises). Now do a normal incline halter(es) curl, but keep seu(s) wrists as far costas as possible so as to neutralize any stress that is placed on them. Sit on an incline banco that is angled at 45-degrees enquanto holding a halter(es) on each hand. Let seu(s) arms hang down on seu(s) sides, com cotovelo(s) in, e turn palms of seu(s) hands forward com thumbs pointing away de body. Tip: You will keep this hand position throughout movement as there should not be any twisting of hands as they come up. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Curl up two halter(es) at same time até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e Expire. Tip: Do not swing arms or use momentum. Keep a controlled motion at all times. Hold contracted position for a second at top. As you Inspire, slowly go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Floor Glute-ham Elevação
instructions: You can use a partner for this exercise or brace seu(s) feet under something stable. Begin on seu(s) joelho(s) com seu(s) upper legs e torso upright. If using a partner, they will firmly hold seu(s) feet to keep you in position. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower yourself by extending at joelho(s), taking care to NOT flex quadril as you go forward. Place seu(s) hands in front of you as you reach floor. This movement is very difficult e you may be unable to do it unaided. Use seu(s) arms to lightly push off floor to aid seu(s) Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Floor Press
instructions: Adjust j-hooks so they are at appropriate height to rack bar. Begin lying on floor com seu(s) head near end of a power rack. mantendo seu(s) ombro(s) blades pulled together; pull bar off of hooks. Lower bar towards bottom of seu(s) peito or upper stomach, squeezing bar e attempting to pull it apart as you do so. Ensure that you tuck seu(s) cotovelo(s) throughout movement. Lower bar até seu(s) upper arm contacts ground e pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of weight. Press bar costas up as fast as you can, mantendo bar, seu(s) wrists, e cotovelo(s) in line as you do so.

name: Floor Press com Chains
instructions: Adjust j-hooks so they are at appropriate height to rack bar. For this exercise, drape chains directly over end of bar, trying to keep ends away de plates. Begin lying on floor com seu(s) head near end of a power rack. mantendo seu(s) ombro(s) blades pulled together, pull bar off of hooks. Lower bar towards bottom of seu(s) peito or upper stomach, squeezing bar e attempting to pull it apart as you do so. Ensure that you tuck seu(s) cotovelo(s) throughout movement. Lower bar até seu(s) upper arm contacts ground e pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of weight. Press bar costas up as fast as you can, mantendo bar, seu(s) wrists, e cotovelo(s) in line as you do so.

name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: On a flat banco lie facedown com quadril on edge of banco, legs straight com toes high off floor e com arms on top of banco holding on to front edge. contraia a musculatura alvo e hamstrings e straighten legs até they are level com quadril. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Start movement by lifting left leg higher than right leg. então lower left leg as you lift right leg. Continue alternating in this manner (as though you are doing a flutter kick in water) até you have done recommended amount of repetições for each leg. Make sure that you keep a controlled movement at all times. Tip: You will breathe normally as you perform this movement.

name: Foot-smr
instructions: This exercise stretches fascia of muscles in feet. Start off seated com seu(s) shoes removed. Using a foot roller or a similar object, such as a small section of pvc pipe, place seu(s) foot against roller across arch of seu(s) foot. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Press down firmly, rolling across arch of seu(s) foot. Hold for 10-30 seconds, e então switch feet.

name: Forward Drag com Press
