instructions: Attach a dual handled chain or rope attachment to sled. You should be facing away de sled, holding a pegadas in each hand. Begin movement by moving forward for one step. Leaning forward, extend through legs e quadril to move, pausing com each step to extend through cotovelo(s), pressing seu(s) hands forward. Step forward até you return to start position prepared to press.

name: Frankenstein Agachamento
instructions: This drill teaches you proper positioning of both bar e seu(s) body during clean e front squat. Place barra on front of ombro(s), releasing seu(s) grip e extending seu(s) arms out in front of you. ombro(s) should be pushed forward to create a shelf, e bar should be in contact com throat. Ensure that you only move seu(s) ombro(s) blades forward; don't round thoracic spine. Squat by flexing joelho(s) e quadril, sitting in between seu(s) legs. Keep torso upright, arms up, e ombro(s) forward, e bar should stay in place. Go to bottom of squat, até seu(s) hamstrings contact seu(s) calves. Return to upright position by driving through front of heel e extending joelho(s) e quadril.

name: Freehand Jump Agachamento
instructions: Cross seu(s) arms over seu(s) peito. com seu(s) head up e seu(s) costas straight, position seu(s) feet at ombro(s) width. mantendo seu(s) costas straight e peito up, squat down as you Inspire até seu(s) upper thighs are parallel, or lower, to floor. Now pressing mainly com ball of seu(s) feet, jump straight up in air as high as possible, using thighs like springs. Expire during this portion of movement. When you touch floor again, immediately squat down e jump again. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Frog Hops
instructions: Stand com seu(s) hands behind seu(s) head, e squat down mantendo seu(s) torso upright e seu(s) head up. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Jump forward several feet, avoiding jumping unnecessarily high. As seu(s) feet contact ground, absorb impact through seu(s) legs, e jump again. Repeat this action 5-10 times.

name: Frog Abdominals
instructions: Lie com seu(s) costas flat on floor (or exercise mat) e seu(s) legs extended in front of you. Now bend at joelho(s) e place seu(s) outer thighs by floor (or mat) as you make soles of seu(s) feet touch each other. Now try pushing both soles e bringing them up as near you as possible enquanto you keep outer thighs on floor (or at least almost touching it). Tip: In this position seu(s) legs should create a diamond shape. Now, cross seu(s) arms in front of you by touching opposite ombro(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire flatten seu(s) lower costas to floor enquanto curling torso upwards. Tip: This will be like performing first 1/4 movement of a sit up. Hold at top position for a second. As you Inspire, Abaixe lentamente costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Front Barra Agachamento
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set bar on a rack that best matches seu(s) height. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, bring seu(s) arms up under bar enquanto mantendo cotovelo(s) high e upper arm slightly above parallel to floor. Rest bar on top of deltoids e cross seu(s) arms enquanto grasping bar for total control. Lift bar off rack by first pushing com seu(s) legs e at same time straightening seu(s) torso. Step away de rack e position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s) width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance e also maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. (Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances described in foot positioning section). Begin to Abaixe lentamente bar by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até angle between upper leg e calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is point in which upper legs are below parallel to floor). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor mainly com middle of seu(s) foot as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Front Barra Agachamento To Bench
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set a flat banco behind you e set bar on a rack that best matches seu(s) height. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, bring seu(s) arms up under bar enquanto mantendo cotovelo(s) high e upper arm slightly above parallel to floor. Rest bar on top of deltoids e cross seu(s) arms enquanto grasping bar for total control. Lift bar off rack by first pushing com seu(s) legs e at same time straightening seu(s) torso. Step away de rack e position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s) width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance e also maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. (Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances described in foot positioning section). Begin to Abaixe lentamente bar by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até you touch banco com seu(s) glúteo(s). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor mainly com heel of seu(s) foot as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Front Box Jump
instructions: Begin com a box of an appropriate height 1-2 feet in front of you. Fique em pé com os pés should width apart. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Perform a short squat in preparation for jumping, swinging seu(s) arms behind you. Rebound out of this position, extending through quadril, joelho(s), e ankles to jump as high as possible. Swing seu(s) arms forward e up. Land on box com joelho(s) bent, absorbing impact through legs. You can jump de box costas to ground, or preferably step down one leg at a time.

name: Front Cabo Elevação
instructions: Select weight on a low pulley máquina e grasp single hand cabo attachment that is attached to low pulley com seu(s) left hand. Face away de pulley e put seu(s) arm straight down com hand cabo attachment in front of seu(s) thighs at arms' length com palms of hand facing seu(s) thighs. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto maintaining torso stationary (no swinging), lift left arm to front com a slight bend on cotovelo(s) e palms of hand always faces down. Continue to go up até you arm is slightly above parallel to floor. Expire as you execute this portion of movement e pause for a second at top. Now as you Inspire lower arm costas down slowly até a posição inicial. Once all of recommended amount of repetições have been performed for this arm, switch arms e perform exercise com right one.

name: Front Cone Hops (or Hurdle Hops)
instructions: Set up a row of cones or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart. Stand in front of first cone com seu(s) feet ombro(s) width apart. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by jumping com both feet over first cone, swinging both arms as you jump. Absorb impact of landing by bending joelho(s), rebounding out of first leap by jumping over next cone. Continue até you have jumped over all of cones.

name: Front Halter Elevação
instructions: Pick a couple of halter(es) e stand com a straight torso e halter(es) on front of seu(s) thighs at arms length com palms of hand facing seu(s) thighs. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto maintaining torso stationary (no swinging), lift left halter(es) to front com a slight bend on cotovelo(s) e palms of hands always facing down. Continue to go up até you arm is slightly above parallel to floor. Expire as you execute this portion of movement e pause for a second at top. Inspire after second pause. Now Abaixe a carga costas down slowly até a posição inicial as you simultaneously lift right halter(es). Continue alternating in this fashion até all of recommended amount of repetições have been performed for each arm.

name: Front Inclinado Halter Elevação
instructions: Sente-se on an incline banco com incline set anywhere between 30 to 60 degrees enquanto holding a halter(es) on each hand. Tip: You can change angle to hit muscle a little differently each time. Extend seu(s) arms straight in front of you e have seu(s) palmas na direção indicada com halter(es) raised about 1 inch above seu(s) thighs. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Slowly Eleve a carga straight up até they are slightly above seu(s) ombro(s), enquanto mantendo seu(s) cotovelo(s) locked. Squeeze at top for a second e make sure you breathe out during this portion of movement. Tip: Keep seu(s) head resting down against banco e seu(s) legs on floor at all times. Lower arms costas até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Front Leg Raises
instructions: Stand next to a chair or other support, holding on com one hand. Swing seu(s) leg forward, mantendo leg straight. Continue com a downward swing, bringing leg as far costas as seu(s) flexibility allows. Repeat 5-10 times, e então switch legs.

name: Front Plate Elevação
instructions: Enquanto standing straight, hold a barra plate in both hands at 3 e 9 o'clock positions. seu(s) palms should be facing each other e seu(s) arms should be extended e locked com a slight bend at cotovelo(s) e plate should be down near seu(s) waist in front of you as far as you can go. Tip: arms will remain in this position throughout exercise. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Slowly raise plate as you Expire até it is a little above ombro(s) level. Hold contraction for a second. Tip: make sure that you do not swing weight or bend at cotovelo(s). seu(s) torso should remain stationary throughout movement as well. As you Inspire, Abaixe lentamente plate costas down até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Elevação Frontal e Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat banco enquanto holding a barra using a palms down grip that is about 15 inches apart. Place bar on seu(s) upper thighs, extend seu(s) arms e lock them enquanto mantendo a slight bend on cotovelo(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now Eleve a carga using a semicircular motion e mantendo seu(s) arms straight as you Inspire. Continue same movement até bar is on other side above seu(s) head . (Tip: bar will travel approximately 180-degrees). At this point seu(s) arms should be parallel to floor com palms of seu(s) hands facing ceiling. Now return barra até a posição inicial by reversing motion as you Expire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Agachamento Frontal (clean Grip)
instructions: To begin, first set bar in a rack slightly below ombro(s) level. Rest bar on top of deltoids, pushing em clavicles, e lightly touching throat. seu(s) hands should be in a clean grip, touching bar only com seu(s) fingers to help keep it in position. Lift bar off rack by first pushing com seu(s) legs e at same time straightening seu(s) torso. Step away de rack e position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s) width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head e cotovelo(s) up at all times. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Bend at joelho(s), sitting down between seu(s) legs. Continue down até seu(s) hamstrings are on seu(s) calves. Keep seu(s) joelho(s) aligned com seu(s) feet by consciously using seu(s) abductors to push seu(s) joelho(s) out as you squat. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor mainly com heel or middle of seu(s) foot as you straighten legs again e Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Agachamento Frontals com Two Kettlebells
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebells towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrists as you do so. Looking straight ahead at all times, squat as low as you can e pause at bottom. As you squat down, push seu(s) joelho(s) out. You should squat between seu(s) legs, mantendo an upright torso, com seu(s) head e peito up. Rise costas up by driving through seu(s) heels e repeat.

name: Front Two-halter Elevação
instructions: Pick a couple of halter(es) e stand com a straight torso e halter(es) on front of seu(s) thighs at arms length com palms of hand facing seu(s) thighs. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto maintaining torso stationary (no swinging), lift halter(es) to front com a slight bend on cotovelo(s) e palms of hands always facing down. Continue to go up até you arms are slightly above parallel to floor. Expire as you execute this portion of movement e pause for a second at top. As you Inspire, Abaixe a carga costas down slowly até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Full Range-de-motion Puxada Alta
instructions: Either standing or seated on a high banco, grasp two stirrup cables that are attached to high pulleys. Grab com opposing hand so seu(s) arms are crisscrossed about you e seu(s) palms are facing forward. mantendo seu(s) peito up e maintaining a slight arch in seu(s) lower costas, pull pegadas down as if you were doing a regular pulldown. range of motion will be more of an arc. During movement, rotate seu(s) hands so that in bottom position seu(s) palms face each other rather than forward. Return slowly até a posição inicial e repeat.

name: Gironda Sternum Chins
instructions: Grasp pull-up bar com a ombro(s) width underhand grip. Now hang com seu(s) arms fully extended e stick seu(s) peito out e lean costas. Tip: You will be leaning costas throughout entire movement. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Start pulling yourself towards bar com seu(s) spine arched throughout movement e seu(s) head leaning costas as far away de bar as possible. Expire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: At upper end of movement, seu(s) quadril e legs will be at about a 45-degree angle to floor. Keep pulling até seu(s) collarbone passes bar e seu(s) lower peito or sternum area touches it. Hold that contraction for a second. Tip: By time you've completed this portion of movement; seu(s) head will be parallel to floor. Slowly start going costas até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Glute Ham Elevação
instructions: Begin by adjusting equipment to fit seu(s) body. Place seu(s) feet against footplate in between rollers as you lie facedown. seu(s) joelho(s) should be just behind pad. Start de bottom of movement. Keep seu(s) costas arched as you begin movement by flexing joelho(s). Drive seu(s) toes em foot plate as you do so. Keep seu(s) upper body straight, e continue até seu(s) body is upright. Retorne à posição inicial, mantendo seu(s) descent under control.

name: Glute Kickback
instructions: Kneel on floor or an exercise mat e bend at waist com seu(s) arms extended in front of you (perpendicular to torso) in order to get em a kneeling push-up position but com arms spaced at ombro(s) width. seu(s) head should be looking forward e bend of joelho(s) should create a 90-degree angle between hamstrings e calves. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, lift up seu(s) right leg até hamstrings are in line com costas enquanto maintaining 90-degree angle bend. Contract glúteo(s) throughout this movement e hold contraction at top for a second. Tip: At end of movement upper leg should be parallel to floor enquanto calf should be perpendicular to it. Go costas to initial position as you Inspire e now repeat com left leg. Continue to alternate legs até all of recommended repetições have been performed.

name: Agachamento Goblet
instructions: Stand holding a light kettlebell by horns close to seu(s) peito. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Squat down between seu(s) legs até seu(s) hamstrings are on seu(s) calves. Keep seu(s) peito e head up e seu(s) costas straight. At bottom position, pause e use seu(s) cotovelo(s) to push seu(s) joelho(s) out. Retorne à posição inicial, e repeat for 10-20 repetições.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Begin com a bar on a rack at ombro(s) height. Rack bar across rear of seu(s) ombro(s) as you would a power squat, not on top of seu(s) ombro(s). Keep seu(s) costas tight, ombro(s) blades pinched together, e seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent. Step costas de rack. Begin by bending at quadril, moving them costas as you bend over to near parallel. Keep seu(s) costas arched e seu(s) cervical spine in proper alignment. Reverse motion by extending through quadril com seu(s) glúteo(s) e hamstrings. Continue até you have returned até a posição inicial.

name: Good Morning Off Pins
instructions: Begin com a bar on a rack at about same height as seu(s) stomach. Bend over underneath bar e rack bar across rear of seu(s) ombro(s) as you would a power squat, not on top of seu(s) ombro(s). At proper height, you should be near parallel to floor when bent over. Keep seu(s) costas tight, ombro(s) blades pinched together, e seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent. Keep seu(s) costas arched e seu(s) cervical spine in proper alignment. Begin motion by extending through quadril com seu(s) glúteo(s) e hamstrings, e you are standing com weight. Slowly Abaixe a carga costas to pins returning até a posição inicial.

name: Gorilla Chin/abdominal Crunch
instructions: Hang de a chin-up bar using an underhand grip (palms facing you) that is slightly wider than ombro(s) width. Now Flexione os joelhos at a 90 degree angle so that calves are parallel to floor enquanto thighs remain perpendicular to it. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, pull yourself up enquanto crunching seu(s) joelho(s) up at same time até seu(s) joelho(s) are at peito level. You will stop going up as soon as seu(s) nose is at same level as bar. Tip: When you get to this point you should also be finishing crunch at same time. Slowly start to Inspire as you Retorne à posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Groin e Back Alongamento
instructions: Sit on floor com seu(s) joelho(s) bent e feet together. Interlock seu(s) fingers behind seu(s) head. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Curl downwards, bringing seu(s) cotovelo(s) to inside of seu(s) thighs. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial com seu(s) head up e seu(s) costas straight. Repeat for 10-20 repetições.

name: Groiners
instructions: Begin in a pushup position on floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Using both legs, jump forward landing com seu(s) feet next to seu(s) hands. Keep seu(s) head up as you do so. Retorne à posição inicial e immediately repeat movement, continuing for 10-20 repetições.

name: Hack Agachamento
instructions: Place costas of seu(s) torso against costas pad of máquina e hook seu(s) ombro(s) under ombro(s) pads provided. Position seu(s) legs in platform using a ombro(s) width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep seu(s) head up at all times e also maintain costas on pad at all times. Place seu(s) arms on side pegadas of máquina e disengage safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving side pegadas de a facing front position to a diagonal position). Now straighten seu(s) legs without locking joelho(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. (Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances described in foot positioning section). Begin to Abaixe lentamente unit by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up (costas on pad at all times). Continue down até angle between upper leg e calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is point in which upper legs are below parallel to floor). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise unit as you Expire by pushing floor com mainly com heel of seu(s) foot as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Rosca Martelos
instructions: Stand up com seu(s) torso upright e a halter(es) on each hand being held at arms length. cotovelo(s) should be close to torso. palms of hands should be facing seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now, enquanto holding seu(s) upper arm stationary, Expire e curl weight forward enquanto contracting biceps. Continue to Eleve a carga até biceps are fully contracted e halter(es) is at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a brief moment as you squeeze biceps. Tip: Focus on mantendo cotovelo(s) stationary e only moving seu(s) forearm. After brief pause, Inspire e slowly begin Abaixe a carga costas down até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Hammer Grip Inclinado Db Bench Press
instructions: Lie costas on an incline banco com a halter(es) on each hand on top of seu(s) thighs. palms of seu(s) hand will be facing each other. By using seu(s) thighs to help you get halter(es) up, clean halter(es) one arm at a time so that you can hold them at ombro(s) width. Once at ombro(s) width, keep palms of seu(s) hands com a neutral grip (palmas na direção indicada). Keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) flared out com upper arms in line com ombro(s) (perpendicular to torso) e cotovelo(s) bent creating a 90-degree angle between upper arm e forearm. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now bring down weights slowly to seu(s) side as you breathe in. Keep full control of halter(es) at all times. As you breathe out, push halter(es) up using seu(s) pectoral muscles. Lock seu(s) arms in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place halter(es) costas in seu(s) thighs e então on floor. This is safest manner to dispose of halter(es).

name: Hamstring-smr
instructions: In a seated position, extend seu(s) legs over a foam roll so that it is position on costas of upper legs. Place seu(s) hands to side or behind you to help support seu(s) weight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Using seu(s) hands, lift seu(s) quadril off of floor e shift seu(s) weight on foam roll to one leg. Relax hamstrings of leg you are stretching. Roll over foam de below quadril to above costas of joelho(s), pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat for other leg.

name: Hamstring Alongamento
instructions: Deite-se de costas com one leg extended above you, com quadril at ninety degrees. Keep other leg flat on floor. Loop a belt, band, or rope over ball of seu(s) foot. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull on belt to create tension in calves e hamstrings. Hold this stretch for 10-30 seconds, e repeat com other leg.

name: Handstand Flexão de Braços
instructions: Com seu(s) costas to wall bend at waist e place both hands on floor at ombro(s) width. Kick yourself up against wall com seu(s) arms straight. seu(s) body should be upside down com arms e legs fully extended. Keep seu(s) whole body as straight as possible. Tip: If doing this for first time, have a spotter help you. Also, make sure that you keep facing wall com seu(s) head, rather than looking down. Abaixe lentamente yourself to ground as you Inspire até seu(s) head almost touches floor. Tip: It is of utmost importance that you come down slow in order to avoid head injury. Push yourself costas up slowly as you Expire até seu(s) cotovelo(s) are nearly locked. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Hang Clean
instructions: Begin com a ombro(s) width, double overhand or hook grip, com bar hanging at mid thigh position. seu(s) costas should be straight e inclined slightly forward. Begin by aggressively extending through quadril, joelho(s) e ankles, driving weight upward. As you do so, shrug seu(s) ombro(s) towards seu(s) ears. Immediately recover by driving through heels, mantendo torso upright e cotovelo(s) up. Continue até you have risen to a standing position.

name: Hang Clean - Below Knees
instructions: Begin com a ombro(s) width, double overhand or hook grip, com bar hanging just below joelho(s). seu(s) costas should be straight e inclined slightly forward. Begin by aggressively extending through quadril, joelho(s) e ankles, driving weight upward. As you do so, shrug seu(s) ombro(s) towards seu(s) ears. As full extension is achieved, transition em third pull by aggressively shrugging e flexing arms com cotovelo(s) up e out. At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating seu(s) cotovelo(s) under bar as you do so. Receive bar in a front squat position, depth of which is dependent upon height of bar at end of third pull. bar should be racked onto protracted ombro(s), lightly touching throat com hands relaxed. Continue to descend to bottom squat position, which will help in recovery. Immediately recover by driving through heels, mantendo torso upright e cotovelo(s) up. Continue até you have risen to a standing position.

name: Hang Snatch
instructions: Begin com a wide grip on bar, com an overhand or hook grip. feet should be directly below quadril com feet turned out. seu(s) joelho(s) should be slightly bent, e torso inclined forward. spine should be fully extended e head facing forward. bar should be at quadril. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Aggressively extend through legs e quadril. At peak extension, shrug ombro(s) e allow cotovelo(s) to flex to side. As you move seu(s) feet em receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below bar as you elevate bar overhead. Receive bar com seu(s) body as low as possible e arms fully extended overhead. Return to a standing position com weight overhead. Follow by returning weight to ground under control.

name: Hang Snatch - Below Knees
instructions: Begin com a wide grip on bar, com an overhand or hook grip. feet should be directly below quadril com feet turned out. seu(s) joelho(s) should be slightly bent, e torso inclined forward. spine should be fully extended e head facing forward. bar should be just below joelho(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Aggressively extend through legs e quadril. At peak extension, shrug ombro(s) e allow cotovelo(s) to flex to side. As you move seu(s) feet em receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below bar as you elevate bar overhead. Receive bar com seu(s) body as low as possible e arms fully extended overhead. Return to a standing position com weight overhead, e então return weight to floor under control.

name: Hanging Bar Good Morning
instructions: Begin com a bar on a rack at about same height as seu(s) stomach. Suspend bar using chains or suspension straps. Bend over underneath bar e rack bar across rear of seu(s) ombro(s) as you would a power squat, not on top of seu(s) traps. At proper height, you should be near parallel to floor when bent over. Keep seu(s) costas tight, ombro(s) blades pinched together, e seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent. Keep seu(s) costas arched e seu(s) cervical spine in proper alignment. Begin motion by extending through quadril com seu(s) glúteo(s) e hamstrings, e you are standing com weight. Slowly Abaixe a carga costas até a posição inicial, where it is supported by chains.

name: Elevação de Pernas na Barra
instructions: Hang de a chin-up bar com both arms extended at arms length in top of you using either a wide grip or a medium grip. legs should be straight down com pelvis rolled slightly backwards. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) legs até torso makes a 90-degree angle com legs. Expire as you perform this movement e hold contraction for a second or so. Go costas slowly até a posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Hanging Pike
instructions: Hang de a chin-up bar com seu(s) legs e feet together using an overhand grip (palmas na direção indicada) that is slightly wider than ombro(s) width. Tip: You may use wrist wraps in order to facilitate holding on to bar. Now Flexione os joelhos at a 90 degree angle e bring upper legs forward so that calves are perpendicular to floor enquanto thighs remain parallel to it. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull seu(s) legs up as you Expire até you almost touch seu(s) shins com bar above you. Tip: Try to straighten seu(s) legs as much as possible enquanto at top. Lower seu(s) legs as slowly as possible até you reach posição inicial. Tip: Avoid swinging e using momentum at all times. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Heaving Snatch Balance
instructions: This drill helps you learn snatch. Begin by holding a light weight across costas of ombro(s). seu(s) feet should be slightly wider than quadril width apart com feet turned out, same position that you would perform a squat com. Begin by dipping com joelho(s) slightly, e popping costas up to briefly unload bar. Drive yourself underneath bar, elevating it overhead as you descend em a full squat. Return to a standing position.

name: Heavy Bag Thrust
instructions: Utilize a heavy bag for this exercise. Assume an upright stance next to bag, com seu(s) feet staggered, fairly wide apart. Place seu(s) hand on bag at about peito height. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by twisting at waist, pushing bag forward as hard as possible. Perform this move quickly, pushing bag away de seu(s) body. Receive bag as it swings costas by reversing these steps.

name: High Cabo Curls
instructions: Stand between a couple of high pulleys e grab a pegadas in each arm. Position seu(s) upper arms in a way that they are parallel to floor com palms of seu(s) hands facing you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Curl pegadas towards you até they are next to seu(s) ears. Make sure that as you do so you flex seu(s) biceps e Expire. upper arms should remain stationary e only forearms should move. Hold for a second in contracted position as you squeeze biceps. Slowly bring costas arms até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Hip Circles (de Bruços)
instructions: Position yourself on seu(s) hands e joelho(s) on ground. Maintaining good posture, raise one bent joelho(s) off of ground. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo joelho(s) in a bent position, rotate femur in an arc, attempting to make a big circle com seu(s) joelho(s). Perform this slowly for a number of repetições, e repeat on other side.

name: Hip Extensão com Bands
instructions: Secure one end of band to lower portion of a post e attach other to one ankle. Facing attachment point of band, hold on to column to stabilize yourself. mantendo seu(s) head e seu(s) peito up, move resisted leg costas as far as you can enquanto mantendo joelho(s) straight. Return leg até a posição inicial.

name: Hip Flexion com Elástico
instructions: Secure one end of band to lower portion of a post e attach other to one ankle. Face away de attachment point of band. mantendo seu(s) head e seu(s) peito up, raise seu(s) joelho(s) up to 90 degrees e pause. Return leg até a posição inicial.

name: Hip Lift com Elástico
instructions: After choosing a suitable band, lay down in middle of rack, after securing band on either side of you. If seu(s) rack doesn't have pegs, band can be secured using heavy halter(es) or similar objects, just ensure they won't move. Adjust seu(s) position so that band is directly over seu(s) quadril. Flexione os joelhos e place seu(s) pés firmes no chão. seu(s) hands can be on floor or holding band in position. mantendo seu(s) ombro(s) on ground, drive through seu(s) heels to raise seu(s) quadril, pushing em band as high as you can. Pause at top of motion, e Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Hug Ball
instructions: Seat yourself on floor. Straddle an exercise ball between both legs e lower seu(s) quadril down toward floor. Hug seu(s) arms around ball to support seu(s) body. Adjust seu(s) legs so that seu(s) feet are flat on floor e seu(s) joelho(s) line up over seu(s) ankles. Keep a good grip on ball so it doesn't roll away de you e send you costas onto seu(s) buttocks.

name: Hug Knees To Chest
instructions: Lie down on seu(s) costas e pull both joelho(s) up to seu(s) peito. Hold seu(s) arms under joelho(s), not over (that would put to much pressure on seu(s) joelho(s) joints). Slowly pull joelho(s) toward seu(s) ombro(s). This also stretches seu(s) buttocks muscles.

name: Hurdle Hops
instructions: Set up a row of hurdles or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart. Stand in front of first hurdle com seu(s) feet ombro(s) width apart. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by jumping com both feet over first hurdle, swinging both arms as you jump. Absorb impact of landing by bending joelho(s), rebounding out of first leap by jumping over next hurdle. Continue até you have jumped over all of hurdles.

name: Hyperextensions (back Extensions)
instructions: Deite-se de bruços on a hyperextension banco, tucking seu(s) ankles securely under footpads. Adjust upper pad if possible so seu(s) upper thighs lie flat across wide pad, leaving enough room for you to bend at waist without any restriction. com seu(s) body straight, cross seu(s) arms in front of you (my preference) or behind seu(s) head. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: You can also hold a weight plate for extra resistance in front of you under seu(s) crossed arms. Start bending forward slowly at waist as far as you can enquanto mantendo seu(s) costas flat. Inspire as you perform this movement. Keep moving forward até you feel a nice stretch on hamstrings e you can no longer keep going without a rounding of costas. Tip: Never round costas as you perform this exercise. Also, some people can go farther than others. key thing is that you go as far as seu(s) body allows you to without rounding costas. Slowly raise seu(s) torso costas to initial position as you Inspire. Tip: Avoid temptation to arch seu(s) costas past a straight line. Also, do not swing torso at any time in order to protect costas de injury. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Hyperextensions com no Hyperextension Bench
instructions: Com someone holding down seu(s) legs, slide yourself down to edge a flat banco até seu(s) quadril hang off end of banco. Tip: seu(s) entire upper body should be hanging down towards floor. Also, you will be in same position as if you were on a hyperextension banco but range of motion will be shorter due to height of flat banco vs. that of hyperextension banco. com seu(s) body straight, cross seu(s) arms in front of you (my preference) or behind seu(s) head. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: You can also hold a weight plate for extra resistance in front of you under seu(s) crossed arms. Start bending forward slowly at waist as far as you can enquanto mantendo seu(s) costas flat. Inspire as you perform this movement. Keep moving forward até you almost touch floor or you feel a nice stretch on hamstrings (whichever comes first). Tip: Never round costas as you perform this exercise. Slowly raise seu(s) torso costas to initial position as you Expire. Tip: Avoid temptation to arch seu(s) costas past a straight line. Also, do not swing torso at any time in order to protect costas de injury. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: It Elástico e Glute Alongamento
instructions: Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of seu(s) feet, e swing that leg across seu(s) body to opposite side, mantendo leg extended as you lay on ground. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) foot off of floor, pull on belt, using tension to pull toes up. Hold for 10-20 seconds, e repeat on other side.

name: Iliotibial Tract-smr
instructions: Lay on seu(s) side, com bottom leg placed onto a foam roller between quadril e joelho(s). other leg can be crossed in front of you. Place as much of seu(s) weight as is tolerable onto seu(s) bottom leg; there is no need to keep seu(s) bottom leg in contact com ground. Be sure to relax muscles of leg you are stretching. Roll seu(s) leg over foam de you quadril to seu(s) joelho(s), pausing for 10-30 seconds at points of tension. Repeat com opposite leg.

name: Inchworm
instructions: Fique em pé com os pés close together. mantendo seu(s) legs straight, stretch down e put seu(s) hands on floor directly in front of you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by walking seu(s) hands forward slowly, alternating seu(s) left e seu(s) right. As you do so, bend only at quadril, mantendo seu(s) legs straight. Keep going até seu(s) body is parallel to ground in a pushup position. Now, keep seu(s) hands in place e slowly take short steps com seu(s) feet, moving only a few inches at a time. Continue walking até seu(s) feet are by hour hands, mantendo seu(s) legs straight as you do so.

name: Inclinado Barra Triceps Extensão
instructions: Hold a barra com an overhand grip (palms down) that is a little closer together than ombro(s) width. Lie costas on an incline banco set at any angle between 45-75-degrees. Bring bar overhead com seu(s) arms extended e cotovelo(s) in. arms should be in line com torso above head. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now lower bar in a semicircular motion behind seu(s) head até seu(s) forearms touch seu(s) biceps. Inspire as you perform this movement. Tip: Keep seu(s) upper arms stationary e close to seu(s) head at all times. Only forearms should move. Retorne à posição inicial as you breathe out e you contract triceps. Hold contraction for a second. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Inclinado Bench Pull
instructions: Grab a halter(es) in each hand e Deite-se de bruços on an incline banco that is set to an incline that is approximately 30 degrees. Let arms hang to seu(s) sides fully extended as they point to floor. Turn wrists até seu(s) hands have a pronated (palms down) grip. Now flare cotovelo(s) out. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, start to pull halter(es) up as if you are doing a reverse banco press. You will do this by bending at cotovelo(s) e bringing upper arms up as you let forearms hang. Continue this motion até upper arms are at same level as seu(s) costas. Tip: cotovelo(s) will come out to side e seu(s) upper arms e torso should make letter "T" at top of movement. Hold contraction at top for a second. Slowly go costas down até a posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Inclinado Cabo Chest Press
instructions: Adjust weight to an appropriate amount e be seated, grasping pegadas. seu(s) upper arms should be about 45 degrees to body, com seu(s) head e peito up. cotovelo(s) should be bent to about 90 degrees. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by extending through cotovelo(s), pressing pegadas together straight in front of you. Keep seu(s) ombro(s) blades retracted as you execute movement. After pausing at full extension, Retorne à posição inicial, mantendo tension on cables.

name: Inclinado Cabo Crucifixo
instructions: To get yourself inaté a posição inicial, set pulleys at floor level (lowest level possible on máquina that is below seu(s) torso). Place an incline banco (set at 45 degrees) in between pulleys, select a weight on each one e grab a pulley on each hand. com a pegadas on each hand, lie on incline banco e bring seu(s) hands together at arms length in front of seu(s) face. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com a slight bend of seu(s) cotovelo(s) (in order to prevent stress at biceps tendon), lower seu(s) arms out at both sides in a wide arc até you feel a stretch on seu(s) peito. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout movement, arms should remain stationary. movement should only occur at ombro(s) joint. Return seu(s) arms costas até a posição inicial as you squeeze seu(s) peito muscles e Expire. Hold contracted position for a second. Tip: Make sure to use same arc of motion used to Abaixe a cargas. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Inclinado Halter Bench com Palms Facing In
instructions: Lie costas on an incline banco com a halter(es) on each hand on top of seu(s) thighs. palms of seu(s) hand will be facing each other. By using seu(s) thighs to help you get halter(es) up, clean halter(es) one arm at a time so that you can hold them at ombro(s) width. Once at ombro(s) width, keep palms of seu(s) hands com a neutral grip (palmas na direção indicada). Keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) flared out com upper arms in line com ombro(s) (perpendicular to torso) e cotovelo(s) bent creating a 90-degree angle between upper arm e forearm. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now bring down weights slowly to seu(s) side as you breathe in. Keep full control of halter(es) at all times. As you breathe out, push halter(es) up using seu(s) pectoral muscles. Lock seu(s) arms in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place halter(es) costas in seu(s) thighs e então on floor. This is safest manner to dispose of halter(es).

name: Inclinado Rosca Direta com Halteres
instructions: Sit costas on an incline banco com a halter(es) in each hand held at arms length. Keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) torso e rotate palms of seu(s) hands até they are facing forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto holding upper arm stationary, curl weights forward enquanto contracting biceps as you breathe out. Only forearms should move. Continue movement até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a second. Slowly begin to bring halter(es) costas to posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Inclinado Crucifixo com Haltereses
instructions: Hold a halter(es) on each hand e lie on an incline banco that is set to an incline angle of no more than 30 degrees. Extend seu(s) arms above you com a slight bend at cotovelo(s). Now rotate wrists so that palms of seu(s) hands are facing you. Tip: pinky fingers should be next to each other. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, start to Abaixe lentamente arms to side enquanto mantendo arms extended e enquanto rotating wrists até palms of hand are facing each other. Tip: At end of movement arms will be by seu(s) side com palms facing ceiling. As you Expire start to bring halter(es) costas up até a posição inicial by reversing motion e rotating hands so that pinky fingers are next to each other again. Tip: Keep in mind that movement will only happen at ombro(s) joint e at wrist. There is no motion that happens at cotovelo(s) joint. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Inclinado Crucifixo com Haltereses - com Twist
instructions: Hold a halter(es) in each hand e lie on an incline banco that is set to an incline angle of no more than 30 degrees. Extend seu(s) arms above you com a slight bend at cotovelo(s). Now rotate wrists so that palms of seu(s) hands are facing you. Tip: pinky fingers should be next to each other. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, start to Abaixe lentamente arms to side enquanto mantendo arms extended e enquanto rotating wrists até palms of hand are facing each other. Tip: At end of movement arms will be by seu(s) side com palms facing ceiling. As you Expire start to bring halter(es) costas up até a posição inicial by reversing motion e rotating hands so that pinky fingers are next to each other again. Tip: Keep in mind that movement will only happen at ombro(s) joint e at wrist. There is no motion that happens at cotovelo(s) joint. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Supino Inclinado com Halteres
instructions: Lie costas on an incline banco com a halter(es) in each hand atop seu(s) thighs. palms of seu(s) hands will be facing each other. então, using seu(s) thighs to help push halter(es) up, lift halter(es) one at a time so that you can hold them at ombro(s) width. Once you have halter(es) raised to ombro(s) width, rotate seu(s) wrists forward so that palms of seu(s) hands are facing away de you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Be sure to keep full control of halter(es) at all times. então breathe out e push halter(es) up com seu(s) peito. Lock seu(s) arms at top, hold for a second, e então start Abaixe lentamenteing weight. Tip Ideally, lowering weights should take about twice as long as raising them. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place halter(es) costas on seu(s) thighs e então on floor. This is safest manner to release halter(es).

name: Inclinado Rosca Martelos
instructions: Seat yourself on an incline banco com a halter(es) in each hand. You should pressed firmly against he costas com seu(s) feet together. Allow halter(es) to hang straight down at seu(s) side, holding them com a neutral grip. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by flexing at cotovelo(s), attempting to keep upper arm stationary. Continue to top of movement e pause, então Retorne lentamente to start position.

name: Inclinado Inner Biceps Rosca
instructions: Hold a halter(es) in each hand e lie costas on an incline banco. halter(es) should be at arm's length hanging at seu(s) sides e seu(s) palms should be facing out. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now as you Expire curl weight outward e up enquanto mantendo seu(s) forearms in line com seu(s) side deltoids. Continue curl até halter(es) are at ombro(s) height e to sides of seu(s) deltoids. Tip: end of movement should look similar to a double biceps pose. After a second contraction at top of movement, start to Inspire e slowly Abaixe a cargas costas até a posição inicial using same path used to bring them up. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Inclinado Flexão de Braço
instructions: Stand facing banco or sturdy elevated platform. Place hands on edge of banco or platform, slightly wider than ombro(s) width. Position forefoot costas de banco or platform com arms e body straight. Arms should be perpendicular to body. mantendo body straight, lower peito to edge of box or platform by bending arms. Push body up até arms are extended. Repeat.

name: Inclinado Flexão de Braço Pegada Fechada
instructions: Stand facing a Smith máquina bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height. Place seu(s) hands next to one another on bar. Position seu(s) feet costas de bar com arms e body straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) body straight, lower seu(s) peito to bar by bending arms. Retorne à posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s), pressing yourself costas up.

name: Inclinado Flexão de Braço Depth Jump
instructions: For this drill you will need a box about 12 inches high, e two thick mats or aerobics steps. Place steps just outside of seu(s) ombro(s), e place seu(s) feet on top of box so that you are in an incline pushup position, seu(s) hands just inside steps. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by bending at cotovelo(s) to lower seu(s) body, quickly reversing position to push seu(s) body off of ground. As you leave ground, move seu(s) hands onto steps, bending seu(s) cotovelo(s) to absorb impact. Repeat motion to Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Inclinado Flexão de Braço Medium
instructions: Stand facing a Smith máquina bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height. Place seu(s) hands on bar, com seu(s) hands about ombro(s) width apart. Position seu(s) feet costas de bar com arms e body straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) body straight, lower seu(s) peito to bar by bending arms. Retorne à posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s), pressing yourself costas up.

name: Inclinado Flexão de Braço Invertido Grip
instructions: Stand facing a Smith máquina bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height. Place seu(s) hands on bar palms up, com seu(s) hands about ombro(s) width apart. Position seu(s) feet costas de bar com arms e body straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) body straight, lower seu(s) peito to bar by bending arms. Retorne à posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s), pressing yourself costas up.

name: Inclinado Flexão de Braço Wide
instructions: Stand facing a Smith máquina bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height. Place seu(s) hands on bar, com seu(s) hands wider than ombro(s) width. Position seu(s) feet costas de bar com arms e body straight. seu(s) arms should be perpendicular to body. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) body straight, lower seu(s) peito to bar by bending arms. Retorne à posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s), pressing yourself costas up.

name: Intermediate Groin Alongamento
instructions: Deite-se de costas com seu(s) legs extended. Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of seu(s) feet, e swing that leg as far to side as you can. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull gently on belt to create tension in seu(s) groin e hamstring muscles. Hold for 10-20 seconds, e repeat on other side.

name: Intermediate Hip Flexor e Quad Alongamento
instructions: Deite-se de bruços on floor, com a rope, belt, or band looped around one foot. Flex joelho(s) e extend quadril of leg to be stretched, using both hands to pull on belt. seu(s) joelho(s) e seu(s) quadril should come off of floor, creating tension in quadril flexors e quadriceps. Hold stretch for 10-20 seconds, e repeat on other leg.

name: Internal Rotation com Elástico
instructions: Choke band around a post. band should be at same height as seu(s) cotovelo(s). Stand com seu(s) right side to band a couple of feet away. Grasp end of band com seu(s) right hand, e keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) pressed firmly to seu(s) side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place com seu(s) cotovelo(s) to keep it firmly in position. com seu(s) upper arm in position, seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be flexed to 90 degrees com seu(s) hand reaching away de seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Execute movement by rotating seu(s) arm in a forehand motion, mantendo seu(s) cotovelo(s) in place. Continue as far as you are able, pause, e então Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Inverted Remada
instructions: Position a bar in a rack to about waist height. You can also use a smith máquina. Take a wider than ombro(s) width grip on bar e position yourself hanging underneath bar. seu(s) body should be straight com seu(s) heels on ground com seu(s) arms fully extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by flexing cotovelo(s), pulling seu(s) peito towards bar. Retract seu(s) ombro(s) blades as you perform movement. Pause at top of motion, e return yourself to start position. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: Inverted Remada com Straps
instructions: Hang a rope or suspension straps de a rack or other stable object. Grasp ends e position yourself in a supine position hanging de ropes. seu(s) body should be straight com seu(s) heels on ground com seu(s) arms fully extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by flexing cotovelo(s), pulling seu(s) peito to seu(s) hands. Retract seu(s) ombro(s) blades as you perform movement. Pause at top of motion, e return yourself to start position. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: Iron Cross
instructions: Execute o movimento com controle, boa postura e amplitude completa.

name: Iron Crosses (alongamento)
instructions: Deite-se de bruços on floor, com seu(s) arms extended out to seu(s) side, palms pressed to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. To begin, flex one joelho(s) e bring that leg across costas of seu(s) body, attempting to touch it to ground near opposite hand. Promptly return leg to starting postion, e quickly repeat com other leg. Continue alternating for 10-20 repetições.

name: Isometric Chest Squeezes
instructions: Enquanto either seating or standing, bend seu(s) arms at a 90-degree angle e place palms of seu(s) hands together in front of seu(s) peito. Tip: seu(s) hands should be open com palms together e fingers facing forward (perpendicular to seu(s) torso). Push both hands against each other as you contract seu(s) peito. Start com slow tension e increase slowly. Keep breathing normally as you execute this contraction. Hold for recommended number of seconds. Now release tension slowly. Rest for recommended amount of time e repeat.

name: Isometric Neck Exercise - Front e Back
instructions: Com seu(s) head e neck in a neutral position (normal position com head erect facing forward), place both of seu(s) hands on front side of seu(s) head. Now gently push forward as you contract neck muscles but resisting any movement of seu(s) head. Start com slow tension e increase slowly. Keep breathing normally as you execute this contraction. Hold for recommended number of seconds. Now release tension slowly. Rest for recommended amount of time e repeat com seu(s) hands placed on costas side of seu(s) head.

name: Isometric Neck Exercise - Sides
instructions: Com seu(s) head e neck in a neutral position (normal position com head erect facing forward), place seu(s) left hand on left side of seu(s) head. Now gently push towards left as you contract left neck muscles but resisting any movement of seu(s) head. Start com slow tension e increase slowly. Keep breathing normally as you execute this contraction. Hold for recommended number of seconds. Now release tension slowly. Rest for recommended amount of time e repeat com seu(s) right hand placed on right side of seu(s) head.

name: Isometric Wipers
instructions: Assume a push-up position, supporting seu(s) weight on seu(s) hands e toes enquanto mantendo seu(s) body straight. seu(s) hands should be just outside of ombro(s) width. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by shifting seu(s) body weight as far to one side as possible, allowing cotovelo(s) on that side to flex as you lower seu(s) body. Reverse motion by extending flexed arm, pushing yourself up e então dropping to other side. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: Jm Press
instructions: Start exercise same way you would a close grip banco press. You will lie on a flat banco enquanto holding a barra at arms length (fully extended) com cotovelo(s) in. However, instead of having arms perpendicular to torso, make sure bar is set in a direct line above upper peito. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now beginning de a fully extended position lower bar down as if performing a lying triceps extension. Inspire as you perform this movement. When you reach half way point, let bar roll costas about one inch by moving upper arms towards seu(s) legs até they are perpendicular to torso. Tip: Keep bend at cotovelo(s) constant as you bring upper arms forward. As you Expire, press bar costas up by using triceps to perform a close grip banco press. Now go costas até a posição inicial e start over. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Jackknife Abdominal
instructions: Lie flat on floor (or exercise mat) on seu(s) costas com seu(s) arms extended straight costas behind seu(s) head e seu(s) legs extended also. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, bend at waist enquanto simultaneously raising seu(s) legs e arms to meet in a jackknife position. Tip: legs should be extended e lifted at approximately a 35-45 degree angle de floor e arms should be extended e parallel to seu(s) legs. upper torso should be off floor. enquanto inhaling, lower seu(s) arms e legs costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Janda Abdominal
instructions: Position seu(s) body on floor in basic sit-up position; joelho(s) to a ninety degree angle com pés firmes no chão e arms either crossed over seu(s) peito or to sides. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you strongly tighten seu(s) glúteo(s) e hamstrings, fill seu(s) lungs com air e in a slow (three to six second count) ascent, slowly Expire. Tip: It is important to tighten glúteo(s) e hamstrings as this will cause quadril flexors to be inactivated in a process called reciprocal inhibition, which basically means that opposite muscles to contracted ones will relax. As you Inspire, slowly go costas in a controlled manner até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Jefferson Squats
instructions: Place a barra on floor. Stand in middle of bar length wise. Bend down by bending at joelho(s) e mantendo seu(s) costas straight e grasp front of bar com seu(s) right hand. seu(s) palm should be in (neutral grip) facing left side. Grasp rear of bar com seu(s) left hand. palm of seu(s) hand should be in neutral grip alignment (palms facing right side). Tip: Ensure that seu(s) grip is even on bar. seu(s) torso should be positioned right in middle of bar e distance between seu(s) torso e seu(s) right hand (which should be at front) should be same as distance between seu(s) torso e seu(s) left hand (which should be to seu(s) costas). Now Fique em pé ereto up com weight. Tip: seu(s) feet should be ombro(s) width apart e seu(s) toes slightly pointed out. Squat down by bending at joelho(s) e mantendo seu(s) costas straight até seu(s) upper thighs are parallel com floor. Tip: Keep seu(s) costas as vertical as possible com floor e seu(s) head up. Also remember to not let seu(s) joelho(s) go past seu(s) toes. Inspire during this portion of movement. Now drive yourself costas up até a posição inicial by pushing com feet . Tip: Keep bar hanging at arm's length e seu(s) cotovelo(s) locked com a slight bend. arms only serve as hooks. Avoid doing any lifting com them. Do lifting com seu(s) thighs; not seu(s) arms.

name: Jerk Balance
instructions: This drill helps you learn to drive yourself low enough during jerk e corrects those who move backward during movement. Begin com bar racked in jerk position, com ombro(s) forward, torso upright, e feet split slightly apart. Initiate movement as you would a normal jerk, dipping at joelho(s) enquanto mantendo seu(s) torso vertical, e driving costas up forcefully, using momentum e not seu(s) arms to elevate weight. Keep rear foot in place, using it to drive seu(s) body forward em a full split as you jerk weight. Recover by standing up com weight overhead.

name: Jerk Paralelas Agachamento
instructions: This movement strengthens dip portion of jerk. Begin com bar racked in jerk position, com ombro(s) forward to create a shelf e bar lightly contacting throat. feet should be directly under quadril, com feet turned out as is comfortable. mantendo torso vertical, dip by flexing joelho(s), allowing them to travel forward e without moving quadril to rear. dip should not be excessive. Return weight até a posição inicial by driving forcefully though feet.

name: Jogging, Esteira
instructions: To begin, step onto treadmill e select desired option de menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter seu(s) age e weight to estimate amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change intensity of workout. Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, e usually have less impact than jogging outside. A 150 lb person will burn almost 250 calories jogging for 30 minutes, compared to more than 450 calories running. Maintain proper posture as you jog, e only hold onto pegadas when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking seu(s) heart rate.

name: Keg Load
instructions: To load kegs, place desired number a distance de loading platform, typically 30-50 feet. Begin by grabbing close pegadas of first keg, tilting it onto its side to grab opposite edge of bottom of keg. Lift keg up to seu(s) peito. higher you can place keg, faster you should be able to move to platform. Shouldering is usually not allowed. Be sure to keep a firm hold on keg. Move as quickly as possible to platform, e load it, extending through seu(s) quadril, joelho(s), e ankles to get it as high as possible. Retorne à posição inicial to retrieve next keg, e repeat até event is completed.

name: Kettlebell Arnold Press
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you raise kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). palm should be facing inward. Looking straight ahead, press kettlebell out e overhead, rotating seu(s) wrist so that seu(s) palm faces forward at top of motion. Return kettlebell até a posição inicial, com palm facing in.

name: Kettlebell Dead Clean
instructions: Place kettlebell between seu(s) feet. To get in posição inicial, push seu(s) butt costas e look straight ahead. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you raise kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). wrist should rotate as you do so. Lower kettlebell, mantendo hamstrings loaded by mantendo seu(s) costas straight e seu(s) butt out.

name: Kettlebell Figure 8
instructions: Place one kettlebell between seu(s) legs e take a wider than ombro(s) width stance. Bend over by pushing seu(s) butt out e mantendo seu(s) costas flat. Pick up a kettlebell e pass it to seu(s) other hand between seu(s) legs. receiving hand should reach de behind legs. Go costas e forth for several repetições.

name: Kettlebell Hang Clean
instructions: Place kettlebell between seu(s) feet. To get in posição inicial, push seu(s) butt costas e look straight ahead. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you raise kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). wrist should rotate as you do so. Lower kettlebell to a hanging position between seu(s) legs enquanto mantendo hamstrings loaded. Keep seu(s) head up at all times.

name: Kettlebell One-legged Levantamento Terra
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by pegadas in one hand. Stand on one leg, on same side that you hold kettlebell. mantendo that joelho(s) slightly bent, perform a stiff legged deadlift by bending at quadril, extending seu(s) free leg behind you for balance. Continue lowering kettlebell até you are parallel to ground, e então return to upright position.

name: Kettlebell Pass Between Legs
instructions: Place one kettlebell between seu(s) legs e take a comfortable stance. Bend over by pushing seu(s) butt out e mantendo seu(s) costas flat. Pick up a kettlebell e pass it to seu(s) other hand between seu(s) legs, in fashion of a "W". Go costas e forth for several repetições.

name: Kettlebell Pirate Ships
instructions: Com a wide stance, hold a kettlebell com both hands. Allow it to hang at waist level com seu(s) arms extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by turning to one side, swinging kettlebell to head height. Briefly pause at top of motion. Allow bell to drop as you rotate to opposite side, again raising kettlebell to head height. Repeat for desired amount of repetições.

name: Kettlebell Pistol Agachamento
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell com two hands e hold it by horns. Hold one leg off of floor e squat down on other. Squat down by flexing joelho(s) e sitting costas com quadril, holding kettlebell up in front of you. Hold bottom position for a second e então reverse motion, driving through heel e mantendo seu(s) head e peito up. Lower yourself again e repeat.

name: Kettlebell Sentado Press
instructions: Sit on floor e spread seu(s) legs out comfortably. Clean one kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s). Press kettlebell up e out até it is locked out overhead. Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Kettlebell Seesaw Press
instructions: Clean two kettlebells two seu(s) ombro(s). Press one kettlebell. Lower kettlebell e immediately press other kettlebell. Make sure to do same amount of repetições on both sides.

name: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull
instructions: Place a kettlebell on ground between seu(s) feet. Position seu(s) feet in a wide stance, e grasp kettlebell com two hands. Set seu(s) quadril costas o máximo possível, com seu(s) joelho(s) bent. Keep seu(s) peito e head up. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by extending quadril e joelho(s), simultaneously pulling kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s), raising seu(s) cotovelo(s) as you do so. Reverse motion to Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Kettlebell Thruster
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebells towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrists as you do so. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin to squat by flexing seu(s) quadril e joelho(s), lowering seu(s) quadril between seu(s) legs. Maintain an upright, straight costas as you descend as low as you can. At bottom, reverse direction e squat by extending seu(s) joelho(s) e quadril, driving through seu(s) heels. As you do so, press both kettlebells overhead by extending seu(s) arms straight up, using momentum de squat to help drive weights upward. As you begin next repetições, return weights to ombro(s).

name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-up (afundo Style)
instructions: Deite-se de costas on floor e press a kettlebell to top position by extending cotovelo(s). Bend joelho(s) on same side as kettlebell. mantendo kettlebell locked out at all times, pivot to opposite side e use seu(s) non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to lunge position. Using seu(s) free hand, push yourself to a seated position, então progressing to one joelho(s). enquanto looking up at kettlebell, slowly stand up. Reverse motion costas até a posição inicial e repeat.

name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-up (agachamento Style)
instructions: Deite-se de costas on floor e press a kettlebell to top position by extending cotovelo(s). Bend joelho(s) on same side as kettlebell. mantendo kettlebell locked out at all times, pivot to opposite side e use seu(s) non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to lunge position. Using seu(s) free hand, push yourself to a seated position, então progressing to seu(s) feet. enquanto looking up at kettlebell, slowly stand up. Reverse motion costas até a posição inicial e repeat.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Place a kettlebell in front of seu(s) lead foot e clean e press it overhead com seu(s) opposite arm. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so, so that palm faces forward. Press it overhead by extending cotovelo(s). mantendo kettlebell locked out at all times, push seu(s) butt out in direction of locked out kettlebell. Turn seu(s) feet out at a forty-five degree angle de arm com locked out kettlebell. Bending at quadril to one side, sticking seu(s) butt out, slowly lean até you can touch floor com seu(s) free hand. Keep seu(s) eyes on kettlebell that you hold over seu(s) head at all times. Pause for a second after reaching ground e reverse motion costas até a posição inicial.

name: Kipping Muscle Up
instructions: Grip rings using a false grip, com base of seu(s) palms on top of rings. Begin com a movement swinging seu(s) legs backward slightly. Counter that movement by swinging seu(s) legs forward e up, jerking seu(s) chin e peito costas, pulling yourself up com both arms as you do so. As you reach top position of pull-up, pull rings to seu(s) armpits as you roll seu(s) ombro(s) forward, allowing seu(s) cotovelo(s) to move straight costas behind you. This puts you em proper position to continue em dip portion of movement. Maintaining control e stability, extend through cotovelo(s) to complete motion. Use care when lowering yourself to ground.

name: Knee Across Body
instructions: Lie down on floor com seu(s) right leg straight. Bend seu(s) left leg e lower it across seu(s) body, holding joelho(s) down toward floor com seu(s) right hand. ( joelho(s) doesn't need to touch floor if you're tight.) Place seu(s) left arm comfortably beside you e turn seu(s) head to left. Imagine you have a weight tied to seu(s) tailbone. let seu(s) tailbone fall costas toward floor as seu(s) peito reaches in opposite direction to stretch seu(s) lower costas. Switch sides.

name: Knee Circles
instructions: Stand com seu(s) legs together e hands by seu(s) waist. Now move seu(s) joelho(s) in a circular motion as you breathe normally. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Knee/hip Elevação no Parallel Bars
instructions: Position seu(s) body on vertical leg raise banco so that seu(s) forearms are resting on pads next to torso e holding on to pegadas. seu(s) arms will be bent at a 90 degree angle. torso should be straight com lower costas pressed against pad of máquina e legs extended pointing towards floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now as you breathe out, lift seu(s) legs up as you keep them extended. Continue this movement até seu(s) legs are roughly parallel to floor e então hold contraction for a second. Tip: Do not use any momentum or swinging as you perform this exercise. Slowly go costas até a posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Knee Tuck Jump
instructions: Begin in a comfortable standing position com seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent. Hold seu(s) hands in front of you, palms down com seu(s) fingertips together at peito height. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Rapidly dip down em a quarter squat e immediately explode upward. Drive joelho(s) towards peito, attempting to touch them to palms of hands. Jump as high as you can, raising seu(s) joelho(s) up, e então ensure a good land be re-extending seu(s) legs, absorbing impact through be allowing joelho(s) to rebend.

name: Kneeling Arm Drill
instructions: This drill helps increase arm efficiency during run. Begin kneeling, left foot in front, right joelho(s) down. Apply pressure through front heel to keep seu(s) glúteo(s) e hamstrings activated. Begin by blocking arms in long, pendulum like swings. Close arm angle, blocking com arms as you would when jogging, progressing to a run e finally a sprint. As soon as seu(s) hands pass quadril, accelerate them forward during sprinting motion to move them as quickly as possible. Switch joelho(s) e repeat.

name: Kneeling Cabo Abdominal Crunch com Alternado Oblique Twists
instructions: Connect a rope attachment to a high pulley cabo e position a mat on floor in front of it. Grab rope com both hands e kneel approximately two feet costas de tower. Position rope behind seu(s) head com seu(s) hands by seu(s) ears. Keep seu(s) hands in same place, contract seu(s) abs e pull downward on rope in a crunching movement até seu(s) cotovelo(s) reach seu(s) joelho(s). Pause briefly at bottom e rise up in a slow e controlled manner até you reach posição inicial. Repeat same downward movement até you're halfway down, at which time you'll begin rotating one of seu(s) cotovelo(s) to opposite joelho(s). Again, pause briefly at bottom e rise up in a slow e controlled manner até you reach posição inicial. Repeat same movement as before, but alternate other cotovelo(s) to opposite joelho(s). Continue this series of movements to failure.

name: Kneeling Cabo Triceps Extensão
instructions: Place a banco sideways in front of a high pulley máquina. Hold a straight bar attachment above seu(s) head com seu(s) hands about 6 inches apart com seu(s) palmas na direção indicada. Face away de máquina e kneel. Place seu(s) head e costas of seu(s) upper arms on banco. seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be bent com forearms pointing towards high pulley. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo seu(s) upper arms close to seu(s) head at all times com cotovelo(s) in, press bar out in a semicircular motion até cotovelo(s) are locked e seu(s) arms are parallel to floor. Contract triceps hard e keep this position for a second. Expire as you perform this movement. Slowly Retorne à posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Kneeling Forearm Alongamento
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat com seu(s) palms flat e seu(s) fingers pointing costas toward seu(s) joelho(s). Slowly lean costas mantendo seu(s) palms flat on floor até you feel a stretch in seu(s) wrists e forearms. Hold for 20-30 seconds.

name: Kneeling High Pulley Remada
instructions: Select appropriate weight using a pulley that is above seu(s) head. Attach a rope to cabo e kneel a couple of feet away, holding rope out in front of you com both arms extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by flexing cotovelo(s) e fully retracting seu(s) ombro(s), pulling rope toward seu(s) upper peito com seu(s) cotovelo(s) out. After pausing briefly, slowly Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor
instructions: Kneel on a mat e bring seu(s) right joelho(s) up so bottom of seu(s) foot is on floor e extend seu(s) left leg out behind you so top of seu(s) foot is on floor. Shift seu(s) weight forward até you feel a stretch in seu(s) quadril. Hold for 15 seconds, então repeat for seu(s) other side.

name: Kneeling Jump Agachamento
instructions: Begin kneeling on floor com a barra racked across costas of seu(s) ombro(s), or you can use seu(s) body weight for this exercise. This can be done inside of a power rack to make unracking easier. Sit costas com seu(s) quadril até seu(s) glúteo(s) touch seu(s) feet, mantendo seu(s) head e peito up. Explode up com seu(s) quadril, generating enough power to land com seu(s) pés firmes no chão. Continue com squat by driving through seu(s) heels e extending joelho(s) to come to a standing position.

name: Kneeling Single-arm High Pulley Remada
instructions: Attach a single pegadas to a high pulley e make seu(s) weight selection. Kneel in front of cabo tower, taking cabo com one hand com seu(s) arm extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Starting com seu(s) palm facing forward, pull weight down to seu(s) torso by flexing cotovelo(s) e retract ombro(s) blade. As you do so, rotate wrist so that at completion of movement, seu(s) palm is now facing you. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Kneeling Agachamento
instructions: Set bar to proper height in a power rack. Kneel behind bar; it may be beneficial to put a mat down to pad seu(s) joelho(s). Slide under bar, racking it across costas of seu(s) ombro(s). seu(s) ombro(s) blades should be retracted e bar tight across seu(s) costas. Unrack weight. com seu(s) head looking forward, sit costas com seu(s) butt até you touch seu(s) calves. Reverse motion, returning torso to an upright position.

name: Landmine 180'S
instructions: Position a bar em a landmine or securely anchor it in a corner. Load bar to an appropriate weight. Raise bar de floor, taking it to ombro(s) height com both hands com seu(s) arms extended in front of you. Adopt a wide stance. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Perform movement by rotating trunk e quadril as you swing weight all way down to one side. Keep seu(s) arms extended throughout exercise. Reverse motion to swing weight all way to opposite side. Continue alternating movement até set is complete.

name: Landmine Linear Jammer
instructions: Position a bar em landmine or, lacking one, securely anchor it in a corner. Load bar to an appropriate weight e position pegadas attachment on bar. Raise bar de floor, taking pegadas to seu(s) ombro(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. In an athletic stance, squat by flexing seu(s) quadril e setting seu(s) quadril costas, mantendo seu(s) arms flexed. Reverse motion by powerfully extending through quadril, joelho(s), e ankles, enquanto also extending cotovelo(s) to straighten arms. This movement should be done explosively, coming out of squat to full extension as powerfully as possible. Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Lateral Bound
instructions: Assume a half squat position facing 90 degrees de seu(s) direction of travel. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Allow seu(s) lead leg to do a countermovement inward as you shift seu(s) weight to outside leg. Immediately push off e extend, attempting to bound to side o máximo possível. Upon landing, immediately push off in opposite direction, returning to seu(s) original start position. Continue costas e forth for several repetições.

name: Lateral Box Jump
instructions: Assume a comfortable standing position, com a short box positioned next to you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Quickly dip em a quarter squat to initiate stretch reflex, e immediately reverse direction to jump up e to side. Bring seu(s) joelho(s) high enough to ensure seu(s) feet have good clearance over box. Land on center of box, using seu(s) legs to absorb impact. Carefully jump down to other side of box, e continue going costas e forth for several repetições.

name: Lateral Cone Hops
instructions: Position a number of cones in a row several feet apart. Stand next to end of cones, facing 90 degrees to direction of travel. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin jump by dipping com joelho(s) to initiate a stretch reflex, e immediately reverse direction to push off ground, jumping up e sideways over cone. Use seu(s) legs to absorb impact upon landing, e rebound em next jump, continuing down row of cones.

name: Elevação Lateral - com Bands
instructions: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. segure a barra/pegadas using a pronated (palms facing seu(s) thighs) grip that is slightly less than ombro(s) width. pegadas should be resting on sides of seu(s) thighs. seu(s) arms should be extended com a slight bend at cotovelo(s) e seu(s) costas should be straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Use seu(s) side ombro(s) to lift pegadas to sides as you Expire. Continue to lift pegadas até they are slightly above parallel. Tip: As you lift pegadas, slightly tilt hand as if you were pouring water e keep seu(s) arms extended. Also, keep seu(s) torso stationary e pause for a second at top of movement. Lower pegadas costas down slowly até a posição inicial. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Latissimus Dorsi-smr
instructions: Enquanto lying on floor, place a foam roll under seu(s) costas e to one side, just behind seu(s) arm pit. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Keep arm of side being stretched behind e to side of you as you shift seu(s) weight onto seu(s) lats, mantendo seu(s) upper body off of ground. Hold for 10-30 seconds, e switch sides.

name: Leg-over Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor com one kettlebell in place on seu(s) peito, holding it by pegadas.
