Extend leg on working side over leg on non-working side.seu(s) free arm can be extended out to seu(s) side for support. Press kettlebll em a locked out position. Abaixe a carga até cotovelo(s) touches ground, mantendo kettlebell above cotovelo(s). Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: Leg-up Hamstring Alongamento
instructions: Lie flat on seu(s) costas, bend one joelho(s), e put that foot flat on floor to stabilize seu(s) spine. Extend other leg in air. If you're tight, you wont be able to straighten it. That's okay. Extend joelho(s) so that sole of lifted foot faces ceiling (or as close as you can get it). Slowly straighten legs as much as possible e então pull leg toward seu(s) nose. Switch sides.

name: Cadeira Extensoras
instructions: For this exercise you will need to use a leg extension máquina. First choose seu(s) weight e sit on máquina com seu(s) legs under pad (feet pointed forward) e hands holding side bars. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: You will need to adjust pad so that it falls on top of seu(s) lower leg (just above seu(s) feet). Also, make sure that seu(s) legs form a 90-degree angle between lower e upper leg. If angle is less than 90-degrees então that means joelho(s) is over toes which in turn creates undue stress at joelho(s) joint. If máquina is designed that way, either look for another máquina or just make sure that when you start executing exercise you stop going down once you hit 90-degree angle. Using seu(s) quadriceps, extend seu(s) legs to maximum as you Expire. Ensure that rest of body remains stationary on seat. Pause a second on contracted position. Slowly Abaixe a carga costas to original position as you Inspire, ensuring that you do not go past 90-degree angle limit. Repeat for recommended amount of times.

name: Leg Lift
instructions: Enquanto standing up straight com both feet next to each other at around ombro(s) width, grab a sturdy surface such as sides of a squat rack or top of a chair to brace yourself e keep balance. com or without an ankle weight, lift one leg behind you as if performing a leg curl but standing up enquanto mantendo other leg straight. Breathe out as you perform this movement. Slowly bring raised leg costas to floor as you breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. Repeat movement com opposite leg.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Using a leg press máquina, Sente-se on máquina e place seu(s) legs on platform directly in front of you at a medium (ombro(s) width) foot stance. (Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances described in foot positioning section). Lower safety bars holding weighted platform in place e press platform all way up até seu(s) legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) torso e legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Inspire, Abaixe lentamente platform até seu(s) upper e lower legs make a 90-degree angle. Pushing mainly com heels of seu(s) feet e using quadriceps go costas até a posição inicial as you Expire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e ensure to lock safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.

name: Leg Pull-in
instructions: Lie on an exercise mat com seu(s) legs extended e seu(s) hands either palmas na direção indicada next to you or under seu(s) glúteo(s). Tip: My preference is com hands next to me. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Flexione os joelhos e pull seu(s) upper thighs em seu(s) midsection as you breathe out. Continue motion até seu(s) joelho(s) are around peito level. Contract seu(s) abs as you execute this movement e hold for a second at top. Tip: As you perform motion, lower legs (calves) should always remain parallel to floor. Retorne à posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Leverage Chest Press
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto pins e adjust seat for seu(s) height. pegadas should be near bottom or middle of pectorals at beginning of motion. seu(s) peito e head should be up e seu(s) ombro(s) blades retracted. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Press pegadas forward by extending through cotovelo(s). After a brief pause at top, return weight just above start position, mantendo tension on muscles by not returning weight to stops até set is complete.

name: Leverage Levantamento Terra
instructions: Load pins to an appropriate weight. Position yourself directly between pegadas. Grasp bottom pegadas com a comfortable grip, e então lower seu(s) quadril as you take a breath. Look forward com seu(s) head e keep seu(s) peito up. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Return weight até a posição inicial.

name: Leverage Declinado Chest Press
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto pins e adjust seat for seu(s) height. pegadas should be near bottom of pectorals at beginning of motion. seu(s) peito e head should be up e seu(s) ombro(s) blades retracted. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Press pegadas forward by extending through cotovelo(s). After a brief pause at top, return weight just above start position, mantendo tension on muscles by not returning weight to stops até set is complete.

name: Leverage High Remada
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto pins e adjust seat height so that you can just reach pegadas above you. Adjust joelho(s) pad to help keep you down. segure a barra/pegadas com a pronated grip. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull pegadas towards seu(s) torso, retracting seu(s) ombro(s) blades as you flex cotovelo(s). Pause at bottom of motion, e então Retorne lentamente pegadas até a posição inicial. For multiple repetições, avoid completely returning weight to stops to keep tension on muscles being worked.

name: Leverage Inclinado Chest Press
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto pins e adjust seat for seu(s) height. pegadas should be near top of pectorals at beginning of motion. seu(s) peito e head should be up e seu(s) ombro(s) blades retracted. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Press pegadas forward by extending through cotovelo(s). After a brief pause at top, return weight just above start position, mantendo tension on muscles by not returning weight to stops até set is complete.

name: Leverage Iso Remada
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto pins e adjust seat height so that pegadas are at peito level. segure a barra/pegadas com either a neutral or pronated grip. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull pegadas towards seu(s) torso, retracting seu(s) ombro(s) blades as you flex cotovelo(s). Pause at bottom of motion, e então Retorne lentamente pegadas até a posição inicial. For multiple repetições, avoid completely returning weight to stops to keep tension on muscles being worked.

name: Leverage Desenvolvimento
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto pins e adjust seat for seu(s) height. pegadas should be near top of ombro(s) at beginning of motion. seu(s) peito e head should be up e pegadas held com a pronated grip. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Press pegadas upward by extending through cotovelo(s). After a brief pause at top, return weight to just above start position, mantendo tension on muscles by not returning weight to stops até set is complete.

name: Leverage Encolhimento
instructions: Load pins to an appropriate weight. Position yourself directly between pegadas. Grasp top pegadas com a comfortable grip, e então lower seu(s) quadril as you take a breath. Look forward com seu(s) head e keep seu(s) peito up. Drive through floor com seu(s) heels, extending seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) as you rise to a standing position. Keep seu(s) arms straight throughout movement, finishing com seu(s) ombro(s) costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Eleve a carga by shrugging ombro(s) towards seu(s) ears, moving straight up e down. Pause at top of motion, e então return weight até a posição inicial.

name: Linear 3-Part Start Technique
instructions: This drill helps you accelerate as quickly as possible em a sprint de a dead stop. It helps to use a line to start de. Begin com two feet on line. Place seu(s) left foot com toe next to seu(s) right ankle. Place seu(s) right foot 4-6 inches behind left. Place seu(s) right hand onto line, e thing bring seu(s) nose close to seu(s) left joelho(s). Squat down as you lean foward, seu(s) head being lower than seu(s) quadril e seu(s) weight loaded onto left leg. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Take seu(s) left hand up so that it is parallel to ground, pointing behind you, e explode out when ready.

name: Linear Acceleration Wall Drill
instructions: Lean at around 45 degrees against a wall. seu(s) feet should be together, glúteo(s) contracted. Begin by lifting seu(s) right joelho(s) quickly, pausing, e então driving it straight down em ground. Switch legs, raising opposite joelho(s), e então attacking ground straight down. Repeat once more com seu(s) right leg, e as soon as right foot strikes ground hammer them out rapidly, alternating left e right as fast as you can.

name: Linear Depth Jump
instructions: You will need two boxes or benches spaced a few feet away de each other. Begin by standing on one box facing towards other platform. To initiate movement, gently drop down to ground between seu(s) platforms, allowing joelho(s) e quadril to flex. Reverse motion by exploding, extending through quadril, joelho(s), e ankles to jump onto other platform. Land softly, asborbing impact through legs.

name: Log Lift
instructions: Begin standing com log in front of you. segure a barra/pegadas, e begin to clean log. As you are bent over to start clean, attempt to get log as high as possible, pulling it em seu(s) peito. Extend through quadril e joelho(s) to bring it up to complete clean. Push seu(s) head costas e look up, creating a shelf on seu(s) peito to rest log. Begin press by dipping, flexing slightly through joelho(s) e reversing motion. This push press will generate momentum to start log moving vertically. Continue by extending through cotovelo(s) to press log above seu(s) head. There are no strict rules on form, so use whatever techniques you are most efficient com. As log is pressed, ensure that you push seu(s) head through on each repetições, looking forward. Repeat as many times as possible. Attempt to control descent of log as it is returned to ground.

name: London Bridges
instructions: Attach a climbing rope to a high beam or cross member. Below it, ensure that smith máquina bar is locked in place com safeties e cannot move. Alternatively, a secure box could also be utilized. Stand on bar, using rope to balance yourself. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) body straight, lean costas e lower seu(s) body by slowly going hand over hand com rope. Continue até you are perpendicular to ground. mantendo seu(s) body straight, reverse motion, going hand over hand costas até a posição inicial.

name: Looking At Ceiling
instructions: Kneel on floor, holding seu(s) heels com both hands. Lift seu(s) buttocks up e forward enquanto bringing seu(s) head costas to look up at ceiling, to give an arch in seu(s) costas.

name: Low Cruzamento de Cabos
instructions: To move inaté a posição inicial, place pulleys at low position, select resistance to be used e grasp a pegadas in each hand. Step forward, gaining tension in pulleys. seu(s) palms should be facing forward, hands below waist, e seu(s) arms straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com a slight bend in seu(s) arms, draw seu(s) hands upward e toward midline of seu(s) body. seu(s) hands should come together in front of seu(s) peito, palmas na direção indicada. Return seu(s) arms costas até a posição inicial after a brief pause.

name: Low Cabo Triceps Extensão
instructions: Select desired weight e lay down face up on banco of a seated row máquina that has a rope attached to it. seu(s) head should be pointing towards attachment. Grab outside of rope ends com seu(s) palmas na direção indicada (neutral grip). Position seu(s) cotovelo(s) so that they are bent at a 90 degree angle e seu(s) upper arms are perpendicular (90 degree angle) to seu(s) torso. Tip: Keep cotovelo(s) in e make sure that upper arms point to ceiling enquanto seu(s) forearms point towards pulley above seu(s) head. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, extend seu(s) lower arms até they are straight e vertical. upper arms e cotovelo(s) remain stationary throughout movement. Only forearms should move. Contract triceps hard for a second. As you breathe in slowly Retorne à posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Low Pulley Remada To Neck
instructions: Sit on a low pulley row máquina com a rope attachment. Grab ends of rope using a palms-down grip e sit com seu(s) costas straight e seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent. Tip: Keep seu(s) costas almost completely vertical e seu(s) arms fully extended in front of you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo seu(s) torso stationary, lift seu(s) cotovelo(s) e start bending them as you pull rope towards seu(s) neck enquanto exhaling. Throughout movement seu(s) upper arms should remain parallel to floor. Tip: Continue this motion até seu(s) hands are almost next to seu(s) ears ( forearms will not be parallel to floor at end of movement as they will be angled a bit upwards) e seu(s) cotovelo(s) are out away de seu(s) sides. After holding for a second or so at contracted position, come costas slowly até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Tip: Again, during no part of movement should torso move. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Lower Back-smr
instructions: In a seated position, place a foam roll under seu(s) lower costas. Cross seu(s) arms in front of you e protract seu(s) ombro(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) quadril off of floor e lean costas, mantendo seu(s) weight on seu(s) lower costas. Now shift seu(s) weight slightly to one side, mantendo seu(s) weight off of spine e on muscles to side of it. Roll over seu(s) lower costas, holding points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on other side.

name: Lower Back Rosca
instructions: Lie on seu(s) stomach com seu(s) arms out to seu(s) sides. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Using seu(s) lower costas muscles, extend seu(s) spine lifting seu(s) peito off of ground. Do not use seu(s) arms to push yourself up. Keep seu(s) head up during movement. Repeat for 10-20 repetições.

name: Afundo Pass Through
instructions: Stand com seu(s) torso upright holding a kettlebell in seu(s) right hand. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Step forward com seu(s) left foot e lower seu(s) upper body down by flexing quadril e joelho(s), mantendo torso upright. Lower seu(s) costas joelho(s) até it nearly touches ground. As you lunge, pass kettlebell under seu(s) front leg to seu(s) opposite hand. Pressing through heel of seu(s) foot, Retorne à posição inicial. Repeat movement for recommended amount of repetições, alternating legs.

name: Afundo Sprint
instructions: Adjust a bar in a Smith máquina to an appropriate height. Position yourself under bar, racking it across costas of seu(s) ombro(s). Unrack bar, e então split seu(s) feet, moving one foot forward e one foot costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower seu(s) costas joelho(s) nearly to ground, flexing joelho(s) e lowering seu(s) quadril as you do so. At bottom of descent, immediately reverse direction. Explosively drive through heel of seu(s) front foot com light pressure de seu(s) costas foot. Jump up e reverse position of seu(s) legs. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Bent Leg Groin
instructions: Deite-se de costas com seu(s) joelho(s) bent e soles of feet pressed together. Have seu(s) partner hold seu(s) joelho(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Attempt to squeeze seu(s) joelho(s) together, enquanto seu(s) partner prevents any movement de occurring. After 10-20 seconds, relax seu(s) muscles as seu(s) partner gently pushes seu(s) joelho(s) towards floor. Be sure to inform seu(s) helper when stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching.

name: Deitado Cabo Rosca
instructions: Grab a straight bar or E-Z bar attachment that is attached to low pulley com both hands, using an underhand (palmas na direção indicada) ombro(s)-width grip. Lie flat on seu(s) costas on top of an exercise mat in front of weight stack com seu(s) feet flat against frame of pulley máquina e seu(s) legs straight. com seu(s) arms extended e seu(s) cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) body slightly bend seu(s) arms. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo seu(s) upper arms stationary e cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) body, curl bar up slowly toward seu(s) peito as you breathe out e you squeeze biceps. After a second squeeze at top of movement, slowly Retorne à posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Cambered Remada com Barra
instructions: Place a cambered bar underneath an exercise banco. Deite-se de bruços on exercise banco e grab bar using a palms down (pronated grip) that is wider than ombro(s) width. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire row bar up as you keep cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) body to either seu(s) peito, in order to target upper mid costas, or to seu(s) stomach if targeting lats is seu(s) goal. After a second hold at top, lower costas down até a posição inicial slowly as you Inspire.

name: Deitado Pegada Fechada Bar Rosca no High Pulley
instructions: Place a flat banco in front of a high pulley or lat pulldown máquina. Hold straight bar attachment using an underhand grip (palms up) that is about ombro(s) width. Deite-se de costas com seu(s) head over end of banco. Now extend seu(s) arms straight above seu(s) ombro(s). seu(s) torso e seu(s) arms should make a 90-degree angle e cotovelo(s) should be in. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, curl bar down in a semicircular motion até it touches seu(s) chin. Squeeze biceps for a second at top contracted position. Tip: As you execute this motion only forearms should move. At no time should upper arms be moving at all. They are to remain perpendicular throughout movement. Return to posição inicial slowly. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Pegada Fechada Barra Triceps Extensão Behind Head
instructions: Enquanto holding a barra or EZ Curl bar com a pronated grip (palmas na direção indicada), Deite-se de costas on a flat banco com seu(s) head close to end of banco. Tip: If you are holding a barra grab it using a ombro(s)-width grip e if you are using an E-Z Bar grab it on inner pegadas. Extend seu(s) arms in front of you e slowly bring bar costas in a semi circular motion (enquanto mantendo arms extended) to a position over seu(s) head. At end of this step seu(s) arms should be overhead e parallel to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: Keep seu(s) cotovelo(s) in at all times. As you Inspire, lower bar by bending at cotovelo(s) e enquanto mantendo upper arm stationary. Keep lowering bar até seu(s) forearms are perpendicular to floor. As you Expire bring bar costas up até a posição inicial by pushing bar up in a semi-circular motion até lower arms are also parallel to floor. Contract triceps hard at top of movement for a second. Tip: Again, only forearms should move. upper arms should remain stationary at all times. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Pegada Fechada Barra Triceps Press To Chin
instructions: Enquanto holding a barra or EZ Curl bar com a pronated grip (palmas na direção indicada), Deite-se de costas on a flat banco com seu(s) head off end of banco. Tip: If you are holding a barra grab it using a ombro(s)-width grip e if you are using an E-Z Bar grab it on inner pegadas. Extend seu(s) arms in front of you as you hold barra over seu(s) peito. arms should be perpendicular to seu(s) torso (90-degree angle). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Inspire, lower bar in a semi-circular motion by bending at cotovelo(s) e enquanto mantendo upper arm stationary e cotovelo(s) in. Keep lowering bar até it lightly touches seu(s) chin. As you Expire bring bar costas up até a posição inicial by pushing bar up in a semi-circular motion. Contract triceps hard at top of movement for a second. Tip: Again, only forearms should move. upper arms should remain stationary at all times. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Crossover
instructions: Deite-se de costas com seu(s) legs extended. Cross one leg over seu(s) body com joelho(s) bent, attempting to touch joelho(s) to ground. seu(s) partner should kneel beside you, holding seu(s) ombro(s) down com one hand e controlling crossed leg com other. this will be seu(s) posição inicial. Attempt to raise bent joelho(s) off of ground as seu(s) partner prevents any actual movement. After 10-20 seconds, relax leg as seu(s) partner gently presses joelho(s) towards floor. Repeat com other side.

name: Deitado Halter Tricep Extensão
instructions: Lie on a flat banco enquanto holding two halter(es) directly in front of you. seu(s) arms should be fully extended at a 90-degree angle de seu(s) torso e floor. palms should be facing in e cotovelo(s) should be tucked in. This is posição inicial. As you breathe in e you keep upper arms stationary com cotovelo(s) in, slowly Abaixe a carga até halter(es) are near seu(s) ears. At that point, enquanto mantendo cotovelo(s) in e upper arms stationary, use triceps to bring weight costas up até a posição inicial as you breathe out. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Face Down Plate Neck Resistance
instructions: Deite-se de bruços com seu(s) whole body straight on a flat banco enquanto holding a weight plate behind seu(s) head. Tip: You will need to position yourself so that seu(s) ombro(s) are slightly above end of a flat banco in order for upper peito, neck e face to be off banco. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo plate secure on costas of seu(s) head Abaixe lentamente seu(s) head (as in saying "yes") as you breathe in. Raise seu(s) head costas up até a posição inicial in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out. Hold contraction for a second. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Face Up Plate Neck Resistance
instructions: Lie face up com seu(s) whole body straight on a flat banco enquanto holding a weight plate on top of seu(s) forehead. Tip: You will need to position yourself so that seu(s) ombro(s) are slightly above end of a flat banco in order for traps, neck e head to be off banco. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo plate secure on seu(s) forehead Abaixe lentamente seu(s) head costas in a semi-circular motion as you breathe in. Raise seu(s) head costas up até a posição inicial in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out. Hold contraction for a second. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Glute
instructions: Deite-se de costas com seu(s) partner kneeling beside you. Flex quadril of one leg, raising it off of floor. Rotate leg so foot is over opposite quadril, lower leg perpendicular to seu(s) body. seu(s) partner should hold joelho(s) e ankle in place. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Attempt to push seu(s) leg towards seu(s) partner, who should be preventing any actual movement of leg. After 10-20 seconds, completely relax as seu(s) partner gently pushes ankle e joelho(s) towards seu(s) peito. Be sure to inform seu(s) helper when stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching.

name: Deitado Hamstring
instructions: Deite-se de costas com seu(s) legs extended. seu(s) partner should be kneeling beside you. Raise one leg up towards ceiling e have seu(s) partner hold ankle. seu(s) partner can use their ombro(s) to brace seu(s) leg if necessary. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com seu(s) partner holding seu(s) leg in place, attempt to flex joelho(s), contracting hamstrings for 10-20 seconds. então relax seu(s) leg, allowing seu(s) partner to gently push leg towards seu(s) head. Be sure to inform seu(s) helper when stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching. Switch sides once complete.

name: Deitado High Bench Rosca Direta com Barra
instructions: Lie face forward on a tall flat banco enquanto holding a barra com a supinated grip (palmas na direção indicada). Tip: If you are holding a barra grab it using a ombro(s)-width grip e if you are using an E-Z Bar grab it on inner pegadas. seu(s) upper body should be positioned in a way that upper peito is over end of banco e barra is hanging in front of you com arms extended e perpendicular to floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo cotovelo(s) in e upper arms stationary, curl weight up in a semi-circular motion as you contract biceps e Expire. Hold at top of movement for a second. As you Inspire, slowly go costas até a posição inicial. Tip: Maintain full control of weight at all times e avoid any swinging. Remember, only forearms should move throughout movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Mesa Flexoras
instructions: Adjust máquina lever to fit seu(s) height e Deite-se de bruços on leg curl máquina com pad of lever on costas of seu(s) legs (just a few inches under calves). Tip: Preferably use a leg curl máquina that is angled as opposed to flat since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment. mantendo torso flat on banco, ensure seu(s) legs are fully stretched e grab side pegadas of máquina. Position seu(s) toes straight (or you can also use any of other two stances described on foot positioning section). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, curl seu(s) legs up o máximo possível without lifting upper legs de pad. Once you hit fully contracted position, hold it for a second. As you Inspire, bring legs costas to initial position. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Máquina Agachamento
instructions: Adjust leg máquina to a height that will allow you to get inside it com seu(s) joelho(s) bent e thighs slightly below parallel. Once you select weight, position yourself inside máquina face up com joelho(s) bent e thighs slightly below parallel to platform. Make sure that joelho(s) do not go past toes. angle created between hamstrings e calves should be one that is slightly less than 90 degrees (since seu(s) posição inicial requires you to start slightly below parallel). seu(s) costas e seu(s) head should be resting on máquina enquanto seu(s) ombro(s) are pressed under ombro(s) pads. Place seu(s) hands by pegadas e position seu(s) feet slightly pointing out at a ombro(s) width position. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto pressing com balls of feet as you breathe out, make seu(s) whole body erect as you squeeze quads. Hold contracted position for a second. Tip: Since you are starting below parallel, you can opt to use seu(s) hands to help you up by pressing on seu(s) thighs only on first repetições. Slowly squat down as you Inspire but instead of going all way down até a posição inicial, just stop once seu(s) thighs are parallel to platform. angle between seu(s) hamstrings e calves should be a 90-degree angle. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado One-arm Elevação Lateral
instructions: Enquanto holding a halter(es) in one hand, lay com seu(s) peito down on a flat banco. other hand can be used to hold to leg of banco for stability. Position palm of hand that is holding halter(es) in a neutral manner (palms facing seu(s) torso) as you keep arm extended com cotovelo(s) slightly bent. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now raise arm com halter(es) to side até seu(s) cotovelo(s) is at ombro(s) height e seu(s) arm is roughly parallel to floor as you Expire. Tip: Maintain seu(s) arm perpendicular to torso enquanto mantendo seu(s) arm extended throughout movement. Also, keep contraction at top for a second. Slowly Abaixe a carga até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado de Bruços Quadriceps
instructions: Lay face down on floor com seu(s) partner kneeling beside you. Flex one joelho(s) e raise that leg off ground, attempting to touch seu(s) glúteo(s) com seu(s) foot. seu(s) partner should hold joelho(s) e ankle. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Attempt to extend seu(s) joelho(s) enquanto seu(s) partner prevents any actual movement. After 10-20 seconds, relax seu(s) muscles as seu(s) partner gently pushes foot towards seu(s) glúteo(s), further stretching quadriceps e quadril flexors. After 10-20 seconds, switch sides.

name: Deitado Rear Delt Elevação
instructions: Enquanto holding a halter(es) in each hand, lay com seu(s) peito down on a flat banco. Position palms of hands in a neutral manner (palms facing seu(s) torso) as you keep arms extended com cotovelo(s) slightly bent. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now raise arms to side até seu(s) cotovelo(s) are at ombro(s) height e seu(s) arms are roughly parallel to floor as you Expire. Tip: Maintain seu(s) arms perpendicular to torso enquanto mantendo them extended throughout movement. Also, keep contraction at top for a second. Slowly Abaixe a carga até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então switch to other arm.

name: Deitado de Costas Rosca Direta com Halteres
instructions: Lie down on a flat banco face up enquanto holding a halter(es) in each arm on top of seu(s) thighs. Bring halter(es) to sides com arms extended e palms of hands facing seu(s) thighs (neutral grip). enquanto mantendo arms close to seu(s) torso e cotovelo(s) in, Abaixe lentamente seu(s) arms (as you keep them extended com a slight bend at cotovelo(s)) as far down towards floor as you can go. Once you cannot go down any further, lock seu(s) upper arms in that position e that will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, slowly begin to curl weights up as you simultaneously rotate seu(s) wrists so that palms of hands face up. Continue curling weight até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e squeeze hard at top position for a second. Tip: Only forearms should move. Upper arms should remain stationary e cotovelo(s) should stay in throughout movement. Return costas até a posição inicial very slowly.

name: Deitado Remada Cavalinho
instructions: Load up T-bar Row máquina com desired weight e adjust leg height so that seu(s) upper peito is at top of pad. Tip: In some machines all you can do is stand on appropriate step that allows you to be at a height that has upper peito at top of pad. Lay face down on pad e grab pegadas. You can either use a palms down, palms up, or palms in position depending on what part of seu(s) costas you want to emphasize. Lift bar off rack e extend seu(s) arms in front of you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire slowly pull weight up e squeeze seu(s) costas at top of movement. Tip: Keep upper arms as close to torso as possible throughout movement in order to better engage costas muscles. Also, do not lift seu(s) body off of pad at any time e refrain de using biceps to lift weight. After a second contraction at top of movement, as you Inspire, slowly go costas down até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Deitado Triceps Press
instructions: Lie on a flat banco com either an e-z bar (my preference) or a straight bar placed on floor behind seu(s) head e seu(s) feet on floor. Grab bar behind you, using a medium overhand (pronated) grip, e raise bar in front of you at arms length. Tip: arms should be perpendicular to torso e floor. cotovelo(s) should be tucked in. This is posição inicial. As you breathe in, slowly Abaixe a carga até bar lightly touches seu(s) forehead enquanto mantendo upper arms e cotovelo(s) stationary. At that point, use triceps to bring weight costas up até a posição inicial as you breathe out. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Máquina Bench Press
instructions: Sente-se on peito Press máquina e select weight. Step on lever provided by máquina since it will help you to bring pegadas forward so that you can grab pegadas e fully extend arms. Grab pegadas com a palms-down grip e lift seu(s) cotovelo(s) so that seu(s) upper arms are parallel to floor to sides of seu(s) torso. Tip: seu(s) forearms will be pointing forward since you are grabbing pegadas. Once you bring pegadas forward e extend arms you will be at posição inicial. Now bring pegadas costas towards you as you breathe in. Push pegadas away de you as you flex seu(s) pecs e you breathe out. Hold contraction for a second before going costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. When finished step on lever again e slowly get pegadas costas to their original place.

name: Máquina Bicep Rosca
instructions: Adjust seat to appropriate height e make seu(s) weight selection. Place seu(s) upper arms against pads e segure a barra/pegadas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Perform movement by flexing cotovelo(s), pulling seu(s) lower arm towards seu(s) upper arm. Pause at top of movement, e então Retorne lentamente weight até a posição inicial. Avoid returning weight all way to stops até set is complete to keep tension on muscles being worked.

name: Máquina Rosca Scotts
instructions: Sente-se on Preacher Curl máquina e select weight. Place costas of seu(s) upper arms (seu(s) triceps) on preacher pad provided e grab pegadas using an underhand grip (palmas na direção indicada). Tip: Make sure that when you place arms on pad you keep cotovelo(s) in. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now lift pegadas as you Expire e you contract biceps. At top of position make sure that you hold contraction for a second. Tip: Only forearms should move. upper arms should remain stationary e on pad at all times. Lower pegadas slowly costas até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Máquina Shoulder (military) Press
instructions: Sente-se on ombro(s) Press máquina e select weight. Grab pegadas to seu(s) sides as you keep cotovelo(s) bent e in line com seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now lift pegadas as you Expire e you extend arms fully. At top of position make sure that you hold contraction for a second. Lower pegadas slowly costas até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Máquina Triceps Extensão
instructions: Adjust seat to appropriate height e make seu(s) weight selection. Place seu(s) upper arms against pads e segure a barra/pegadas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Perform movement by extending cotovelo(s), pulling seu(s) lower arm away de seu(s) upper arm. Pause at completion of movement, e então Retorne lentamente weight até a posição inicial. Avoid returning weight all way to stops até set is complete to keep tension on muscles being worked.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
instructions: You will need a partner for this exercise. Lacking one, this movement can be performed against a wall. Begin facing seu(s) partner holding medicine ball at seu(s) torso com both hands. Pull ball to seu(s) peito, e reverse motion by extending through cotovelo(s). For sports applications, you can take a step as you throw. seu(s) partner should catch ball, e throw it costas to you. Receive throw com both hands at peito height.

name: Medicine Ball Full Twist
instructions: For this exercise you will need a medicine ball e a partner. Stand costas to costas com seu(s) partner, spaced 2-3 feet apart. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Hold ball in front of trunk. Open quadril e turn ombro(s) at same time as seu(s) partner. For full rotation, you e seu(s) partner should twist in same direction, i.e. counter-clockwise. Pass ball to seu(s) partner, e both of you can now twist in opposite direction to repeat procedure.

name: Medicine Ball Scoop Throw
instructions: Assume a semisquat stance com a medicine ball in seu(s) hands. seu(s) arms should hang so ball is near seu(s) feet. Begin by thrusting quadril forward as you extend through legs, jumping up. As you do, swing seu(s) arms up e over seu(s) head, mantendo them extended, releasing ball at peak of seu(s) movement. goal is to throw ball greatest distance behind you.

name: Middle Back Encolhimento
instructions: Lie facedown on an incline banco enquanto holding a halter(es) in each hand. seu(s) arms should be fully extended hanging down e pointing towards floor. palms of seu(s) hands should be facing each other. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, contraia a musculatura alvo together e hold contraction for a full second. Tip: This movement is just like reverse action of a hug, or trying to perform rear laterals as if you had no arms. As you Inspire go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Middle Back Alongamento
instructions: Stand so seu(s) feet are ombro(s) width apart e seu(s) hands are on seu(s) quadril. Twist at seu(s) waist até you feel a stretch. Hold for 10 to 15 seconds, então twist to other side.

name: Mixed Grip Chin
instructions: Using a spacing that is just about 1 inch wider than ombro(s) width, grab a pull-up bar com palms of one hand facing forward e palms of other hand facing towards you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now start to pull yourself up as you Expire. Tip: com arm that has palmas na direção indicada concentrate on using costas muscles in order to perform movement. cotovelo(s) of that arm should remain close to torso. com other arm that has palmas na direção indicada, cotovelo(s) will be away but in line com torso. You will concentrate on using lats to pull seu(s) body up. After a second contraction at top, start to slowly come down as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. On following set, switch grips; so if you had right hand com palms facing you e left one com palmas na direção indicada, on next set you will have palmas na direção indicada for right hand e facing you for left.

name: Monster Walk
instructions: Place a band around both ankles e another around both joelho(s). There should be enough tension that they are tight when seu(s) feet are ombro(s) width apart. To begin, take short steps forward alternating seu(s) left e right foot. After several steps, do just opposite e walk backward to where you started.

name: Escaladors
instructions: Begin in a pushup position, com seu(s) weight supported by seu(s) hands e toes. Flexing joelho(s) e quadril, bring one leg até joelho(s) is approximately under quadril. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Explosively reverse positions of seu(s) legs, extending bent leg até leg is straight e supported by toe, e bringing other foot up com quadril e joelho(s) flexed. Repeat in an alternating fashion for 20-30 seconds.

name: Moving Claw Series
instructions: This move helps prepare seu(s) running form to help you excel at sprinting. As you run, be sure to flex joelho(s), aiming to kick seu(s) glúteo(s) as quadril extends. Reload quad as leg moves costas forward, attacking ground on next step. Ensure that as you run, you block com arms, punching through in a rapid 1-2 motion.

name: Muscle Snatch
instructions: Begin com a loaded barra held at mid thigh position com a wide grip. feet should be directly below quadril, com feet turned out as needed. Lower quadril, com peito up e head looking forward. ombro(s) should be just in front of bar. This will be posição inicial. Begin pull by driving through front of heels, raising bar. Transition em second pull by extending through quadril joelho(s) e ankles, driving bar up as quickly as possible. bar should be close to body. Continue raising bar to overhead position, without rebending joelho(s).

name: Muscle Up
instructions: Grip rings using a false grip, com base of seu(s) palms on top of rings. Initiate a pull up by pulling cotovelo(s) down to seu(s) side, flexing cotovelo(s). As you reach top position of pull-up, pull rings to seu(s) armpits as you roll seu(s) ombro(s) forward, allowing seu(s) cotovelo(s) to move straight costas behind you. This puts you em proper position to continue em dip portion of movement. Maintaining control e stability, extend through cotovelo(s) to complete motion. Use care when lowering yourself to ground.

name: Narrow Stance Hack Squats
instructions: Place costas of seu(s) torso against costas pad of máquina e hook seu(s) ombro(s) under ombro(s) pads provided. Position seu(s) legs in platform using a less than ombro(s) width narrow stance com toes slightly pointed out. seu(s) feet should be around 3 inches or less apart. Tip: Keep seu(s) head up at all times e also maintain costas on pad at all times. Place seu(s) arms on side pegadas of máquina e disengage safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving side pegadas de a facing front position to a diagonal position). Now straighten seu(s) legs without locking joelho(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin to Abaixe lentamente unit by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up (costas on pad at all times). Continue down até angle between upper leg e calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is point in which upper legs are below parallel to floor). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Begin to raise unit as you Expire by pushing floor com mainly com heels of seu(s) feet as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Narrow Stance Leg Press
instructions: Using a leg press máquina, Sente-se on máquina e place seu(s) legs on platform directly in front of you at a less-than-ombro(s)-width narrow stance com toes slightly pointed out. seu(s) feet should be around 3 inches or less apart. Tip: Keep seu(s) head up at all times e also maintain costas on pad at all times. Lower safety bars holding weighted platform in place e press platform all way up até seu(s) legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) torso e legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Inspire, Abaixe lentamente platform até seu(s) upper e lower legs make a 90-degree angle. Pushing mainly com heels of seu(s) feet e using quadriceps go costas até a posição inicial as you Expire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e ensure to lock safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.

name: Narrow Stance Squats
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set bar on a rack that best matches seu(s) height. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, step under bar e place costas of seu(s) ombro(s) (slightly below neck) across it. Hold on to bar using both arms at each side e lift it off rack by first pushing com seu(s) legs e at same time straightening seu(s) torso. Step away de rack e position seu(s) legs using a less-than-ombro(s)-width narrow stance com toes slightly pointed out. Feet should be around 3-6 inches apart. Keep seu(s) head up at all times (looking down will get you off balance) e maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. (Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances discussed in foot stances section). Begin to Abaixe lentamente bar by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até angle between upper leg e calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is point in which upper legs are below parallel to floor). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor com heel of seu(s) foot mainly as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Natural Glute Ham Elevação
instructions: Using leg pad of a lat pulldown máquina or a preacher banco, position yourself so that seu(s) ankles are under pads, joelho(s) on seat, e you are facing away de máquina. You should be upright e maintaining good posture. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower yourself under control até seu(s) joelho(s) are almost completely straight. Remaining in control, raise yourself costas up até a posição inicial. If you are unable to complete a repetições, use a band, a partner, or push off of a box to aid in completing a repetições.

name: Neck-smr
instructions: Using a muscle roller or a rolling pin, place roller behind seu(s) head e against seu(s) neck. Make sure that you do not place roller directly against spine, but turned slightly so that roller is pressed against muscles to either side of spine. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Starting at top of seu(s) neck, slowly roll down muscles of seu(s) neck, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds.

name: Neck Press
instructions: Lie costas on a flat banco. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in middle of movement between forearms e upper arms), lift bar de rack e hold it straight over seu(s) neck com seu(s) arms locked. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, come down slowly até you feel bar on seu(s) neck. After a second pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out e push bar using seu(s) peito muscles. Lock seu(s) arms e squeeze seu(s) peito in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up). Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place bar costas in rack.

name: Oblique Abdominal Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on floor com seu(s) lower costas pressed to ground. For this exercise, you will need to put one hand beside seu(s) head e other to side against floor. Make sure seu(s) feet are elevated e resting on a flat surface. Now lift ombro(s) in which seu(s) hand is touching seu(s) head. Simply elevate seu(s) ombro(s) e body upward até you touch seu(s) joelho(s). For example, if you have seu(s) right hand besides seu(s) head, então you want to elevate seu(s) body upwards até seu(s) right cotovelo(s) touches seu(s) left joelho(s). same variation can be applied doing inverse e using seu(s) left cotovelo(s) to touch seu(s) right joelho(s). After seu(s) joelho(s) touches seu(s) cotovelo(s), lower seu(s) body até you have reached posição inicial. Remember to breathe in during eccentric (lowering) part of exercise e to breathe out during concentric (upward) part of exercise. Continue alternating in this manner até all of recommended repetições for each side have been completed.

name: Oblique Abdominal Crunches - no Floor
instructions: Start out by lying on seu(s) right side com seu(s) legs lying on top of each other. Make sure seu(s) joelho(s) are bent a little bit. Place seu(s) left hand behind seu(s) head. Once you are in this set position, begin by moving seu(s) left cotovelo(s) up as you would perform a normal crunch except this time main emphasis is on seu(s) obliques. Crunch as high as you can, hold contraction for a second e então slowly drop costas down inaté a posição inicial. Remember to breathe in during eccentric (lowering) part of exercise e to breathe out during concentric (elevation) part of exercise.

name: Olympic Agachamento
instructions: Begin com a barra supported on top of traps. peito should be up, e head facing forward. Adopt a quadril width stance com feet turned out as needed. Descend by flexing joelho(s), refraining de moving quadril costas as much as possible. This requires that joelho(s) travel forward; ensure that they stay aligned com feet. goal is to keep torso as upright as possible. Continue all way down, mantendo weight on front of heel. At moment upper legs contact lower, reverse motion, driving weight upward.

name: No-your-back Quad Alongamento
instructions: Lie on a flat banco or step, e hang one leg e arm over side. Bend joelho(s) e hold top of foot. As you do this, be careful not to arch seu(s) lower costas. Pull belly button to spine to stay in neutral. Press seu(s) foot down e em seu(s) hand. To add quadril stretch, lift quadril of leg you're holding up toward ceiling. Switch sides.

name: No Your Side Quad Alongamento
instructions: Start off by lying on seu(s) right side, com seu(s) right joelho(s) bent at a 90-degree angle resting on floor in front of you (this stabilizes torso). Bend seu(s) left joelho(s) behind you e hold seu(s) left foot com seu(s) left hand. To stretch seu(s) quadril flexor, press seu(s) left quadril forward as you push seu(s) left foot costas em seu(s) hand. Switch sides.

name: One-arm Remada com Halter
instructions: Choose a flat banco e place a halter(es) on each side of it. Place right leg on top of end of banco, bend seu(s) torso forward de waist até seu(s) upper body is parallel to floor, e place seu(s) right hand on other end of banco for support. Use left hand to pick up halter(es) on floor e hold weight enquanto mantendo seu(s) lower costas straight. palm of hand should be facing seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull resistance straight up to side of seu(s) peito, mantendo seu(s) upper arm close to seu(s) side e mantendo torso stationary. Breathe out as you perform this step. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. Also, make sure that force is performed com costas muscles e not arms. Finally, upper torso should remain stationary e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work except for holding halter(es); therefore do not try to pull halter(es) up using forearms. Lower resistance straight down até a posição inicial. Breathe in as you perform this step. Repeat movement for specified amount of repetições. Switch sides e repeat again com other arm.

name: One-arm Reto Bench Crucifixo com Halterese
instructions: Lie down on a flat banco com a halter(es) in one hand resting on top of seu(s) thigh. palm of seu(s) hand com halter(es) in it should be at a neutral grip. By using seu(s) thighs to help you get halter(es) up, clean halter(es) so that you can hold it in front of you com seu(s) lifting arm being fully extended. Remember to maintain a neutral grip com this exercise. seu(s) non lifting hand should be to side holding flat banco for better support. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. seu(s) arm com weight should have a slight bend on seu(s) cotovelo(s) in order to prevent stress at biceps tendon. Begin by lowering seu(s) arm com weight in it out in a wide arc até you feel a stretch on seu(s) peito. Breathe in as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout movement, seu(s) lifting arm should remain stationary; movement should only occur at ombro(s) joint. Return seu(s) lifting arm costas até a posição inicial as you squeeze seu(s) peito muscles e breathe out. Tip: Make sure to use same arc of motion used to Abaixe a cargas. Hold for a second at contracted position e repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. Switch arms e repeat exercise.

name: One-arm High-pulley Cabo Side Bends
instructions: Connect a standard pegadas to a tower. Move cabo to highest pulley position. Stand com side to cabo. com one hand, reach up e grab pegadas com underhand grip. Pull down cabo até cotovelo(s) touches seu(s) side e pegadas is by seu(s) ombro(s). Position feet na largura do quadril. Place free hand on quadril to help gauge pivot point. Keep arm in static position. Contract oblique to bring weight down in a side crunch. Once you reach maximum contraction, slowly release weight até a posição inicial. weight stack should never be unloaded in a resting position. aim is constant tension during set. Repeat to failure. então, reposition e repeat same series of movements on opposite side.

name: One-arm Inclinado Elevação Lateral
instructions: Lie down sideways on an incline banco press com a halter(es) in hand. Make sure ombro(s) is pressing against incline banco e arm is lying across seu(s) body com palm around seu(s) navel. Hold a halter(es) in seu(s) uppermost arm enquanto mantendo it extended in front of you parallel to floor. This is seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo halter(es) parallel to floor at all times, perform a lateral raise. seu(s) arm should travel straight up até it is pointing at ceiling. Tip: Expire as you perform this movement. Hold halter(es) in position e feel contraction in ombro(s) for a second. enquanto inhaling Abaixe a carga across seu(s) body costas inaté a posição inicial. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. Switch arms e repeat movement.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Place a kettlebell between seu(s) feet. As you bend down to grab kettlebell, push seu(s) butt costas e keep seu(s) eyes looking forward. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you raise kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). wrist should rotate as you do so. Return weight até a posição inicial.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Clean e Jerk
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by pegadas. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so, so that palm faces forward. Dip seu(s) body by bending joelho(s), mantendo seu(s) torso upright. Immediately reverse direction, driving through heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending arms, using seu(s) body's momentum to move weight. Receive weight overhead by returning to a squat position underneath weight. mantendo weight overhead, return to a standing position. Abaixe a carga to floor to perform next repetições.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor holding a kettlebell com one hand, com seu(s) upper arm supported by floor. palm should be facing in. Press kettlebell straight up toward ceiling, rotating seu(s) wrist. Lower kettlebell costas até a posição inicial e repeat.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Jerk
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by pegadas. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so, so that palm faces forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Dip seu(s) body by bending joelho(s), mantendo seu(s) torso upright. Immediately reverse direction, driving through heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending arms, using seu(s) body's momentum to move weight. Receive weight overhead by returning to a squat position underneath weight. mantendo weight overhead, return to a standing position. Abaixe a carga to perform next repetições.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Desenvolvimento Militar To Side
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so, so that palm faces inward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Look at kettlebell e press it up e out até it is locked out overhead. Lower kettlebell costas to seu(s) ombro(s) under control e repeat. Make sure to contract seu(s) lat, butt, e stomach forcefully for added stability e strength.

name: One-arm Kettlebell para Press
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so, so that palm faces forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Hold kettlebell com cotovelo(s) out to side, e press it up e out até it is locked out overhead. Lower kettlebell costas to seu(s) ombro(s) under control e repeat. Make sure to contract seu(s) lat, butt, e stomach forcefully for added stability e strength.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Push Press
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by pegadas. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so, so that palm faces forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Dip seu(s) body by bending joelho(s), mantendo seu(s) torso upright. Immediately reverse direction, driving through heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending arms, using seu(s) body's momentum to move weight. Abaixe a carga to perform next repetições.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Remada
instructions: Place a kettlebell in front of seu(s) feet. Flexione os joelhos slightly e então push seu(s) butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in posição inicial. Grab kettlebell e pull it to seu(s) stomach, retracting seu(s) ombro(s) blade e flexing cotovelo(s). Mantenha as costas retas. Lower e repeat.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Place a kettlebell between seu(s) feet. Flexione os joelhos e push seu(s) butt costas to get in proper posição inicial. Look straight ahead e swing kettlebell costas between seu(s) legs. Immediately reverse direction e drive through com seu(s) quadril e joelho(s), accelerating kettlebell upward. As kettlebell rises to seu(s) ombro(s) rotate seu(s) hand e punch straight up, using momentum to receive weight locked out overhead.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Split Jerk
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by pegadas. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so, so that palm faces forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Dip seu(s) body by bending joelho(s), mantendo seu(s) torso upright. Immediately reverse direction, driving through heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending arms, using seu(s) body's momentum to move weight. Receive weight overhead by returning to a squat position underneath weight, positioning one leg in front of you e one leg behind you. mantendo weight overhead, return to a standing position e bring seu(s) feet together. Abaixe a carga to perform next repetições.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Split Snatch
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand by pegadas. Squat towards floor, e então reverse motion, extending quadril, joelho(s), e finally ankles, to raise kettlebell overhead. After fully extending body, descend em a lunge position to receive weights overhead, one leg forward e one leg costas. Ensure you drive through com seu(s) quadril e lock ketttlebells overhead in one uninterrupted motion. Return to a standing position, holding weight overhead, e bring feet together. Abaixe a carga to Retorne à posição inicial.

name: One-arm Kettlebell Swings
instructions: Execute o movimento com controle, boa postura e amplitude completa.

name: One-arm Long Bar Remada
instructions: Position a bar em a landmine or in a corner to keep it de moving. Load an appropriate weight onto seu(s) end. Stand next to bar, e take a grip com one hand close to collar. Using seu(s) quadril e legs, rise to a standing position. Assume a bent-joelho(s) stance com seu(s) quadril costas e seu(s) peito up. seu(s) arm should be extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull weight to seu(s) side by retracting ombro(s) e flexing cotovelo(s). Do not jerk weight or cheat during movement. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial.

name: One-arm Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Start in a standing position com a staggered, athletic stance. Hold a medicine ball in one hand, on same side as seu(s) costas leg. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by winding arm, raising medicine ball above seu(s) head. As you do so, extend through quadril, joelho(s), e ankles to load up for slam. At peak extension, flex ombro(s), spine, e quadril to throw ball hard em ground directly in front of you. Catch ball on bounce e continue for número desejado de repetições.

name: One-arm Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Place one kettlebell between seu(s) feet. Grab pegadas com one hand e raise kettlebell rapidly, let it flip so that ball of kettlebell lands in palm of seu(s) hand. Throw kettlebell out in front of you e catch pegadas com one hand. Take kettlebell to floor e repeat. Make sure to work both arms.

name: One-arm Acima da Cabeç Kettlebell Squats
instructions: Clean e press a kettlebell com one arm. Clean kettlebell to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you pull kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrist as you do so. Pressione a carga para cima by extending through cotovelo(s).This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Looking straight ahead e mantendo a kettlebell locked out above you, flex joelho(s) e quadril e lower seu(s) torso between seu(s) legs, mantendo seu(s) head e peito up. Pause at bottom position for a second before rising costas to top, driving through heels of seu(s) feet.

name: One-arm Side Levantamento Terra
instructions: Stand to side of a barra next to its center. Flexione os joelhos e lower seu(s) body até you are able to reach barra. segure a barra/pegadas as if you were grabbing a briefcase (palms facing you since bar is sideways). You may need a wrist wrap if you are using a significant amount of weight. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Use seu(s) legs to help lift barra up enquanto exhaling. seu(s) arms should extend fully as bring barra up até you are in a standing position. Slowly bring barra costas down enquanto inhaling. Tip: Make sure to Flexione os joelhos enquanto lowering weight to avoid any injury de occurring. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. Switch arms e repeat movement.

name: One-arm Side Laterals
instructions: Pick a halter(es) e place it in one of seu(s) hands. seu(s) non lifting hand should be used to grab something steady such as an incline banco press. Lean towards seu(s) lifting arm e away de hand that is gripping incline banco as this will allow you to keep seu(s) balance. Stand com a straight torso e have halter(es) by seu(s) side at arm's length com palm of hand facing you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto maintaining torso stationary (no swinging), lift halter(es) to seu(s) side com a slight bend on cotovelo(s) e seu(s) hand slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up até you arm is parallel to floor. Expire as you execute this movement e pause for a second at top. Abaixe a carga costas down slowly até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. Switch arms e repeat exercise.

name: One-legged Cabo Kickback
instructions: Hook a leather ankle cuff to a low cabo pulley e então attach cuff to seu(s) ankle. Face weight stack de a distance of about two feet, grasping steel frame for support. enquanto mantendo seu(s) joelho(s) e quadril bent slightly e seu(s) abs tight, contract seu(s) glúteo(s) to slowly "kick" working leg costas in a semicircular arc as high as it will comfortably go as you breathe out. Tip: At full extension, contraia a musculatura alvo for a second in order to achieve a peak contraction. Now slowly bring seu(s) working leg forward, resisting pull of cabo até you reach posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. Switch legs e repeat movement for other side.

name: Unilateral Against Wall
instructions: De a standing position, place a bent arm against a wall or doorway. Slowly lean toward seu(s) arm até you feel a stretch in seu(s) lats.

name: Unilateral Barra Fixa (pegada Supinada)
instructions: For this exercise, start out by placing a towel around a chin up bar. Grab chin-up bar com seu(s) palm facing you. One hand will be grabbing chin-up bar e other will be grabbing towel. Bring seu(s) torso costas around 30 degrees or so enquanto creating a curvature on seu(s) lower costas e sticking seu(s) peito out. This is seu(s) posição inicial.v Pull seu(s) torso up até bar touches seu(s) upper peito by drawing ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas. Expire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work other than hold bar. After a second on contracted position, start to Inspire e Abaixe lentamente seu(s) torso costas até a posição inicial when seu(s) arms are fully extended e lats are fully stretched. Repeat this motion for prescribed amount of repetições. Switch arms e repeat movement.

name: Unilateral Supino com Halteres
instructions: Lie down on a flat banco com a halter(es) in one hand on top of seu(s) thigh. By using seu(s) thigh to help you get halter(es) up, clean halter(es) up so that you can hold it in front of you at ombro(s) width. Use hand you are not lifting com to help position halter(es) over you properly. Once at ombro(s) width, rotate seu(s) wrist forward so that palm of seu(s) hand is facing away de you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Bring down weights slowly to seu(s) side as you breathe in. Keep full control of halter(es) at all times. Tip: Use hand that you are not lifting com to help keep halter(es) balance as you may struggle a bit at first. Only use seu(s) non-lifting hand if it is needed. Otherwise, keep it resting to side. As you breathe out, push halter(es) up using seu(s) pectoral muscles. Lock seu(s) arms in contracted position, squeeze seu(s) peito, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições of seu(s) training program. Switch arms e repeat movement.

name: Unilateral Halter Rosca Scott
instructions: Grab a halter(es) com right arm e place upper arm on top of preacher banco or incline banco. halter(es) should be held at ombro(s) length. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, slowly Abaixe a carga até seu(s) upper arm is extended e biceps is fully stretched. As you Expire, use biceps to curl weight up até seu(s) biceps is fully contracted e halter(es) is at ombro(s) height. Again, remember that to ensure full contraction you need to bring that small finger higher than thumb. Squeeze biceps hard for a second at contracted position e repeat for recommended amount of repetições. Switch arms e repeat movement.

name: Unilateral Floor Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat surface com seu(s) costas pressing against floor or an exercise mat. Make sure seu(s) joelho(s) are bent. Have a partner hand you bar on one hand. When starting, seu(s) arm should be just about fully extended, similar até a posição inicial of a barra banco press. However, this time seu(s) grip will be neutral (palms facing seu(s) torso). Make sure hand you are not using to lift weight is placed by seu(s) side. Begin exercise by lowering barra até seu(s) cotovelo(s) touches ground. Make sure to breathe in as this is eccentric (lowering part of exercise). então start lifting barra costas up to original posição inicial. Remember to breathe out during concentric (lifting part of exercise). Repeat até you have performed seu(s) recommended repetições. Switch arms e repeat movement.

name: Unilateral Puxada Alta
instructions: Select an appropriate weight e adjust joelho(s) pad to help keep you down. segure a barra/pegadas com a pronated grip. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Pull pegadas down, squeezing seu(s) cotovelo(s) to seu(s) side as you flex cotovelo(s). Pause at bottom of motion, e então Retorne lentamente pegadas até a posição inicial. For multiple repetições, avoid completely returning weight to keep tension on muscles being worked.

name: Unilateral Pronated Halter Triceps Extensão
instructions: Deite-se em um banco enquanto holding a halter(es) at arms length. seu(s) arm should be perpendicular to seu(s) body. palm of seu(s) hand should be facing towards seu(s) feet as a pronated grip is required to perform this exercise. Place seu(s) non lifting hand on seu(s) bicep for support. Slowly begin to Abaixe a carga down as you breathe in. então, begin lifting halter(es) upward as you contract triceps. Remember to breathe out during concentric (lifting part of exercise). Repeat até you have performed seu(s) set repetições. Switch arms e repeat movement.

name: Unilateral Supinated Halter Triceps Extensão
instructions: Deite-se em um banco enquanto holding a halter(es) at arms length. seu(s) arm should be perpendicular to seu(s) body. palm of seu(s) hand should be facing towards seu(s) face as a supinated grip is required to perform this exercise. Place seu(s) non lifting hand on seu(s) bicep for support. Slowly begin to Abaixe a carga down as you breathe in. então, begin lifting halter(es) upward as you contract triceps. Remember to breathe out during concentric (lifting part of exercise). Repeat até you have performed seu(s) set repetições. Switch arms e repeat movement. Switch arms again e repeat movement.

name: One Half Locust
instructions: Lie facedown on floor. Put seu(s) left hand under seu(s) left hipbone to pad seu(s) quadril e pubic bone. Bend seu(s) right joelho(s) so you can hold foot in seu(s) right hand. Lift foot in air e simultaneously lift seu(s) ombro(s) off floor. This also stretches right quadril flexor e peito e ombro(s). Switch sides. If it doesn't bother seu(s) costas, you can try it com both arms e legs at same time.

name: One Handed Hang
instructions: Grab onto a chinup bar com one hand, using a pronated grip. Keep seu(s) feet on floor or a step. Allow majority of seu(s) weight to hang de that hand, enquanto mantendo seu(s) feet on ground. Hold for 10-20 seconds e switch sides.

name: One Knee To Chest
instructions: Start off by lying on floor. Extend one leg straight e pull other joelho(s) to seu(s) peito. Hold under joelho(s) joint to protect kneecap. Gently tug that joelho(s) toward seu(s) nose. Switch sides. This stretches buttocks e lower costas of bent leg e quadril flexor of straight leg.

name: Unilateral Barra Agachamento
instructions: Start by standing about 2 to 3 feet in front of a flat banco com seu(s) costas facing banco. Have a barra in front of you on floor. Tip: seu(s) feet should be ombro(s) width apart de each other. Bend joelho(s) e use a pronated grip com seu(s) hands being wider than ombro(s) width apart de each other to lift barra up até you can rest it on seu(s) peito. então lift barra over seu(s) head e rest it on base of seu(s) neck. Move one foot costas so that seu(s) toe is resting on flat banco. seu(s) other foot should be stationary in front of you. Keep seu(s) head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance e also maintain a straight costas. Tip: Make sure seu(s) costas is straight e peito is out enquanto performing this exercise. As you Inspire, Abaixe lentamente seu(s) leg até seu(s) thigh is parallel to floor. At this point, seu(s) joelho(s) should be over seu(s) toes. seu(s) peito should be directly above middle of seu(s) thigh. Leading com peito e quadril e contracting quadriceps, elevate seu(s) leg costas até a posição inicial as you Expire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. Switch legs e repeat movement.

name: Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Place one kettlebell between seu(s) feet. Clean kettlebell by extending through legs e quadril as you raise kettlebell towards seu(s) ombro(s). Release kettlebell as it comes up, e let it flip so that ball of kettlebell lands in palms of seu(s) hands. Release kettlebell out in front of you e catch pegadas com both hands. Lower kettlebell até a posição inicial e repeat.

name: Otis-up
instructions: Secure seu(s) feet e lay costas on floor. seu(s) joelho(s) should be bent. Hold a weight com both hands to seu(s) peito. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by flexing quadril e spine to raise seu(s) torso up de ground. As you move up, Pressione a carga para cima so that it is above seu(s) head at top of movement. Return weight to seu(s) peito as you reverse sit-up motion, ensuring not to go all way down to floor.

name: Acima da Cabeç Cabo Rosca
instructions: To begin, set a weight that is comfortable on each side of pulley máquina. Note: Make sure that amount of weight selected is same on each side. Now adjust height of pulleys on each side e make sure that they are positioned at a height higher than that of seu(s) ombro(s). Stand in middle of both sides e use an underhand grip (palms facing towards ceiling) to grab each pegadas. seu(s) arms should be fully extended e parallel to floor com seu(s) feet positioned ombro(s) width apart de each other. seu(s) body should be evenly aligned pegadas. This is posição inicial. enquanto exhaling, slowly squeeze biceps on each side até seu(s) forearms e biceps touch. enquanto inhaling, move seu(s) forearms costas até a posição inicial. Note: seu(s) entire body is stationary during this exercise except for forearms. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições prescribed in seu(s) program.

name: Acima da Cabeç Lat
instructions: Sit upright on floor com seu(s) partner behind you. Raise one arm straight up, e flex cotovelo(s), attempting to touch seu(s) hand to seu(s) costas. seu(s) parner should hold seu(s) tricep e wrist. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Attempt to pull seu(s) upper arm to seu(s) side as seu(s) partner prevents you de doing actually doing so. After 10-20 seconds, relax arm e allow seu(s) partner to further stretch lat by applying gentle pressure to tricep. Hold for 10-20 seconds, e então switch sides.

name: Acima da Cabeç Slam
instructions: Hold a medine ball com both hands e Fique em pé com os pés at ombro(s) width. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate countermovement by raising ball above seu(s) head e fully extending seu(s) body. Reverse motion, slamming ball em ground directly in front of you as hard as you can. Receive ball com both hands on bounce e repeat movement.

name: Acima da Cabeç Agachamento
instructions: Start out by having a barra in front of you on floor. seu(s) feet should be wider than ombro(s) width apart de each other. Bend joelho(s) e use a pronated grip (palms facing you) to grab barra. seu(s) hands should be at a wider than ombro(s) width apart de each other before lifting. Once you are positioned, lift barra up até you can rest it on seu(s) peito. Move barra over e slightly behind seu(s) head e make sure seu(s) arms are fully extended. Keep seu(s) head up at all times e also maintain a straight costas. Retract seu(s) ombro(s) blades. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Slowly Abaixe a carga by bending seu(s) joelho(s) até seu(s) thighs are parallel to ground enquanto inhaling. Tip: Mantenha as costas retas enquanto performing this exercise to avoid any injuries e seu(s) arms should remain extended e over seu(s) head at all times. Now use seu(s) feet e legs to help bring weight costas up até a posição inicial enquanto exhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Acima da Cabeç Alongamento
instructions: Standing straight up, lace seu(s) fingers together e open seu(s) palms to ceiling. Keep seu(s) ombro(s) down as you extend seu(s) arms up. To create a full torso stretch, pull seu(s) tailbone down e stabilize seu(s) torso as you do this. Stretch muscles on both front e costas of torso.

name: Acima da Cabeç Triceps
instructions: Sit upright on floor com seu(s) partner behind you. Raise one arm straight up, e flex cotovelo(s), attempting to touch seu(s) hand to seu(s) costas. seu(s) parner should hold seu(s) cotovelo(s) e wrist. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Attempt to extend arm straight em air as seu(s) partner prevents you de doing actually doing so. After 10-20 seconds, relax arm e allow seu(s) partner to further stretch tricep by applying gentle pressure to wrist. Hold for 10-20 seconds, e então switch sides.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Connect a standard pegadas to a tower, e—if possible—position cabo to ombro(s) height. If not, a low pulley will suffice. com seu(s) side to cabo, grab pegadas com both hands e step away de tower. You should be approximately arm's length away de pulley, com tension of weight on cabo. com seu(s) feet positioned na largura do quadril e joelho(s) slightly bent, hold cabo to middle of seu(s) peito. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Press cabo away de seu(s) peito, fully extending both arms. You core should be tight e engaged. Hold repetições for several seconds before returning até a posição inicial. At conclusion of set, repeat facing other direction.

name: Pallof Press com Rotation
instructions: Connect a standard pegadas to a tower, e position cabo to ombro(s) height. com seu(s) side to cabo, grab pegadas com one hand e step away de tower. You should be approximately arm's length away de pulley, com tension of weight on cabo. Align outstretched arm com cabo. com seu(s) feet positioned na largura do quadril, pull cabo em seu(s) peito e grab pegadas com seu(s) other hand. Both hands should be on pegadas at this time. Facing forward, press cabo away de seu(s) peito. You core should be tight e engaged. mantendo seu(s) quadril straight, twist seu(s) torso away de pulley até you get a full quarter rotation. Maintain seu(s) rigid stance e straight arms. Return to neutral position in a slow e controlled manner. seu(s) arms should be extended in front of you. com side tension still engaging seu(s) core, bring seu(s) hands to seu(s) peito e immediately press outward to a fully extended position. This constitutes one repetições. Repeat to failure. então, reposition e repeat same series of movements on opposite side.

name: Palms-down Halter Wrist Rosca Over Bench
instructions: Start out by placing two halter(es) on one side of a flat banco. Kneel down on both of seu(s) joelho(s) so that seu(s) body is facing flat banco. Use seu(s) arms to grab both of halter(es) com a pronated grip (palmas na direção indicada) e bring them up so that seu(s) forearms are resting against flat banco. seu(s) wrists should be hanging over edge. Start out by curling seu(s) wrist upwards e exhaling. Abaixe lentamente seu(s) wrists costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. seu(s) forearms should be stationary as seu(s) wrist is only movement needed to perform this exercise. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Palms-down Wrist Rosca Over Bench
instructions: Start out by placing a barra on one side of a flat banco. Kneel down on both of seu(s) joelho(s) so that seu(s) body is facing flat banco. Use seu(s) arms to grab barra com a pronated grip (palms down) e bring them up so that seu(s) forearms are resting against flat banco. seu(s) wrists should be hanging over edge. Start out by curling seu(s) wrist upwards e exhaling. Abaixe lentamente seu(s) wrists costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. seu(s) forearms should be stationary as seu(s) wrist is only movement needed to perform this exercise. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Palms-up Barra Wrist Rosca Over Bench
