instructions: Start out by placing a barra on one side of a flat banco. Kneel down on both of seu(s) joelho(s) so that seu(s) body is facing flat banco. Use seu(s) arms to grab barra com a supinated grip (palms up) e bring them up so that seu(s) forearms are resting against flat banco. seu(s) wrists should be hanging over edge. Start out by curling seu(s) wrist upwards e exhaling. Abaixe lentamente seu(s) wrists costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. seu(s) forearms should be stationary as seu(s) wrist is only movement needed to perform this exercise. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Palms-up Halter Wrist Rosca Over Bench
instructions: Start out by placing two halter(es) on one side of a flat banco. Kneel down on both of seu(s) joelho(s) so that seu(s) body is facing flat banco. Use seu(s) arms to grab both of halter(es) com a supinated grip (palms up) e bring them up so that seu(s) forearms are resting against flat banco. seu(s) wrists should be hanging over edge. Start out by curling seu(s) wrist upwards e exhaling. Abaixe lentamente seu(s) wrists costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Make sure to Inspire during this part of exercise. seu(s) forearms should be stationary as seu(s) wrist is only movement needed to perform this exercise. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Parallel Bar Paralelas
instructions: Stand between a set of parallel bars. Place a hand on each bar, e então take a small jump to help you get inaté a posição inicial com seu(s) arms locked out. Begin by flexing cotovelo(s), lowering seu(s) body até seu(s) arms break 90 degrees. Avoid swinging, e maintain good posture throughout descent. Reverse motion by extending cotovelo(s), pushing yourself costas up inaté a posição inicial. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
instructions: Lie down com seu(s) feet on floor, heels directly under seu(s) joelho(s). Lift only seu(s) tailbone to ceiling to stretch seu(s) lower costas. (Don't lift entire spine yet.) Pull in seu(s) stomach. To go em a bridge, lift entire spine except neck.

name: Peroneals-smr
instructions: Lay on seu(s) side, supporting seu(s) weight on seu(s) forearm e on a foam roller placed on outside of seu(s) lower leg. seu(s) upper leg can either be on top of seu(s) lower leg, or you can cross it in front of you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) quadril off of ground e begin to roll de below joelho(s) to above ankle on side of seu(s) leg, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on other leg.

name: Peroneals Alongamento
instructions: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com leg extended e heel off of ground, pull on belt so that foot is inverted, com inside of foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, e então switch sides.

name: Physioball Hip Bridge
instructions: Lay on a ball so that seu(s) upper costas is on ball com seu(s) quadril unsupported. Both feet should be flat on floor, quadril width apart or wider. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by extending quadril using seu(s) glúteo(s) e hamstrings, raising seu(s) quadril upward as you bridge. Pause at top of motion e Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Pin Presses
instructions: Pin presses remove eccentric phase of banco press, developing starting strength. They also allow you to train a desired range of motion. banco should be set up in a power rack. Set pins to desired point in seu(s) range of motion, whether it just be lockout or an inch off of seu(s) peito. bar should be moved to pins e prepared for lifting. Begin by lying on banco, com bar directly above contact point during seu(s) regular banco. Tuck seu(s) feet underneath you e arch seu(s) costas. Using bar to help support seu(s) weight, lift seu(s) ombro(s) off banco e retract them, squeezing ombro(s) blades together. Use seu(s) feet to drive seu(s) traps em banco. Maintain this tight body position throughout movement. You can take a standard banco grip, or ombro(s) width to focus on triceps. bar, wrist, e cotovelo(s) should stay in line at all times. Focus on squeezing bar e trying to pull it apart. Drive bar up com as much force as possible. cotovelo(s) should be tucked in até lockout. Return bar to pins, pausing before beginning next repetições.

name: Piriformis-smr
instructions: Sit com seu(s) buttocks on top of a foam roll. Flexione os joelhos, e então cross one leg so that ankle is over joelho(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Shift seu(s) weight to side of crossed leg, rolling over buttocks até you feel tension in seu(s) upper glúteo(s). You may assist stretch by using one hand to pull bent joelho(s) towards seu(s) peito. Hold this position for 10-30 seconds, e então switch sides.

name: Prancha
instructions: Get em a prone position on floor, supporting seu(s) weight on seu(s) toes e seu(s) forearms. seu(s) arms are bent e directly below ombro(s). Keep seu(s) body straight at all times, e hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.

name: Plate Pinch
instructions: Grab two wide-rimmed plates e put them together com smooth sides facing outward Use seu(s) fingers to grip outside part of plate e seu(s) thumb for other side thus holding both plates together. This is posição inicial. Squeeze plate com seu(s) fingers e thumb. Hold this position for as long as you can. Repeat for recommended amount of sets prescribed in seu(s) program. Switch arms e repeat movements.

name: Plate Twist
instructions: Lie down on floor or an exercise mat com seu(s) legs fully extended e seu(s) upper body upright. Grab plate by its sides com both hands out in front of seu(s) abdominals com seu(s) arms slightly bent. Slowly cross seu(s) legs near seu(s) ankles e lift them up off ground. seu(s) joelho(s) should also be bent slightly. Note: Move seu(s) upper body costas slightly to help keep you balanced turning this exercise. This is posição inicial. Move plate to left side e touch floor com it. Breathe out as you perform that movement. Come costas até a posição inicial as you breathe in e então repeat movement but this time to right side of body. Tip: Use a slow controlled movement at all times. Jerking motions can injure costas. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Platform Hamstring Slides
instructions: For this movement a wooden floor or similar is needed. Lay on seu(s) costas com seu(s) legs extended. Place a gym towel or a light weight underneath seu(s) heel. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin movement by flexing joelho(s), mantendo seu(s) other leg straight. Continue bringing heel closer to you, sliding it on floor. At full joelho(s) flexion, reverse movement to Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Plie Halter Agachamento
instructions: Hold a halter(es) at base com both hands e Fique em pé ereto up. Move seu(s) legs so that they are wider than ombro(s) width apart de each other com seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent. seu(s) toes should be facing out. Note: seu(s) arms should be stationary enquanto performing exercise. This is posição inicial. Slowly bend joelho(s) e lower seu(s) legs até seu(s) thighs are parallel to floor. Make sure to Inspire as this is eccentric part of exercise. Press mainly com heel of foot to bring body costas até a posição inicial enquanto exhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Plyo Kettlebell Flexão de Braços
instructions: Place a kettlebell on floor. Place yourself in a pushup position, on seu(s) toes com one hand on ground e one hand holding kettlebell, com seu(s) cotovelo(s) extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by lowering yourself as low as you can, mantendo seu(s) costas straight. Quickly e forcefully reverse direction, pushing yourself up to other side of kettlebell, switching hands as you do so. Continue movement by descending e repeating movement costas e forth.

name: Plyo Flexão de Braço
instructions: Move em a prone position on floor, supporting seu(s) weight on seu(s) hands e toes. seu(s) arms should be fully extended com hands around ombro(s) width. Keep seu(s) body straight throughout movement. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Descend by flexing at cotovelo(s), lowering seu(s) peito towards ground. At bottom, reverse motion by pushing yourself up through cotovelo(s) extension as quickly as possible. Attempt to push seu(s) upper body up até seu(s) hands leave ground. Retorne à posição inicial e repeat exercise. For added difficulty, add claps em movement enquanto you are air borne.

name: Posterior Tibialis Alongamento
instructions: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. com leg extended e heel off of ground, pull on belt so that foot is everted, com outside of foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, e então switch sides.

name: Power Clean
instructions: Fique em pé com os pés slightly wider than ombro(s) width apart e toes pointing out slightly. Squat down e grasp bar com a closed, pronated grip. seu(s) hands should be slightly wider than ombro(s) width apart outside joelho(s) com cotovelo(s) fully extended. Place bar about 1 inch in front of seu(s) shins e over balls of seu(s) feet. seu(s) costas should be flat or slightly arched, seu(s) peito held up e out e seu(s) ombro(s) blades should be retracted. Keep seu(s) head in a neutral position (in line com vertebral column e not tilted or rotated) com seu(s) eyes focused straight ahead. Inspire during this phase. Lift bar de floor by forcefully extending quadril e joelho(s) as you Expire. Tip: upper torso should maintain same angle. Do not bend at waist yet e do not let quadril rise before ombro(s) (this would have effect of pushing glúteo(s) in air e stretching hamstrings. Keep cotovelo(s) fully extended com head in a neutral position e ombro(s) over bar. As bar raises keep it as close to shins as possible. As bar passes joelho(s), thrust seu(s) quadril forward e slightly bend joelho(s) to avoid locking them. Tip: At this point seu(s) thighs should be against bar. Keep costas flat or slightly arched, cotovelo(s) fully extended e seu(s) head neutral. Tip: You will hold seu(s) breath até next phase. Inspire e então forcefully e quickly extend seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) e stand on seu(s) toes. Keep bar as close to seu(s) body as possible. Tip: seu(s) costas should be flat com cotovelo(s) pointed out to sides e seu(s) head in a neutral position. Also, keep seu(s) ombro(s) over bar e arms straight as long as possible. When seu(s) lower body joints are fully extended, shrug ombro(s) upward rapidly without letting cotovelo(s) flex yet. Expire during this portion of movement. As ombro(s) reach their highest elevation flex seu(s) cotovelo(s) to begin pulling seu(s) body under bar. Continue to pull arms as high e as long as possible. Tip: Due to explosive nature of this phase, seu(s) torso will be erect or com an arched costas, seu(s) head will be tilted costas slightly e seu(s) feet may lose contact com floor. After lower body has fully extended e bar reaches near maximal height, pull seu(s) body under bar e rotate arms around e under bar. Simultaneously, flex quadril e joelho(s) em a quarter squat position. Once arms are under bar, Inspire e então lift seu(s) cotovelo(s) to position upper arms parallel to floor. Rack bar across front of seu(s) collar bones e front ombro(s) muscles. Catch bar com an erect e tight torso, a neutral head position e flat feet. Expire during this movement. Stand up by extending quadril e joelho(s) to a fully erect position. Lower bar by gradually reducing muscular tension of arms to allow a controlled descent of bar to thighs. Inspire during this movement. Simultaneously flex quadril e joelho(s) to cushion impact of bar on thighs. Squat down com cotovelo(s) fully extended até bar touches floor. Start over at Phase 1 e repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Power Clean From Blocks
instructions: Com a barra on boxes of desired height, take a grip just outside legs. Lower seu(s) quadril com weight focused on heels, costas straight, head facing forward, peito up, com seu(s) ombro(s) just in front of bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through heels, extending seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) costas angle should stay same, e seu(s) arms should remain straight. As bar approaches mid-thigh position, begin extending through quadril. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending quadril, joelho(s), e ankles, using speed to move bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through arms to accelerate weight. At end of second pull, body should be fully extended, leaning slightly costas, com arms still extended. As full extension is achieved, transition em third pull by aggressively shrugging e flexing arms com cotovelo(s) up e out. At peak extension, pull yourself under bar far enough that it can be racked onto ombro(s), rotating seu(s) cotovelo(s) under bar as you do so. bar should be racked onto protracted ombro(s), lightly touching throat com hands relaxed. Immediately recover by driving through heels, mantendo torso upright e cotovelo(s) up. Continue até you have risen to a standing position, e complete repetições by returning weight to boxes.

name: Power Jerk
instructions: Standing com weight racked on front of ombro(s), begin com dip. com seu(s) feet directly under seu(s) quadril, flex joelho(s) without moving quadril backward. Go down only slightly, e reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through heels create as much speed e force as possible, e be sure to move seu(s) head out of way as bar leaves ombro(s). At this moment as feet leave floor, feet must be placed em receiving position as quickly as possible. In brief moment feet are not actively driving against platform, athletes effort to push bar up will drive them down. feet should be moved to a slightly wider stance, com joelho(s) partially bent. Receive bar com arms locked out overhead. Return to a standing position.

name: Power Partials
instructions: Stand up com seu(s) torso upright e a halter(es) on each hand being held at arms length. cotovelo(s) should be close to torso. palms of hands should be facing seu(s) torso. seu(s) feet should be about ombro(s) width apart. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) arms straight e torso stationary, lift weights out to seu(s) sides até they are about ombro(s) level height enquanto exhaling. Feel contraction for a second e begin to Abaixe a cargas costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Tip: Keep palmas na direção indicada com little finger slightly higher enquanto lifting e lowering weights as it will concentrate stress on seu(s) ombro(s) mainly. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Power Snatch
instructions: Begin com a loaded barra on floor. bar should be close to or touching shins, e a wide grip should be taken on bar. feet should be directly below quadril, com feet turned out as needed. Lower quadril, com peito up e head looking forward. ombro(s) should be just in front of bar. This will be posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through front of heels, raising bar de ground. costas angle should stay same até bar passes joelho(s). Transition em second pull by extending through quadril joelho(s) e ankles, driving bar up as quickly as possible. bar should be close to body. At peak extension, shrug ombro(s) e allow cotovelo(s) to flex to side. As you move seu(s) feet em receiving position, a slightly wider position, pull yourself below bar as you elevate bar overhead. bar should be received in a partial squat. Continue raising bar to overhead position, receiving bar locked out overhead. Return to a standing position com weight over head.

name: Power Snatch From Blocks
instructions: Begin com a loaded barra on boxes or stands of desired height. A wide grip should be taken on bar. feet should be directly below quadril, com feet turned out as needed. Lower quadril, com peito up e head looking forward. ombro(s) should be just in front of bar, com cotovelo(s) pointed out. This will be posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through front of heels, raising bar de boxes. Transition em second pull by extending through quadril joelho(s) e ankles, driving bar up as quickly as possible. bar should be close to body. At peak extension, shrug ombro(s) e allow cotovelo(s) to flex to side. As you move seu(s) feet em receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below bar as you elevate bar overhead. feet should move to just outside quadril, turned out as necessary. Receive bar above a full squat e com arms fully extended overhead. mantendo bar aligned over front of heels, seu(s) head e peito up, drive through heels of feet to move to a standing position. Carefully return weight to boxes.

name: Power Stairs
instructions: In power stairs, implements are moved up a staircase. For training purposes, these can be performed com a tire or box. Begin by taking implement com both hands. Set seu(s) feet wide, com seu(s) head e peito up. Drive through ground com seu(s) heels, extending seu(s) joelho(s) e quadril to Eleve a carga de ground. As you lean costas, attempt to swing weight onto stairs, which are usually around 16-18" high. You can use seu(s) legs to help push weight onto stair. Repeat for 3-5 repetições, e continue com a heavier weight, moving as fast as possible.

name: Rosca Scott
instructions: To perform this movement you will need a preacher banco e an E-Z bar. Grab E-Z curl bar at close inner pegadas (either have someone hand you bar which is preferable or grab bar de front bar rest provided by most preacher benches). palm of seu(s) hands should be facing forward e they should be slightly tilted inwards due to shape of bar. com upper arms positioned against preacher banco pad e peito against it, hold E-Z Curl Bar at ombro(s) length. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, Abaixe lentamente bar até seu(s) upper arm is extended e biceps is fully stretched. As you Expire, use biceps to curl weight up até seu(s) biceps is fully contracted e bar is at ombro(s) height. Squeeze biceps hard e hold this position for a second. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Preacher Hammer Rosca Direta com Halteres
instructions: Place upper part of both arms on top of preacher banco as you hold a halter(es) in each hand com palmas na direção indicada (neutral grip). As you breathe in, slowly Abaixe a carga até seu(s) upper arm is extended e biceps is fully stretched. As you Expire, use biceps to curl weight up até seu(s) biceps is fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) height. Squeeze biceps hard for a second at contracted position e repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Press Abdominal
instructions: To begin, lie down on a banco com a barra resting on seu(s) peito. Position seu(s) legs so they are secure on extension of abdominal banco. This is posição inicial. enquanto inhaling, tighten seu(s) abdominals e glúteo(s). Simultaneously curl seu(s) torso as you do when performing a sit-up e press barra to an overhead position enquanto exhaling. Tip: Use seu(s) arms to push barra out as you perform this exercise enquanto still focusing on abdominal muscles. Lower seu(s) upper body costas down até a posição inicial enquanto bringing barra costas down to seu(s) torso. Remember to breathe in enquanto lowering body. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: De Bruços Manual Hamstring
instructions: You will need a partner for this exercise. Lay face down com seu(s) legs straight. seu(s) assistant will place their hand on seu(s) heel. To begin, flex joelho(s) to curl seu(s) leg up. seu(s) partner should provide resistance, starting light e increasing pressure as movement is completed. Communicate com seu(s) partner to monitor appropriate resistance levels. Pause at top, returning leg até a posição inicial as seu(s) partner provides resistance going other direction.

name: Prowler Sprint
instructions: Place seu(s) sled on an appropriate surface, loaded to a suitable weight. sled should provide enough resistance to require effort, but not so heavy that you are significantly slowed down. You may use upright or low pegadas for this exercise. Place seu(s) hands on pegadas com seu(s) arms extended, leaning em implement. com good posture, drive through ground com alternating, short steps. Move as fast as you can for a short distance.

name: Pull Through
instructions: Begin standing a few feet in front of a low pulley com a rope or pegadas attached. Face away de máquina, straddling cabo, com seu(s) feet set wide apart. Begin movement by reaching through seu(s) legs o máximo possível, bending at quadril. Keep seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent. mantendo seu(s) arms straight, extend through quadril to Fique em pé ereto up. Avoid pulling upward through ombro(s); all of motion should originate through quadril.

name: Barra Fixas
instructions: Grab pull-up bar com palmas na direção indicada using prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, seu(s) hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than seu(s) ombro(s) width. For a medium grip, seu(s) hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to seu(s) ombro(s) width e for a close grip at a distance smaller than seu(s) ombro(s) width. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding bar at chosen grip width, bring seu(s) torso costas around 30 degrees or so enquanto creating a curvature on seu(s) lower costas e sticking seu(s) peito out. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Pull seu(s) torso up até bar touches seu(s) upper peito by drawing ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas. Expire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work other than hold bar. After a second on contracted position, start to Inspire e Abaixe lentamente seu(s) torso costas até a posição inicial when seu(s) arms are fully extended e lats are fully stretched. Repeat this motion for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Flexão de Braço Wide
instructions: Com seu(s) hands wide apart, support seu(s) body on seu(s) toes e hands in a plank position. seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be extended e seu(s) body straight. Do not allow seu(s) quadril to sag. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. To begin, allow cotovelo(s) to flex, lowering seu(s) peito to floor as you Inspire. Using seu(s) pectoral muscles, press seu(s) upper body costas up até a posição inicial by extending cotovelo(s). Expire as you perform this step. After pausing at contracted position, repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Flexão de Braços - Close Triceps Position
instructions: Lie on floor face down e place seu(s) hands closer than ombro(s) width for a close hand position. Make sure that you are holding seu(s) torso up at arms' length. Lower yourself até seu(s) peito almost touches floor as you Inspire. Using seu(s) triceps e some of seu(s) pectoral muscles, press seu(s) upper body costas up até a posição inicial e squeeze seu(s) peito. Breathe out as you perform this step. After a second pause at contracted position, repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Flexão de Braços com Feet Elevated

name: Push Press

instructions: Standing com weight racked on costas of ombro(s), begin com dip. com seu(s) feet directly under seu(s) quadril, flex joelho(s) without moving quadril backward. name: Flexão de Braços
instructions: Lie on floor face down e place seu(s) hands about 36 inches apart enquanto holding seu(s) torso up at arms length. instructions: Lay facedown on floor com seu(s) weight supported by seu(s) hands or forearms. Place a foam roll underneath one leg on quadriceps, e keep foot off of ground. instructions: This drill teaches delivery of barra to rack position on ombro(s). Begin holding a bar in scarecrow position, com upper arms parallel to floor, e forearms hanging down. name: Rack Pull com Bands
instructions: Set up in a power rack com bar on pins. pins should be set to desired point; just below joelho(s), just above, or in mid thigh position. Attach bands to base of rack, or secure them com halter(es). Attach other end to bar. You may need to choke bands to provide tension. Be sure to pull seu(s) ombro(s) costas as you complete movement. Return weight to pins e repeat.

name: Rack Pulls
instructions: Set up in a power rack com bar on pins. pins should be set to desired point; just below joelho(s), just above, or in mid thigh position. Position yourself against bar in proper deadlifting position. seu(s) feet should be under seu(s) quadril, seu(s) grip ombro(s) width, costas arched, e quadril costas to engage hamstrings. Be sure to pull seu(s) ombro(s) costas as you complete movement. Return weight to pins e repeat.

name: Rear Leg Raises
instructions: Place yourself on seu(s) hands joelho(s) on an exercise mat. seu(s) head should be looking forward e bend of joelho(s) should create a 90-degree angle between hamstrings e calves. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Extend one leg up e behind you. joelho(s) e quadril should both extend. Repeat for 5-10 repetições, e então switch sides.

name: Recumbent Bike
instructions: To begin, seat yourself on bike e adjust seat to seu(s) height. Select desired option de menu. You may have to start pedaling to turn it on. You can use manual setting, or you can select a program to use. Recumbent bikes offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, e have less impact than other activities. name: Return Push From Stance
instructions: You will need a partner for this drill. Begin in an athletic 2 or 3 point stance. At signal, move em a position to receive pass de seu(s) partner. Catch medicine ball com both hands e immediately throw it costas to seu(s) partner. You can modify this drill by running different routes.

name: Invertido Elástico Bench Press
instructions: Position a banco inside a power rack, com bar set to correct height. Begin by anchoring bands either to band pegs or to top of rack. Ensure that you will be position properly under bands. Attach other end to barra. Deite-se em um banco, tuck seu(s) feet underneath you e arch seu(s) costas. Using bar to help support seu(s) weight, lift seu(s) ombro(s) off banco e retract them, squeezing ombro(s) blades together. Use seu(s) feet to drive seu(s) traps em banco. Maintain this tight body position throughout movement. However wide seu(s) grip, it should cover ring on bar. Pull bar out of rack without protracting seu(s) ombro(s). Focus on squeezing bar e trying to pull it apart. Lower bar to seu(s) lower peito or upper stomach. bar, wrist, e cotovelo(s) should stay in line at all times. Pause when barra touches seu(s) torso, e então drive bar up com as much force as possible. cotovelo(s) should be tucked in até lockout.

name: Invertido Elástico Box Agachamento
instructions: Begin in a power rack com a box at appropriate height behind you. Set up bands either on band pegs or attached to top of rack, ensuring they will be directly above bar during squat. Attach other end to bar. Begin by stepping under bar e placing it across costas of ombro(s). contraia a musculatura alvo together e rotate seu(s) cotovelo(s) forward, attempting to bend bar across seu(s) ombro(s). Remove bar de rack, creating a tight arch in seu(s) lower costas, e step costas em position. Place seu(s) feet wider for more emphasis on costas, glúteo(s), adductors, e hamstrings, or closer together for more quad development. Keep seu(s) head facing forward. com seu(s) costas, ombro(s), e core tight, push seu(s) joelho(s) e butt out e you begin seu(s) descent. Sit costas com seu(s) quadril até you are seated on box. Ideally, seu(s) shins should be perpendicular to ground. Pause when you reach box, e relax quadril flexors. Never bounce off of a box. mantendo weight on seu(s) heels e pushing seu(s) feet e joelho(s) out, drive upward off of box as you lead movement com seu(s) head. Continue upward, maintaining tightness head to toe. Use care to return barra to rack.

name: Invertido Elástico Levantamento Terra
instructions: Set bar up in a power rack. Attach bands to top of rack, using either bands pegs or frame itself. Attach other end of bands to bar. Approach bar so that it is centered over seu(s) feet. You feet should be about quadril width apart. Bend at quadril to grip bar at ombro(s) width, allowing seu(s) ombro(s) blades to protract. Typically, you would use an overhand grip or an over/under grip on heavier sets. com seu(s) feet, e seu(s) grip set, take a big breath e então lower seu(s) quadril e bend joelho(s) até seu(s) shins contact bar. Look forward com seu(s) head, keep seu(s) peito up e seu(s) costas arched, e begin driving through heels to move weight upward. After bar passes joelho(s), aggressively pull bar costas, pulling seu(s) ombro(s) blades together as you drive seu(s) quadril forward em bar. Lower bar by bending at quadril e guiding it to floor.

name: Invertido Elástico Power Agachamento
instructions: Begin in a power rack com pins e bar set at appropriate height. After loading bar, attach bands to top of rack, using either pegs or frame itself. Attach other end of bands to bar. Begin by stepping under bar e placing it across costas of ombro(s). contraia a musculatura alvo together e rotate seu(s) cotovelo(s) forward, attempting to bend bar across seu(s) ombro(s). Remove bar de rack, creating a tight arch in seu(s) lower costas, e step costas em position. Place seu(s) feet wide for more emphasis on costas, glúteo(s), adductors, e hamstrings. Keep seu(s) head facing forward. com seu(s) costas, ombro(s), e core tight, push seu(s) joelho(s) e butt out e you begin seu(s) descent. Sit costas com seu(s) quadril as much as possible. Ideally, seu(s) shins should be perpendicular to ground. Lower bar position necessitates a greater torso lean to keep bar over heels. Continue até you break parallel, which is defined as crease of quadril being in line com top of joelho(s). mantendo weight on seu(s) heels e pushing seu(s) feet e joelho(s) out, drive upward as you lead movement com seu(s) head. Continue upward, maintaining tightness head to toe, até you have returned até a posição inicial.

name: Invertido Elástico Sumo Levantamento Terra
instructions: Begin com a bar loaded on floor inside of a power rack. Attach bands to top of rack, using either pegs or frame itself. Attach other end to barra. Approach bar so that bar intersects middle of feet. feet should be set very wide, near collars. Bend at quadril to grip bar. arms should be directly below ombro(s), inside legs, e you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip. Relax ombro(s), which in effect lengthens seu(s) arms. Extend through quadril e joelho(s). As bar passes through joelho(s), lean costas e drive quadril em bar, pulling seu(s) ombro(s) blades together. name: Invertido Rosca Direta com Barra
instructions: Stand up com seu(s) torso upright enquanto holding a barra at ombro(s) width com cotovelo(s) close to torso. palm of seu(s) hands should be facing down (pronated grip). Slowly begin to bring bar costas to posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Invertido Barra Rosca Scotts
instructions: Grab an EZ-bar using a ombro(s) width e palms down (pronated) grip. Now place upper part of both arms on top of preacher banco e have seu(s) arms extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, use biceps to curl weight up até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e barra is at ombro(s) height. Feel contraction e slowly Abaixe a cargas costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Invertido Máquina Crucifixo

instructions: Lie costas on a flat banco. name: Rhomboids-smr
instructions: Lay down com seu(s) costas on floor. Place a foam roll underneath seu(s) upper costas, e cross seu(s) arms in front of you, protracting seu(s) ombro(s). instructions: Position frame at starting point, e load com appropriate weight. Standing in center of frame, begin by gripping pegadas e driving through seu(s) heels to lift frame. name: Rickshaw Levantamento Terra
instructions: Load frame com desired weight. Center yourself between pegadas. You feet should be about quadril width apart. Fully extend seu(s) entire body, reaching overhead o máximo possível. As you land, absorb seu(s) impact through legs.

name: Rocking em Pé Elevação de Panturrilha
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set bar on a rack that best matches seu(s) height. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, step under bar e place it on costas of seu(s) ombro(s) (slightly below neck). Also maintain a straight costas e keep joelho(s) com a slight bend; never locked. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) heels as you breathe out by extending seu(s) ankles as high as possible e flexing seu(s) calf. Ensure that joelho(s) is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending (other than slight initial bend we created during positioning) at any time. Hold contracted position by a second before you start to go costas down. Go costas slowly até a posição inicial as you breathe in by lowering seu(s) heels as you bend ankles até calves are stretched. Now lift seu(s) toes by contracting tibia muscles in front of calves as you breathe out. Hold for a second e bring them costas down as you breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Rocky Barra Fixas/pulldowns
instructions: Grab pull-up bar com palmas na direção indicada using a wide grip. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding bar at chosen grip width, bring seu(s) torso costas around 30 degrees or so enquanto creating a curvature on seu(s) lower costas e sticking seu(s) peito out. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Pull seu(s) torso up até bar touches seu(s) upper peito by drawing ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas. Expire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work other than hold bar. After a second on contracted position, start to Inspire e Abaixe lentamente seu(s) torso costas até a posição inicial when seu(s) arms are fully extended e lats are fully stretched. Now repeat same movements as described above except this time seu(s) torso will remain straight as you go up e bar will touch costas of neck instead of upper peito. Tip: Use head to lean forward slightly as it will help you properly execute this portion of exercise. Once you have lowered yourself costas down até a posição inicial, repeat exercise for prescribed amount of repetições in seu(s) program.

name: Romanian Levantamento Terra
instructions: Put a barra in front of you on ground e grab it using a pronated (palmas na direção indicada) grip that a little wider than ombro(s) width. Tip: Depending on weight used, you may need wrist wraps to perform exercise e also a raised platform in order to allow for better range of motion. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) costas e arms completely straight at all times, use seu(s) quadril to lift bar as you Expire. Tip: movement should not be fast but steady e under control. Once you are standing completely straight up, lower bar by pushing quadril costas, only slightly bending joelho(s), unlike when squatting. name: Romanian Levantamento Terra From Deficit
instructions: Begin standing enquanto holding a bar at arm's length in front of you. You can stand on a raised platform to increase range of motion. name: Runner's Alongamento
