Perform for recommended amount of repetições, switch arms e repeat movement.

name: Sentado One-arm Cabo Pulley Rows
instructions: To get inaté a posição inicial, first Sente-se on máquina e place seu(s) feet on front platform or crossbar provided making sure that seu(s) joelho(s) are slightly bent e not locked. Lean over as you keep natural alignment of seu(s) costas e grab single pegadas attachment com seu(s) left arm using a palms-down grip. com seu(s) arm extended pull costas até seu(s) torso is at a 90-degree angle de seu(s) legs. seu(s) costas should be slightly arched e seu(s) peito should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on seu(s) lat as you hold bar in front of you. right arm can be kept by waist. This is posição inicial of exercise. mantendo torso stationary, pull pegadas costas towards seu(s) torso enquanto mantendo arms close to it as you rotate wrist, so that by time seu(s) hand is by seu(s) abdominals it is in a neutral position (palms facing torso). Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing seu(s) costas muscles hard. Hold that contraction for a second e slowly go costas to original position enquanto breathing in. Tip: Remember to rotate wrist as you go costas até a posição inicial so that palms are facing down again. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições e então perform same movement com right hand.

name: Sentado Acima da Cabeç Alongamento
instructions: Sit up straight on an exercise mat. Touch soles of seu(s) feet together com seu(s) feet six to eight inches in front of seu(s) quadril. Place one hand on floor beside you e seu(s) other hand behind seu(s) head. Lift seu(s) cotovelo(s) to ceiling as you incline seu(s) torso to other side. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, então switch sides.

name: Sentado Palm-up Barra Wrist Rosca
instructions: Hold a barra com both hands e seu(s) palmas na direção indicada; hands spaced about ombro(s) width. Place seu(s) pés firmes no chão, at a distance that is slightly wider than ombro(s) width apart. Lean forward e place seu(s) forearms on top of seu(s) upper thighs com seu(s) palms up. Tip: Make sure that front of wrists lay on top of seu(s) joelho(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower bar o máximo possível enquanto inhaling e mantendo a tight grip. Now curl bar up as high as possible enquanto flexing forearms e exhaling. Hold contraction at top for a second e Tip: Only wrist should move.

name: Sentado Palms-down Barra Wrist Rosca
instructions: Hold a barra com both hands e seu(s) palmas na direção indicada; hands spaced about ombro(s) width. Place seu(s) pés firmes no chão, at a distance that is slightly wider than ombro(s) width apart. Lean forward e place seu(s) forearms on top of seu(s) upper thighs com seu(s) palms down. Tip: Make sure that costas of wrists lay on top of seu(s) joelho(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower bar o máximo possível enquanto inhaling e mantendo a tight grip. Now curl bar up as high as possible enquanto flexing forearms e exhaling. Hold contraction at top for a second e Tip: Only wrist should move.

name: Sentado Side Elevação Lateral
instructions: Pick a couple of halter(es) e sit at end of a flat banco com seu(s) feet firmly on floor. Hold halter(es) com seu(s) palms facing in e seu(s) arms straight down at seu(s) sides at arms' length. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto maintaining torso stationary (no swinging), lift halter(es) to seu(s) side com a slight bend on cotovelo(s) e hands slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up até you arms are parallel to floor. Expire as you execute this movement e pause for a second at top. Abaixe a carga costas down slowly até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Sentado Triceps Press
instructions: Sente-se on a banco com costas support e grasp a halter(es) com both hands e hold it overhead at arm's length. Tip: a better way is to have somebody hand it to you especially if it is very heavy. resistance should be resting in palms of seu(s) hands com seu(s) thumbs around it. palm of hand should be facing inward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) upper arms close to seu(s) head (cotovelo(s) in) e perpendicular to floor, lower resistance in a semi-circular motion behind seu(s) head até seu(s) forearms touch seu(s) biceps. Tip: upper arms should remain stationary e only forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step. Go costas até a posição inicial by using triceps to Eleve a carga. Breathe out as you perform this step. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Sentado Two-arm Palms-up Low-pulley Wrist Rosca
instructions: Put a banco in front of a low pulley máquina that has a barra or EZ Curl attachment on it. Move banco far enough away so that when you bring pegadas to top of seu(s) thighs tension is created on cabo due to weight stack being moved up. Now hold pegadas com both hands, palms up, using a ombro(s)-width grip. Step costas e Sente-se em um banco com seu(s) feet about ombro(s) width apart, firmly on floor. Lean forward e place forearms on seu(s) thighs com costas of seu(s) wrists over seu(s) joelho(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower bar o máximo possível, enquanto inhaling e mantendo a tight grip. Now curl bar up as high as possible enquanto contracting forearms. Tip: Only wrist should move; not forearms. After a second contraction at top go costas até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: See-saw Press (alternado Side Press)
instructions: Grab a halter(es) com each hand e stand up erect. Clean (lift) halter(es) to peito/ombro(s) level e então rotate seu(s) wrists so that seu(s) palms are facing towards you as if you were getting ready to perform an Arnold Press. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now start extending seu(s) left arm overhead as you rotate wrist so that palm of seu(s) hand faces forward as you go up. seu(s) cotovelo(s) should come out also as you lift weight. Simultaneously, you will also be bending de seu(s) quadril to seu(s) opposite side. Tip: If you perform exercise correctly, is should look as if you are trying to reach for something overhead on right hand side of seu(s) body, but com seu(s) left arm. Breathe out as you perform this movement. Once you reach top position breathe in. então, com weight fully extended overhead e you bent over to seu(s) right hand side, begin movement to left side. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Shotgun Remada
instructions: Attach a single pegadas to a low cabo. After selecting correct weight, stand a couple feet costas com a wide-split stance. seu(s) arm should be extended e seu(s) ombro(s) forward. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Perform movement by retracting ombro(s) e flexing cotovelo(s). As you pull, supinate wrist, turning palm upward as you go. After a brief pause, Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Shoulder Circles
instructions: Com ombro(s) relaxed e arms resting loosely at seu(s) sides (or in seu(s) lap if you're seated), gently roll seu(s) ombro(s) forward, up, costas, e down. Reverse direction. You can do this exercise alternating ombro(s) or both at same time.

name: Desenvolvimento - com Bands
instructions: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. segure a barra/pegadas e lift them so that hands are at ombro(s) height at each side. Rotate wrists so that palms of seu(s) hands are facing forward. seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be bent, com upper arms e forearms in line to torso. This is seu(s) posição inicial. As you Expire, lift pegadas up até seu(s) arms are fully extended overhead.

name: Shoulder Elevação
instructions: Relax seu(s) arms to seu(s) sides e raise seu(s) ombro(s) up toward seu(s) ears, então costas down.

name: Shoulder Alongamento
instructions: Reach seu(s) left arm across seu(s) body e hold it straight.

name: Side-deitado Floor Alongamento
instructions: First lie on seu(s) left side, bending seu(s) left joelho(s) in front of you to stabilize seu(s) torso (use seu(s) abdominal muscles as well to hold you upright). Straighten seu(s) right leg e rest right foot on floor behind seu(s) left. Straighten seu(s) right arm over seu(s) head e gently pull on seu(s) right wrist to stretch entire right side of body. Switch sides.

name: Side Bridge
instructions: Execute o movimento com controle, boa postura e amplitude completa.

name: Side Hop-sprint
instructions: Stand to side of a cone or hurdle. Begin this drill by hopping sideways over obstacle, rebounding out of seu(s) landing to hop costas to where you started. Hop for a prescribed number or repetições as quickly as possible, e finish this drill by sprinting a short distance upon landing last hop.

name: Side Jackknife
instructions: Execute o movimento com controle, boa postura e amplitude completa.

name: Side Elevação Lateral
instructions: Pick a couple of halter(es) e stand com a straight torso e halter(es) by seu(s) side at arms length com palms of hand facing you. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto maintaining torso in a stationary position (no swinging), lift halter(es) to seu(s) side com a slight bend on cotovelo(s) e hands slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up até you arms are parallel to floor. Expire as you execute this movement e pause for a second at top. Abaixe a carga costas down slowly até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Side Laterals To Elevação Frontal
instructions: In a standing position, hold a pair of halter(es) at seu(s) side. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo os cotovelos levemente flexionados, Eleve a cargas directly in front of you to ombro(s) height, avoiding any swinging or cheating. At top of exercise move weights out in front of you, mantendo seu(s) arms extended. Abaixe a cargas com a controlled motion. On next repetições, Eleve a cargas in front of you to ombro(s) height before moving weights laterally to seu(s) sides. Abaixe a cargas até a posição inicial.

name: Side Leg Raises
instructions: Stand next to a chair, which you may hold onto as a support. Stand on one leg. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) leg straight, raise it as far out to side as possible, e swing it costas down, allowing it to cross opposite leg. Repeat this swinging motion 5-10 times, increasing range of motion as you do so.

name: Side Deitado Groin Alongamento
instructions: Start off by lying on seu(s) right side e bend seu(s) right joelho(s) in front of you to stabilize torso. Rest seu(s) head on seu(s) right hand or ombro(s). Lift seu(s) left leg upward e hold it by costas of joelho(s) (easier) or foot (harder). Pull seu(s) left joelho(s) in toward seu(s) left ombro(s) e simultaneously press seu(s) foot or joelho(s) down to floor. To intensify this stretch, straighten seu(s) left leg. Switch sides.

name: Side Neck Alongamento
instructions: Start com seu(s) ombro(s) relaxed, gently tilt seu(s) head towards seu(s) ombro(s). Assist stretch com a gentle pull on side of head.

name: Side em Pé Long Jump
instructions: Begin standing com seu(s) feet quadril width apart in an athletic stance. seu(s) head e peito should be up, joelho(s) e quadril slightly bent. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Leaning to seu(s) right, extend through seu(s) quadril, joelho(s), e ankles to jump em air. Block com arms to lead movement, jumping as far to seu(s) right as you can. Land facing same direction com seu(s) feet quadril width apart, absorbing impact through seu(s) lower body.

name: Side To Side Chins
instructions: Grab pull-up bar com palmas na direção indicada using a wide grip. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding bar at a wide grip, bring seu(s) torso costas around 30 degrees or so enquanto creating a curvature on seu(s) lower costas e sticking seu(s) peito out. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Pull seu(s) torso up enquanto leaning to left hand side até bar almost touches seu(s) upper peito by drawing ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas. Expire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space (no swinging) e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work other than hold bar. After a second of contraction, Inspire as you go costas até a posição inicial. Now, pull seu(s) torso up enquanto leaning to right hand side até bar almost touches seu(s) upper peito by drawing ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas. Expire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work other than hold bar. After a second of contraction, Inspire as you go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat steps 3-6 até you have performed prescribed amount of repetições for each side.

name: Side Wrist Pull
instructions: This stretch works best standing. Cross seu(s) left arm over midline of seu(s) body e hold left wrist in seu(s) right hand down at level of seu(s) quadril. Start stretch com a bent left arm. Slowly straighten, pull, e lift it up to ombro(s) height, as pictured. Feel this stretch originate in seu(s) costas, not seu(s) ombro(s), e don't pull too hard on ombro(s) joint. Switch sides.

name: Side To Side Box Shuffle
instructions: Stand to one side of box com seu(s) left foot resting on middle of it. To begin, jump up e over to other side of box, landing com seu(s) right foot on top of box e seu(s) left foot on floor. Swing seu(s) arms to aid seu(s) movement. Continue shuffling costas e forth across box.

name: Single-arm Cruzamento de Cabos
instructions: Begin by moving pulleys to high position, select resistance to be used, e take a pegadas in each hand. Step forward in front of both pulleys com seu(s) arms extended in front of you, bringing seu(s) hands together. seu(s) head e peito should be up as you lean forward, enquanto seu(s) feet should be staggered. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) left arm in place, allow seu(s) right arm to extend out to side, maintaining a slight bend at cotovelo(s). right arm should be perpendicular to body at approximately ombro(s) level. Return seu(s) arm costas até a posição inicial by pulling seu(s) hand costas to midline of body. Hold for a second at posição inicial e repeat movement on opposite side. Continue alternating costas e forth for prescribed number of repetições.

name: Single-arm Linear Jammer
instructions: Position a bar em a landmine or securely anchor it in a corner. Load bar to an appropriate weight. Raise bar de floor, taking it to seu(s) ombro(s) com one or both hands. Adopt a wide stance. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Perform movement by extending cotovelo(s), pressing weight up. Move explosively, extending quadril e joelho(s) fully to produce maximal force. Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Single-arm Flexão de Braço
instructions: Begin laying prone on ground. Move yourself em a position supporting seu(s) weight on seu(s) toes e one arm. seu(s) working arm should be placed directly under ombro(s), fully extended. seu(s) legs should be extended, e for this movement you may need a wider base, placing seu(s) feet further apart than in a normal push-up. Maintain good posture, e place seu(s) free hand behind seu(s) costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lower yourself by allowing cotovelo(s) to flex até you touch ground. Descend slowly, e reverse direction be extending arm to Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Single-cone Sprint Drill
instructions: This drill teaches quick foot action. You need a single cone. Begin standing next to cone com one arm costas e one arm forward. Chop feet as quickly as possible, blocking com arms. Circle cone, keep seu(s) joelho(s) up, com violent foot action. Rest after three trips around cone.

name: Single-leg High Box Agachamento
instructions: Position a box in a rack. Secure a band or rope in place above box. Standing in front of it, step onto box to a full standing position, letting seu(s) other leg remain unsupported. Hold onto band for balance . Continue stepping up e down on same leg before switching to opposite side.

name: Single-leg Hop Progression
instructions: Arrange a line of cones in front of you. Assume a relaxed standing position, balanced on one leg. Raise joelho(s) of seu(s) opposite leg. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Hop forward, jumping e landing com same leg over cone. Use a countermovement jump to hop de cone to cone. At end, turn around e go costas on other leg.

name: Single-leg Lateral Hop
instructions: Stand to side of a cone or hurdle. To get em start position, stand on one leg com seu(s) joelho(s) slightly bent. To begin, execute a counterjump to hop sideways over cone. Land on seu(s) jumping leg, e immediately rebound out of it by jumping costas to start position. Continue hopping costas e forth.

name: Single-leg Cadeira Extensora
instructions: Seat yourself in máquina e adjust it so that you are positioned properly. pad should be against lower part of shin but not in contact com ankle. Adjust seat so that pivot point is in line com seu(s) joelho(s). Select a weight appropriate for seu(s) abilities. Maintaining good posture, fully extend one leg, pausing at top of motion. Retorne à posição inicial without letting weight stop, mantendo tension on muscle. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: Single-leg Stride Jump
instructions: Stand to side of a box com seu(s) inside foot on top of it, close to edge. Begin by swinging arms upward as you push through top leg, jumping upward as high as possible. Attempt to drive opposite joelho(s) upward. Land in same position that you started, using seu(s) inside leg to decelerate impact.

name: Single Halter Elevação
instructions: Com a wide stance, hold a dumbell com both hands, grasping head of halter(es) instead of pegadas. seu(s) arms should be extended e hanging at waist. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Eleve a carga até it is above ombro(s) level, mantendo seu(s) arms extended. seu(s) torso e quadril should remain stationary throughout movement. Retorne à posição inicial e repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Unilateral Butt Kick
instructions: Begin by standing on one leg, com bent joelho(s) raised. This will be seu(s) start position. Using a countermovement jump, take off upward by extending quadril, joelho(s), e ankle of grounded leg. Immediately flex joelho(s) e attempt to touch seu(s) butt com heel of seu(s) jumping leg. Return leg to a partially bent position underneath quadril e land. seu(s) opposite leg should stay in relatively same position throughout drill.

name: Unilateral Ponte de Glúteo
instructions: Lay on floor com seu(s) feet flat e joelho(s) bent. Raise one leg off of ground, pulling joelho(s) to seu(s) peito. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Execute movement by driving through heel, extending seu(s) quadril upward e raising seu(s) glúteo(s) off of ground. Extend o máximo possível, pause e então Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Unilateral Push-off
instructions: Stand on ground com one foot resting on box, heel close to edge. Push off com seu(s) foot on top of box, trying to gain as much height as possible by extending through quadril e joelho(s). Land com same foot on top of box, returning seu(s) other foot costas to start position.

name: Abdominal
instructions: Lie down on floor placing seu(s) feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. seu(s) legs should be bent at joelho(s). Place seu(s) hands behind seu(s) head e lock them together by clasping seu(s) fingers. This is posição inicial. Elevate seu(s) upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape com seu(s) thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of exercise. Once you feel contraction for a second, lower seu(s) upper body costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Sit Squats
instructions: Fique em pé com os pés ombro(s) width apart. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin movement by flexing seu(s) joelho(s) e quadril, sitting costas com seu(s) quadril. Continue até you have squatted a portion of way down, but are above parallel, e quickly reverse motion até you Retorne à posição inicial. Repeat for 5-10 repetições.

name: Skating
instructions: Roller skating is a fun activity which can be effective in improving cardiorespiratory fitness e muscular endurance. It requires relatively good balance e coordination. It is necessary to learn basics of skating including turning e stopping e to wear protective gear to avoid possible injury. You can skate at a comfortable pace for 30 minutes straight. If you want a cardio challenge, do interval skating — speed skate two minutes of every five minutes, using remaining three minutes to recover. A 150 lb person will typically burn about 175 calories in 30 minutes skating at a comfortable pace, similar to brisk walking.

name: Sled Drag - Harness
instructions: To begin, load sled com desired weight e attach pulling strap. You can pull com pegadas, use a harness, or attach pulling strap to a weight belt. Whether pulling forwards or backwards, lean in direction of travel e progress by extending through quadril e joelho(s).

name: Sled Acima da Cabeç Backward Walk
instructions: Attach dual pegadas to a sled connected by a rope or chain. Load sled to a light weight. Face sled, backing up até there is some tension in line. Hold seu(s) hands directly above seu(s) head com seu(s) cotovelo(s) extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Walk backwards, mantendo seu(s) arms raised above seu(s) head. Avoid jerky movements.

name: Sled Acima da Cabeç Triceps Extensão
instructions: Attach dual pegadas to a sled using a chain or rope. Load sled to an appropriate load. Facing away de sled, step away até there is tension in line. Raise seu(s) hands above seu(s) head, mantendo them together, palmas na direção indicada. seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be pointed upward com cotovelo(s) flexed. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Extend through cotovelo(s) to straighten arm. Ensure that seu(s) upper arm stays in position to isolate triceps. Upon full extension, step forward to take slack out of line. You may keep seu(s) feet staggered for more stability.

name: Sled Push
instructions: Load seu(s) pushing sled com desired weight. Take an athletic posture, leaning em sled com seu(s) arms fully extended, grasping pegadas. Push sled as fast as possible, focusing on extending seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) to strengthen seu(s) posterior chain.

name: Sled Invertido Crucifixo
instructions: Attach dual pegadas to a sled connected by a rope or chain. Load sled to a light weight. Face sled, backing up até there is some tension in line. Take both pegadas at arms length at about waist level. Bend joelho(s) slightly e keep seu(s) peito e head up. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Without flexing cotovelo(s), pull pegadas upward e apart, performing a reverse fly com some external rotation. seu(s) palms should be facing forward as you do this. Retorne à posição inicial, taking a couple steps costas to take slack out of line.

name: Sled Remada
instructions: Attach dual pegadas to a sled connected by a rope or chain. Load sled to an appropriate weight. Face sled, backing up até there is some tension in line. com a pegadas in each hand, bend joelho(s) slightly, keep seu(s) head e peito up, e begin com seu(s) arms extended. To initiate movement, flex cotovelo(s) as you retract seu(s) ombro(s) blades, pulling sled towards you. Take a step or two costas to get tension in line e repeat.

name: Sledgehammer Swings
instructions: You will need a tire e a sledgehammer for this exercise. Stand in front of tire about two feet away de it com a staggered stance. Grip sledgehammer. If you are right handed, seu(s) left hand should be at bottom of pegadas, e seu(s) right hand should be choking up closer to head. As you bring sledge up, seu(s) right hand slides toward head; as you swing down, seu(s) right hand will slide down to join seu(s) left hand. Slam it down as hard as you can against tire. Control bounce of hammer off of tire. Repeat on other side.

name: Smith Inclinado Shoulder Elevação
instructions: Place an incline banco underneath smith máquina. Place barra at a height that you can reach when lying down e seu(s) arms are almost fully extended. Once weight you need is selected, lie down on incline banco e make sure seu(s) ombro(s) are aligned right under barra. Using a ombro(s) width pronated (palms forward) grip, lift bar de rack e hold it straight over you com a slight bend at cotovelo(s). This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, lift bar up até seu(s) arms are fully extended. Note: contraction should be felt around ombro(s). After a second pause, bring bar costas down até a posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place bar costas in rack.

name: Smith Máquina Behind Back Encolhimento
instructions: Com bar at thigh level, load an appropriate weight. Stand com bar behind you, taking a ombro(s)-width, pronated grip on bar e unhook weight. You should be standing up straight com seu(s) head e peito up e seu(s) arms extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by shrugging seu(s) ombro(s) straight up. Do not flex arms or wrist during movement. After a brief pause return weight até a posição inicial. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições before engaging hooks to rack weight.

name: Smith Máquina Bench Press
instructions: Place a flat banco underneath smith máquina. Now place barra at a height that you can reach when lying down e seu(s) arms are almost fully extended. Once weight you need is selected, lie down on flat banco. Using a pronated grip that is wider than ombro(s) width, unlock bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, come down slowly até you feel bar on seu(s) middle peito. After a second pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out e push bar using seu(s) peito muscles. Lock seu(s) arms in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, lock bar costas in rack.

name: Smith Máquina Remada Curvada
instructions: Set barra attached to smith máquina to a height that is about 2 inches below seu(s) joelho(s). Flexione os joelhos slightly e bring seu(s) torso forward, by bending at waist, enquanto mantendo costas straight até it is almost parallel to floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep head up. Now segure a barra/pegadasbell using an overhand (pronated) grip e unlock it de smith máquina rack. então let it hang directly in front of you as seu(s) arms hang extended perpendicular to floor e seu(s) torso. This is seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto mantendo torso stationary, lift barra as you breathe out, mantendo cotovelo(s) close to body e not doing any force com forearm other than holding weights. On top contracted position, squeeze costas muscles e hold for a second. Slowly Abaixe a carga again até a posição inicial as you Inspire. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Smith Máquina Elevação de Panturrilha
instructions: Place a block or weight plate below bar on Smith máquina. Set bar to a position that best matches seu(s) height. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, step onto plates com balls of seu(s) feet e place bar on costas of seu(s) ombro(s). Take bar com both hands facing forward. Rotate bar to unrack it. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Raise seu(s) heels as high as possible by pushing off of balls of seu(s) feet, flexing seu(s) calf at top of contraction. seu(s) joelho(s) should remain extended. Hold contracted position for a second before you start to go costas down. Return slowly até a posição inicial as you breathe in enquanto lowering seu(s) heels. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Smith Máquina Supino Pegada Fechada
instructions: Place a flat banco underneath smith máquina. Place barra at a height that you can reach when lying down e seu(s) arms are almost fully extended. Once weight you need is selected, lie down on flat banco. Using a close e pronated grip (palmas na direção indicada) that is around ombro(s) width, unlock bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, come down slowly até you feel bar on seu(s) middle peito. Tip: Make sure that as opposed to a regular banco press, you keep cotovelo(s) close to torso at all times in order to maximize triceps involvement. After a second pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out e push bar using seu(s) triceps muscles. Lock seu(s) arms in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, lock bar costas in rack.

name: Smith Máquina Declinado Press
instructions: Position a decline banco in rack so that bar will be above seu(s) peito. Load an appropriate weight e take seu(s) place on banco. Rotate bar to unhook it de rack e Estenda completamente os braços. seu(s) costas should be slightly arched e seu(s) ombro(s) blades retracted. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin movement by flexing seu(s) arms, lowering bar to seu(s) peito. Pause briefly, e então extend seu(s) arms to push weight costas até a posição inicial. After completing número desejado de repetições, rotate bar to rack weight.

name: Smith Máquina Hang Power Clean
instructions: Position bar at joelho(s) height e load it to an appropriate weight. Take a pronated grip on bar outside of ombro(s) width e unhook bar de máquina. seu(s) arms should be fully extended com seu(s) head e peito up. seu(s) cotovelo(s) should be pointed out com seu(s) ombro(s) costas e down. seu(s) quadril should be costas, loading tension em hamstrings. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initate movement by forcefully extending quadril e joelho(s), accelerating em bar. Ensure that you keep seu(s) arms straight during this part of motion. Upon full extension, rebend quadril e joelho(s) to lower seu(s) receiving position. Allow arms to flex at this point, rotating cotovelo(s) around bar to receive it on seu(s) ombro(s). Extend through quadril e joelho(s) to come to a standing position com bar racked on seu(s) ombro(s) to complete movement.

name: Smith Máquina Hip Elevação
instructions: Position a banco in rack e load bar to an appropriate weight. Lie down on banco, placing bottom of seu(s) feet against bar. Unlock bar e extend seu(s) legs. You may need to use seu(s) hands to assist you. For added stability grasp sides of Smith máquina. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by rotating seu(s) pelvis, flexing seu(s) spine to raise seu(s) quadril off of banco. Maintain a slight bend in joelho(s) throughout motion. After a brief pause, return quadril to banco. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: Smith Máquina Inclinado Bench Press
instructions: Place an incline banco underneath smith máquina. Place barra at a height that you can reach when lying down e seu(s) arms are almost fully extended. Once weight you need is selected, lie down on incline banco e make sure seu(s) upper peito is aligned com barra. Using a pronated grip (palmas na direção indicada) that is wider than ombro(s) width, unlock bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, come down slowly até you feel bar on seu(s) upper peito. After a second pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out e push bar using seu(s) peito muscles. Lock seu(s) arms in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições. When you are done, place bar costas in rack.

name: Smith Máquina Leg Press
instructions: Position a Smith máquina bar a couple feet off of ground. Ensure that it is resting on safeties. After loading bar to an appropriate weight, lie underneath bar. Place middle of seu(s) feet on bar, tucking seu(s) joelho(s) to seu(s) peito. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin movement by driving through seu(s) feet to move bar upward, extending quadril e joelho(s). Do not lock out seu(s) joelho(s). At top of motion, pause briefly before returning até a posição inicial.

name: Smith Máquina One-arm Upright Remada
instructions: Com bar at thigh level, load an appropriate weight. Take a wide grip on bar e unhook weight, removing seu(s) off hand de bar. seu(s) arm should be extended as you Fique em pé ereto com seu(s) head e peito up. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin movement by flexing cotovelo(s), raising upper arm com cotovelo(s) pointed out. Continue até seu(s) upper arm is parallel to floor. After a brief pause, return weight até a posição inicial. Repita pelo número desejado de repetições before engaging hooks to rack weight.

name: Smith Máquina Acima da Cabeç Desenvolvimento
instructions: To begin, place a flat banco (or preferably one com costas support) underneath a smith máquina. Position barra at a height so that when seated on flat banco, arms must be almost fully extended to reach barra. Once you have correct height, sit slightly in behind barra so that there is an imaginary straight line de tip of seu(s) nose to barra. seu(s) feet should be stationary. Grab barra com palmas na direção indicada, unlock it e lift it up so that seu(s) arms are fully extended. This is posição inicial. Slowly begin to Abaixe a carga até it is level com seu(s) chin enquanto inhaling. então lift barra costas até a posição inicial using seu(s) ombro(s) enquanto exhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Smith Máquina Pistol Agachamento
instructions: To begin, first set bar to a position that best matches seu(s) height. Step under it e position bar across costas of seu(s) ombro(s). Take bar com seu(s) hands facing forward, unlock it e lift it off rack by extending seu(s) legs. 3 Move one foot forward about 12 inches in front of bar. Extend other leg out in front of you, holding it off ground. Look forward at all times e maintain a neutral or slightly arched spine. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Maintaining good posture, lower yourself by flexing joelho(s) e quadril, going down as far as flexibility allows. Pause briefly at bottom e então Retorne à posição inicial by driving through heel of seu(s) foot, extending joelho(s) e quadril.

name: Smith Máquina Invertido Elevação de Panturrilhas
instructions: Adjust barra on smith máquina to fit seu(s) height e align a raised platform right under bar. Stand on platform com heels of seu(s) feet secured on top of it com balls of seu(s) feet extending off it. Position seu(s) toes facing forward com a ombro(s) width stance. Now, place seu(s) ombro(s) under barra enquanto maintaining foot positioning described e Empurre a carga para cima by extending seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) até seu(s) torso is standing erect. joelho(s) should be kept com a slight bend; never locked. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Tip: barra on seu(s) costas is only for balance purposes. Raise balls of seu(s) feet as you breathe out by extending seu(s) toes as high as possible e flexing seu(s) calf. Ensure that joelho(s) is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold contracted position for a second before you start to go costas down. Slowly go costas down até a posição inicial as you breathe in by lowering balls of seu(s) feet e toes. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Smith Máquina Agachamento
instructions: To begin, first set bar on height that best matches seu(s) height. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, step under bar e place costas of seu(s) ombro(s) (slightly below neck) across it. Hold on to bar using both arms at each side (palmas na direção indicada), unlock it e lift it off rack by first pushing com seu(s) legs e at same time straightening seu(s) torso. Position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s) width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head up at all times e also maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. (Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances discussed in foot stances section). Begin to Abaixe lentamente bar by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até angle between upper leg e calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is point in which upper legs are below parallel to floor). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor com heel of seu(s) foot as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Smith Máquina Stiff-legged Levantamento Terra
instructions: To begin, set bar on smith máquina to a height that is around middle of seu(s) thighs. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, segure a barra/pegadas using a pronated (palms forward) grip that is ombro(s) width apart. You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight. Lift bar up by Estenda completamente os braços enquanto mantendo seu(s) costas straight. Stand com seu(s) torso straight e seu(s) legs spaced using a ombro(s) width or narrower stance. joelho(s) should be slightly bent. This is seu(s) posição inicial. mantendo joelho(s) stationary, Abaixe a carga to over top of seu(s) feet by bending at waist enquanto mantendo seu(s) costas straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something de floor até you feel a stretch on hamstrings. Expire as you perform this movement Start bringing seu(s) torso up straight again as soon as you feel hamstrings stretch by extending seu(s) quadril e waist até you are costas at posição inicial. Inspire as you perform this movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Smith Máquina Upright Remada
instructions: To begin, set bar on smith máquina to a height that is around middle of seu(s) thighs. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, segure a barra/pegadas using a pronated (palms forward) grip that is ombro(s) width apart. You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight. Lift barra up e Estenda completamente os braços com seu(s) costas straight. There should be a slight bend at cotovelo(s). This is posição inicial. Use seu(s) side ombro(s) to lift bar as you Expire. bar should be close to body as you move it up. Continue to lift it até it nearly touches seu(s) chin. Tip: seu(s) cotovelo(s) should drive motion. As you lift bar, seu(s) cotovelo(s) should always be higher than seu(s) forearms. Also, keep seu(s) torso stationary e pause for a second at top of movement. Lower bar costas down slowly até a posição inicial. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Smith Single-leg Split Agachamento
instructions: To begin, place a flat banco 2-3 feet behind smith máquina. então, set bar on height that best matches seu(s) height. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, step under bar e place costas of seu(s) ombro(s) (slightly below neck) across it. Hold on to bar using both arms at each side (palmas na direção indicada), unlock it e lift it off rack by first pushing com seu(s) legs e at same time straightening seu(s) torso. Position seu(s) legs by placing one foot slightly forward under bar e extending seu(s) other leg costas e place top of seu(s) foot on banco. This will be seu(s) posição inicial Begin to Abaixe lentamente bar by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até angle between upper leg e calf becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is point in which upper legs are below parallel to floor). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) is past that imaginary line (if it is past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor com heel of seu(s) foot mainly as you straighten seu(s) leg again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. Switch legs e repeat movement.

name: Snatch
instructions: Place seu(s) feet at a ombro(s) width stance com barra resting right above connection between toes e rest of foot. com a palmas na direção indicada grip, bend at joelho(s) e mantendo costas flat grab bar using a wider than ombro(s) width grip. Bring quadril down e make sure that seu(s) body drops as if you were going to sit on a chair. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Start pushing floor as if it were a moving platform com seu(s) feet e simultaneously start lifting barra mantendo it close to seu(s) legs. As bar reaches middle of seu(s) thighs, push floor com seu(s) legs e lift seu(s) body to a complete extension in an explosive motion. Lift seu(s) ombro(s) costas in a shrugging movement as you bring bar up enquanto lifting seu(s) cotovelo(s) out to side e mantendo them above bar for as long as possible. Now in a very quick but powerful motion, you have to get seu(s) body under barra when it has reached a high enough point where it can be controlled e drop enquanto locking seu(s) arms e holding barra overhead as you assume a squat position. Finalize movement by rising up out of squat position to finish lift. At end of lift both feet should be on line e arms fully extended holding barra overhead.

name: Snatch Balance
instructions: Begin com feet in pulling position, bar racked across costas of ombro(s), e hands placed in a wide snatch grip. Pop bar com an abrupt dip e drive of joelho(s), e aggressively drive under bar, transitioning feet em receiving position. Receive bar locked out overhead near bottom of squat. torso should remain vertical, lowering quadril between legs. Continue to descend to full depth, e return to a standing position. Carefully Abaixe a carga.

name: Snatch Levantamento Terra
instructions: Snatch deadlift strengthens first pull of snatch. Begin com a wide snatch grip com barra placed on platform. feet should be directly under quadril, com feet turned out. Squat down to bar, mantendo costas in absolute extension com head facing forward. Initiate movement by driving through heels, raising quadril. costas angle should remain same até bar passes joelho(s). At that point, drive seu(s) quadril through bar as you lay costas. Return bar to platform by reversing motion.

name: Snatch Pull
instructions: Com a barra on floor close to shins, take a wide snatch grip. Lower seu(s) quadril com weight focused on heels, costas straight, head facing forward, peito up, com seu(s) ombro(s) just in front of bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through heels, extending seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) costas angle should stay same, e seu(s) arms should remain straight. Move weight com control as you continue to above joelho(s). Next comes second pull, main source of acceleration for pull. As bar approaches mid-thigh position, begin extending through quadril. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending quadril, joelho(s), e ankles, using speed to move bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through arms to accelerate weight; at end of second pull, body should be fully extended, leaning slightly costas. Full extension should be violent e abrupt, e ensure that you do not prolong extension for longer than necessary.

name: Snatch Encolhimento
instructions: Begin com a wide grip, com bar hanging at mid thigh position. You can use a hook or overhand grip. seu(s) costas should be straight e inclined slightly forward. Shrug seu(s) ombro(s) towards seu(s) ears. enquanto this exercise can usually by loaded com heavier weight than a snatch, avoid overloading to point that execution slows down.

name: Snatch From Blocks
instructions: Begin com a loaded barra on boxes or stands of desired height. A wide grip should be taken on bar. feet should be directly below quadril, com feet turned out as needed. Lower quadril, com peito up e head looking forward. ombro(s) should be just in front of bar, com cotovelo(s) pointed out. This will be posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through front of heels, raising bar de boxes. Transition em second pull by extending through quadril joelho(s) e ankles, driving bar up as quickly as possible. bar should be close to body. At peak extension, shrug ombro(s) e allow cotovelo(s) to flex to side. As you move seu(s) feet em receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below bar as you elevate bar overhead. feet should move to just outside quadril, turned out as necessary. Receive bar com seu(s) body as low as possible e arms fully extended overhead. mantendo bar aligned over front of heels, seu(s) head e peito up, drive through heels of feet to move to a standing position. Carefully return weight to boxes.

name: Speed Elástico Acima da Cabeç Triceps
instructions: For this exercise anchor a band to ground. We used an incline banco e anchored band to base, standing over banco. Alternatively, this could be performed standing on band. To begin, pull band behind seu(s) head, holding it com a pronated grip e seu(s) cotovelo(s) up. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. To perform movement, extend through cotovelo(s) to to Estenda os braços, ensuring that you keep seu(s) upper arm in place. Pause, e então Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Speed Box Agachamento
instructions: Attach bands to bar that are securely anchored near ground. You may need to choke bands to get adequate tension. Use a box of an appropriate height for this exercise. Load bar to a weight that still requires effort, but isn't so heavy that speed is compromised. Typically, that will be between 50-70% of seu(s) one repetições max. Position bar on seu(s) upper costas, ombro(s) blades retracted, costas arched e everything tight head to toe. This will be posição inicial. Unrack bar e position yourself in front of box. Sit costas com seu(s) quadril até you are seated on box, ensuring that you descend under control e don't crash onto surface. Pause briefly, e explode off of box, extending through quadril e joelho(s).

name: Speed Squats
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set bar on a rack that best matches seu(s) height. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, step under bar e place costas of seu(s) ombro(s) (slightly below neck) across it. Hold on to bar using both arms at each side e lift it off rack by first pushing com seu(s) legs e at same time straightening seu(s) torso. Step away de rack e position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s) width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance e also maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. (Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances discussed in foot stances section). Begin to lower bar by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até angle between upper leg e calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is point in which upper legs are below parallel to floor). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise bar as fast as possible without involving momentum as you Expire by pushing floor com heel of seu(s) foot mainly as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Note: You should perform these exercises as fast as possible but without breaking perfect form e without involving momentum. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Spell Caster
instructions: Hold a halter(es) in each hand com a pronated grip. seu(s) feet should be wide com seu(s) quadril e joelho(s) extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin movement by pulling both of halter(es) to one side next to seu(s) quadril, rotating seu(s) torso. mantendo seu(s) arms straight e halter(es) parallel to ground, rotate seu(s) torso to swing weights to seu(s) opposite side. Continue alternating, rotating de one side to other até set is complete.

name: Spider Crawl
instructions: Begin in a prone position on floor. Support seu(s) weight on seu(s) hands e toes, com seu(s) feet together e seu(s) body straight. seu(s) arms should be bent to 90 degrees. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Initiate movement by raising one foot off of ground. Externally rotate leg e bring joelho(s) toward seu(s) cotovelo(s), as far forward as possible. Return this leg até a posição inicial e repeat on opposite side.

name: Spider Rosca
instructions: Start out by setting bar on part of preacher banco that you would normally sit on. Make sure to align barra properly so that it is balanced e will not fall off. Move to front side of preacher banco ( part where arms usually lay) e position yourself to lay at a 45 degree slant com seu(s) torso e stomach pressed against front side of preacher banco. Make sure that seu(s) feet (especially toes) are well positioned on floor e place seu(s) upper arms on top of pad located on inside part of preacher banco. Use seu(s) arms to grab barra com a supinated grip (palmas na direção indicada) at about ombro(s) width apart or slightly closer de each other. Slowly begin to lift barra upwards e Expire. Hold contracted position for a second as you squeeze biceps. Slowly begin to bring barra costas até a posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. . Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Spinal Alongamento
instructions: Sit in a chair so seu(s) costas is straight e seu(s) feet planted on floor. Interlace seu(s) fingers behind seu(s) head, cotovelo(s) out e seu(s) chin down. Twist seu(s) upper body to one side about 3 times as far as you can. então lean forward e twist seu(s) torso to reach seu(s) cotovelo(s) to floor on inside of seu(s) joelho(s). Return to upright position e então repeat for seu(s) other side.

name: Split Clean
instructions: Com a barra on floor close to shins, take an overhand grip just outside legs. Lower seu(s) quadril com weight focused on heels, costas straight, head facing forward, peito up, com seu(s) ombro(s) just in front of bar. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through heels, extending seu(s) joelho(s). seu(s) costas angle should stay same, e seu(s) arms should remain straight. Move weight com control as you continue to above joelho(s). Next comes second pull, main source of acceleration for clean. As bar approaches mid-thigh position, begin extending through quadril. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending quadril, joelho(s), e ankles, using speed to move bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through arms to accelerate weight; at end of second pull, body should be fully extended, leaning slightly costas, com arms still extended. As full extension is achieved, transition em third pull by aggressively shrugging e flexing arms com cotovelo(s) up e out. At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating seu(s) cotovelo(s) under bar as you do so. Receive bar com feet split, aggressively moving one foot forward e one foot costas. bar should be racked onto protracted ombro(s), lightly touching throat com hands relaxed. Continue to descend to bottom position, which will help in recovery. Immediately recover by driving through heels, mantendo torso upright e cotovelo(s) up. Bring feet together as you stand up.

name: Split Jerk
instructions: Standing com weight racked on front of ombro(s), begin com dip. com seu(s) feet directly under seu(s) quadril, flex joelho(s) without moving quadril backward. Go down only slightly, e reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through heels create as much speed e force as possible, e be sure to move seu(s) head out of way as bar leaves ombro(s). At this moment as feet leave floor, feet must be placed em receiving position as quickly as possible. In brief moment feet are not actively driving against platform, athlete's effort to push bar up will drive them down. feet should be moved to a split stance, one foot forward, one foot costas, com joelho(s) partially bent. Receive bar com arms locked out overhead. Return to a standing position, bringing feet together.

name: Split Jump
instructions: Assume a lunge stance position com one foot forward com joelho(s) bent, e rear joelho(s) nearly touching ground. Ensure that front joelho(s) is over midline of foot. Extending through both legs, jump as high as possible, swinging seu(s) arms to gain lift. As you jump, bring seu(s) feet together, e move them costas to their initial positions as you land. Absorb impact by reverting costas até a posição inicial.

name: Split Snatch
instructions: Begin com a loaded barra on floor. bar should be close to or touching shins, e a wide grip should be taken on bar. feet should be directly below quadril, com feet turned out as needed. Lower quadril, com peito up e head looking forward. ombro(s) should be just in front of bar. This will be posição inicial. Begin first pull by driving through front of heels, raising bar de ground. costas angle should stay same até bar passes joelho(s). Transition em second pull by extending through quadril joelho(s) e ankles, driving bar up as quickly as possible. bar should be close to body. At peak extension, shrug ombro(s) e allow cotovelo(s) to flex to side. As you move seu(s) feet em receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below bar as you elevate bar overhead. feet should move forcefully to a split position, one foot forward one foot costas. Receive bar com seu(s) body as low as possible e arms fully extended overhead. mantendo bar aligned over front of heels, seu(s) head e peito up, drive through heels of feet to move to a standing position, bringing seu(s) feet together. Carefully return weight to floor.

name: Split Agachamento com Halteres
instructions: Position yourself em a staggered stance com rear foot elevated e front foot forward. Hold a halter(es) in each hand, letting them hang at sides. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by descending, flexing seu(s) joelho(s) e quadril to lower seu(s) body down. Maintain good posture througout movement. Keep front joelho(s) in line com foot as you perform exercise. At bottom of movement, drive through heel to extend joelho(s) e quadril to Retorne à posição inicial.

name: Split Squats
instructions: Being in a standing position. Jump em a split leg position, com one leg forward e one leg costas, flexing joelho(s) e lowering seu(s) quadril slightly as you do so. As you descend, immediately reverse direction, standing costas up e jumping, reversing position of seu(s) legs. Repeat 5-10 times on each leg.

name: Agachamento Jerk
instructions: Standing com weight racked on front of ombro(s), begin com dip. com seu(s) feet directly under seu(s) quadril, flex joelho(s) without moving quadril backward. Go down only slightly, e reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through heels create as much speed e force as possible, e be sure to move seu(s) head out of way as bar leaves ombro(s). At this moment as feet leave floor, feet must be placed em receiving position as quickly as possible. In brief moment feet are not actively driving against platform, athlete's effort to push bar up will drive them down. feet should move forcefully to just outside quadril, turned out as necessary. Receive bar com seu(s) body in a full squat e arms fully extended overhead. mantendo bar aligned over front of heels, seu(s) head e peito up, drive throught heels of feet to move to a standing position. Carefully return weight to floor.

name: Agachamento com Bands
instructions: Set up bands on sleeves, secured to either band pegs, rack, or halter(es) so that there is appropriate tension. Begin by stepping under bar e placing it across costas of ombro(s). contraia a musculatura alvo together e rotate seu(s) cotovelo(s) forward, attempting to bend bar across seu(s) ombro(s). Remove bar de rack, creating a tight arch in seu(s) lower costas, e step costas em position. Place seu(s) feet wide for more emphasis on costas, glúteo(s), adductors, e hamstrings. Mantenha as costas retas com a slight bend in joelho(s) e bend forward at waist. seu(s) torso should be almost parallel to floor. Make sure to keep seu(s) head up. seu(s) upper arms should be close to seu(s) torso e parallel to floor. seu(s) forearms should be pointed towards floor as you hold weights. There should be a 90-degree angle formed between seu(s) forearm e upper arm. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Now, enquanto mantendo seu(s) upper arms stationary, Expire e use seu(s) triceps to lift weights até arm is fully extended. Focus on moving forearm. After a brief pause at top contraction, Inspire e slowly Abaixe a carga costas down até a posição inicial. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Tricep Side Alongamento
instructions: Bring right arm across seu(s) body e over seu(s) left ombro(s), holding seu(s) cotovelo(s) com seu(s) left hand, até you feel a stretch in seu(s) tricep. então repeat for seu(s) other arm.

name: Triceps Tríceps Francês com Rope
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley. After selecting an appropriate weight, grasp rope com both hands e face away de cabo. Position seu(s) hands behind seu(s) head com seu(s) cotovelo(s) point straight up. seu(s) cotovelo(s) should start out flexed, e you can stagger seu(s) stance e lean gently away de máquina to create greater stability. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. To perform movement, extend through cotovelo(s) enquanto mantendo upper arm in position, raising seu(s) hands above seu(s) head. Squeeze seu(s) triceps at top of movement, e slowly Abaixe a carga costas to start position.

name: Tríceps Pulley
instructions: Attach a straight or angled bar to a high pulley e grab com an overhand grip (palmas na direção indicada) at ombro(s) width. Standing upright com torso straight e a very small inclination forward, bring upper arms close to seu(s) body e perpendicular to floor. forearms should be pointing up towards pulley as they hold bar. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Using triceps, bring bar down até it touches front of seu(s) thighs e arms are fully extended perpendicular to floor. upper arms should always remain stationary next to seu(s) torso e only forearms should move. Expire as you perform this movement. After a second hold at contracted position, bring bar slowly up to starting point. Breathe in as you perform this step. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Tríceps Pulley - Rope Attachment
instructions: Attach a rope attachment to a high pulley e grab com a neutral grip (palmas na direção indicada). Standing upright com torso straight e a very small inclination forward, bring upper arms close to seu(s) body e perpendicular to floor. forearms should be pointing up towards pulley as they hold rope com palmas na direção indicada. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Using triceps, bring rope down as you bring each side of rope to side of seu(s) thighs. At end of movement arms are fully extended e perpendicular to floor. upper arms should always remain stationary next to seu(s) torso e only forearms should move. Expire as you perform this movement. After holding for a second, at contracted position, bring rope slowly up to starting point. Breathe in as you perform this step. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Tríceps Pulley - V-bar Attachment
instructions: Attach a V-Bar to a high pulley e grab com an overhand grip (palmas na direção indicada) at ombro(s) width. Standing upright com torso straight e a very small inclination forward, bring upper arms close to seu(s) body e perpendicular to floor. forearms should be pointing up towards pulley as they hold bar. thumbs should be higher than small finger. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Using triceps, bring bar down até it touches front of seu(s) thighs e arms are fully extended perpendicular to floor. upper arms should always remain stationary next to seu(s) torso e only forearms should move. Expire as you perform this movement. After a second hold at contracted position, bring V-Bar slowly up to starting point. Breathe in as you perform this step. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Triceps Alongamento
instructions: Reach seu(s) hand behind seu(s) head, grasp seu(s) cotovelo(s) e gently pull. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, então switch sides.

name: Tuck Abdominal Crunch
instructions: To begin, lie down on floor or an exercise mat com seu(s) costas pressed against floor. seu(s) arms should be lying across seu(s) sides com palmas na direção indicada. seu(s) legs should be crossed by wrapping one ankle around other. Slowly elevate seu(s) legs up in air até seu(s) thighs are perpendicular to floor com a slight bend at joelho(s). Note: seu(s) joelho(s) e toes should be parallel to floor as opposed to thighs. Move seu(s) arms de floor e cross them so they are resting on seu(s) peito. This is posição inicial. enquanto mantendo seu(s) lower costas pressed against floor, slowly lift seu(s) torso. Remember to Expire enquanto perform this part of exercise. Slowly begin to lower seu(s) torso costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Two-arm Halter Rosca Scott
instructions: Grab a halter(es) com each arm e place upper arms on top of preacher banco or incline banco. halter(es) should be held at ombro(s) length. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, slowly Abaixe a carga até seu(s) upper arm is extended e biceps is fully stretched. As you Expire, use biceps to curl weights up até seu(s) biceps is fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) height. Squeeze biceps hard for a second at contracted position e repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Two-arm Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Place two kettlebells between seu(s) feet. To get in posição inicial, push seu(s) butt costas e look straight ahead. Clean kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you raise kettlebells towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrists as you do so. Lower kettlebells costas até a posição inicial e repeat.

name: Two-arm Kettlebell Jerk
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you swing kettlebells towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrists as you do so, so that palms face forward. Squat down a few inches e reverse motion rapidly driving both kettlebells overhead. Immediately after initial push, squat down again e get under kettlebells. Once kettlebells are locked out, stand upright to complete exercise.

name: Two-arm Kettlebell Desenvolvimento Militar
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s). Clean kettlebells to seu(s) ombro(s) by extending through legs e quadril as you swing kettlebells towards seu(s) ombro(s). Rotate seu(s) wrists as you do so, so that palms face forward. Press kettlebells up e out. As kettlebells pass seu(s) head, lean em weights so that kettlebells are racked behind seu(s) head. Make sure to contract seu(s) lats, butt, e stomach for added stability.

name: Two-arm Kettlebell Remada
instructions: Place two kettlebells in front of seu(s) feet. Flexione os joelhos slightly e então push seu(s) butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in posição inicial. Grab both kettlebells e pull them to seu(s) stomach, retracting seu(s) ombro(s) blades e flexing cotovelo(s). Mantenha as costas retas. Lower e repeat.

name: Supinada Cabo Pulldowns
instructions: Sente-se on a pull-down máquina com a wide bar attached to top pulley. Adjust joelho(s) pad of máquina to fit seu(s) height. These pads will prevent seu(s) body de being raised by resistance attached to bar. Grab pull-down bar com palms facing seu(s) torso (a supinated grip). Make sure that hands are placed closer than ombro(s) width. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding bar at chosen grip width, bring seu(s) torso costas around 30 degrees or so enquanto creating a curvature on seu(s) lower costas e sticking seu(s) peito out. This is seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, pull bar down até it touches seu(s) upper peito by drawing ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach fully contracted position e keep cotovelo(s) close to seu(s) body. upper torso should remain stationary as seu(s) bring bar to you e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work other than hold bar. After a second on contracted position, enquanto breathing in, slowly bring bar costas até a posição inicial when seu(s) arms are fully extended e lats are fully stretched. Repeat this motion for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Upper Back-leg Grab
instructions: Enquanto seated, bend forward to hug seu(s) thighs de underneath com both arms. Keep seu(s) joelho(s) together e seu(s) legs extended out as you bring seu(s) peito down to seu(s) joelho(s). You can also stretch seu(s) middle costas by pulling seu(s) costas away de seu(s) joelho(s) as seu(s) hugging them.

name: Upper Back Alongamento
instructions: Clasp fingers together com seu(s) thumbs pointing down, round seu(s) ombro(s) as you reach seu(s) hands forward.

name: Upright Remada com Barra
instructions: Grasp a barra com an overhand grip that is slightly less than ombro(s) width. bar should be resting on top of seu(s) thighs com seu(s) arms extended e a slight bend in seu(s) cotovelo(s). seu(s) costas should also be straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now Expire e use sides of seu(s) ombro(s) to lift bar, raising seu(s) cotovelo(s) up e to side. Keep bar close to seu(s) body as you raise it. Continue to lift bar até it nearly touches seu(s) chin. Tip: seu(s) cotovelo(s) should drive motion, e should always be higher than seu(s) forearms. Remember to keep seu(s) torso stationary e pause for a second at top of movement. Lower bar costas down slowly até a posição inicial. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Upright Cabo Remada
instructions: Grasp a straight bar cabo attachment that is attached to a low pulley com a pronated (palms facing seu(s) thighs) grip that is slightly less than ombro(s) width. bar should be resting on top of seu(s) thighs. seu(s) arms should be extended com a slight bend at cotovelo(s) e seu(s) costas should be straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Use seu(s) side ombro(s) to lift cabo bar as you Expire. bar should be close to body as you move it up. Continue to lift it até it nearly touches seu(s) chin. Tip: seu(s) cotovelo(s) should drive motion. As you lift bar, seu(s) cotovelo(s) should always be higher than seu(s) forearms. Also, keep seu(s) torso stationary e pause for a second at top of movement. Lower bar costas down slowly até a posição inicial. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Upright Remada - com Bands
instructions: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. segure a barra/pegadas using a pronated (palms facing seu(s) thighs) grip that is slightly less than ombro(s) width. pegadas should be resting on top of seu(s) thighs. seu(s) arms should be extended com a slight bend at cotovelo(s) e seu(s) costas should be straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Use seu(s) side ombro(s) to lift pegadas as you Expire. pegadas should be close to body as you move them up. Continue to lift pegadas até they nearly touches seu(s) chin. Tip: seu(s) cotovelo(s) should drive motion. As you lift pegadas, seu(s) cotovelo(s) should always be higher than seu(s) forearms. Also, keep seu(s) torso stationary e pause for a second at top of movement. Lower pegadas costas down slowly até a posição inicial. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Upward Alongamento
instructions: Extend both hands straight above seu(s) head, palms touching. Slowly push seu(s) hands up e costas, mantendo seu(s) costas straight.

name: V-bar Puxada
instructions: Sente-se on a pull-down máquina com a V-Bar attached to top pulley. Adjust joelho(s) pad of máquina to fit seu(s) height. These pads will prevent seu(s) body de being raised by resistance attached to bar. Grab V-bar com palmas na direção indicada (a neutral grip). Stick seu(s) peito out e lean yourself costas slightly (around 30-degrees) in order to better engage lats. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Using seu(s) lats, pull bar down as you contraia a musculatura alvo. Continue até seu(s) peito nearly touches V-bar. Expire as you execute this motion. Tip: Keep torso stationary throughout movement. After a second hold on contracted position, slowly bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat for prescribed number of repetições.

name: V-bar Barra Fixa
instructions: Start by placing middle of V-bar in middle of pull-up bar (assuming that pull-up station you are using does not have neutral grip pegadas). V-Bar pegadas will be facing down so that you can hang de pull-up bar through use of pegadas. Once you securely place V-bar, take a hold of bar de each side e hang de it. Stick seu(s) peito out e lean yourself costas slightly in order to better engage lats. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Using seu(s) lats, pull seu(s) torso up enquanto leaning seu(s) head costas slightly so that you do not hit yourself com chin-up bar. Continue até seu(s) peito nearly touches V-bar. Expire as you execute this motion. After a second hold on contracted position, Abaixe lentamente seu(s) body costas até a posição inicial as you breathe in. Repeat for prescribed number of repetições.

name: Vertical Swing
instructions: Allow halter(es) to hang at arms length between seu(s) legs, holding it com both hands. Mantenha as costas retas e seu(s) head up. Swing halter(es) between seu(s) legs, flexing at quadril e bending joelho(s) slightly. Powerfully reverse motion by extending at quadril, joelho(s), e ankles to propel yourself upward, swinging dumbell over seu(s) head. As you land, absorb impact through seu(s) legs e draw halter(es) to seu(s) torso before next repetições.

name: Walking, Esteira
instructions: To begin, step onto treadmill e select desired option de menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter seu(s) age e weight to estimate amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change intensity of workout. Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, e usually have less impact than walking outside. When walking, you should move at a moderate to fast pace, not a leisurely one. Being an activity of lower intensity, walking doesn't burn as many calories as some other activities, but still provides great benefit. A 150 lb person will burn about 175 calories walking 4 miles per hour for 30 minutes, compared to 450 calories running twice as fast. Maintain proper posture as you walk, e only hold onto pegadas when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking seu(s) heart rate.

name: Com Peso Ball Hyperextension
instructions: To begin, lie down on an exercise ball com seu(s) torso pressing against ball e parallel to floor. ball of seu(s) feet should be pressed against floor to help keep you balanced. Place a weighted plate under seu(s) chin or behind seu(s) neck. This is posição inicial. Slowly raise seu(s) torso up by bending at waist e lower costas. Remember to Expire during this movement. Hold contraction on seu(s) lower costas for a second e lower seu(s) torso costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições prescribed in seu(s) program.

name: Com Peso Ball Side Bend
instructions: To begin, lie down on an exercise ball com seu(s) left side of torso (waist, quadril e ombro(s)) pressed against ball. seu(s) feet should be on floor enquanto seu(s) legs are crossed e hanging de ball. Place seu(s) left arm across seu(s) torso so that seu(s) palm is on seu(s) obliques. There should be a right angle between seu(s) left forearm e upper arm. This is posição inicial. Raise side of seu(s) torso up by laterally flexing at waist enquanto exhaling. Hold contraction for a second e Abaixe lentamente yourself costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições. Switch sides e repeat exercise.

name: Com Peso Bench Paralelas
instructions: For this exercise you will need to place a banco behind seu(s) costas e another one in front of you. com benches perpendicular to seu(s) body, hold on to one banco on its edge com hands close to seu(s) body, separated at ombro(s) width. seu(s) arms should be fully extended. legs will be extended forward on top of other banco. seu(s) legs should be parallel to floor enquanto seu(s) torso is to be perpendicular to floor. Have seu(s) partner place halter(es) on seu(s) lap. Note: This exercise is best performed com a partner as placing weight on seu(s) lap can be challenging e cause injury without assistance. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Abaixe lentamente seu(s) body as you Inspire by bending at cotovelo(s) até you lower yourself far enough to where there is an angle slightly smaller than 90 degrees between upper arm e forearm. Tip: Keep cotovelo(s) as close as possible throughout movement. Forearms should always be pointing down. Using seu(s) triceps to bring seu(s) torso up again, lift yourself costas até a posição inicial enquanto exhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Com Peso Abdominal Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on seu(s) costas com seu(s) pés firmes no chão or resting on a banco com seu(s) joelho(s) bent at a 90 degree angle. Hold a weight to seu(s) peito, or you may hold it extended above seu(s) torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now, Expire e slowly begin to roll seu(s) ombro(s) off floor. seu(s) ombro(s) should come up off floor about 4 inches enquanto seu(s) lower costas remains on floor. At top of movement, flex seu(s) abdominals e hold for a brief pause. então Inspire e Abaixe lentamente yourself costas down até a posição inicial.

name: Com Peso Jump Agachamento
instructions: Position a lightly loaded barra across costas of seu(s) ombro(s). You could also use a weighted vest, sandbag, or other type of resistance for this exercise. weight should be light enough that it doesn't slow you down significantly. seu(s) feet should be just outside of ombro(s) width com seu(s) head e peito up. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Maintain good posture throughout jump. As you return to ground, absorb impact through seu(s) legs.

name: Com Peso Pull Ups
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt e secure it around seu(s) waist. Grab pull-up bar com palms of seu(s) hands facing forward. For a medium grip, seu(s) hands should be spaced at ombro(s) width. Both arms should be extended in front of you holding bar at chosen grip. You'll want to bring seu(s) torso costas about 30 degrees enquanto creating a curvature in seu(s) lower costas e sticking seu(s) peito out. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Now, Expire e pull seu(s) torso up até seu(s) head is above seu(s) hands. Concentrate on squeezing yourshoulder blades costas e down as you reach top contracted position. After a brief moment at top contracted position, Inspire e Abaixe lentamente seu(s) torso costas até a posição inicial com seu(s) arms extended e seu(s) lats fully stretched.

name: Com Peso Sissy Agachamento
instructions: Standing upright, com feet at ombro(s) width e toes raised, use one hand to hold onto beams of a squat rack e opposite arm to hold a plate on top of seu(s) peito. This is seu(s) posição inicial. As you use one arm to hold yourself, bend at joelho(s) e Abaixe lentamente seu(s) torso toward ground by bringing seu(s) pelvis e joelho(s) forward. After seu(s) one second hold, use seu(s) thigh muscles to bring seu(s) torso costas up até a posição inicial. Expire as you move up. Repeat for recommended amount of times.

name: Com Peso Abdominals - com Bands
instructions: Start out by strapping bands around base of decline banco. Place pegadas towards inside of decline banco so that when lying down, you can reach for both of them. Position seu(s) legs through decline máquina até they are secured. Now reach for exercise bands com both hands. Use a pronated (palms forward) grip to segure a barra/pegadas. Position them near seu(s) collar bone e rotate seu(s) wrist to a neutral grip (palms facing torso). Note: seu(s) arms should remain stationary throughout exercise. This is posição inicial. Move seu(s) torso upward até seu(s) upper body is perpendicular to floor enquanto exhaling. Hold contraction for a second e lower seu(s) upper body costas down até a posição inicial enquanto inhaling. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Com Peso Agachamento
instructions: Start by positioning two flat benches ombro(s) width apart de each other. Stand on top of them e wrap weighted belt around seu(s) waist com amount of weight you feel comfortable com. Make sure seu(s) toes are facing out. Once you are standing straight up com weight hanging in between seu(s) legs, position seu(s) arms so that they are fully extended to side of seu(s) body. This is posição inicial. Begin by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up.
