Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that are perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to move body costas up by pushing floor of flat banco com ball of seu(s) foot mainly as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Expire as you perform this portion of exercise. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Aberta Supino Reto com Barra
instructions: Lie costas on a flat banco com feet firm on floor. Using a wide, pronated (palms forward) grip that is around 3 inches away de ombro(s) width (for each hand), lift bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked. bar will be perpendicular to torso e floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, come down slowly até you feel bar on seu(s) middle peito. After a second pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out e push bar using seu(s) peito muscles. Lock seu(s) arms e squeeze seu(s) peito in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Aberta Declinado Supino Reto com Barra
instructions: Lie costas on a decline banco com feet securely locked at front of banco. Using a wide, pronated (palms forward) grip that is around 3 inches away de ombro(s) width (for each hand), lift bar de rack e hold it straight over you com seu(s) arms locked. bar will be perpendicular to torso e floor. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, come down slowly até you feel bar on seu(s) lower peito. After a second pause, bring bar costas até a posição inicial as you breathe out e push bar using seu(s) peito muscles. Lock seu(s) arms e squeeze seu(s) peito in contracted position, hold for a second e então start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Aberta Declinado Barra Pullover
instructions: Lie down on a decline banco com both legs securely locked in position. Reach for barra behind head using a pronated grip (palms facing out). Make sure to grab barra wider than ombro(s) width apart for this exercise. Slowly lift barra up de floor by using seu(s) arms. When positioned properly, seu(s) arms should be fully extended e perpendicular to floor. This is posição inicial. Begin by moving barra costas down in a semicircular motion as if you were going to place it on floor, but instead, stop when arms are parallel to floor. Tip: Keep arms fully extended at all times. movement should only happen at ombro(s) joint. Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Now bring barra up enquanto exhaling até you are costas at posição inicial. Remember to keep full control of barra at all times. Repeat movement for prescribed amount of repetições of seu(s) training program. When finished com seu(s) set, slowly Abaixe a carga costas down até it is level com seu(s) head e release it.

name: Pegada Aberta Puxada Alta
instructions: Sente-se on a pull-down máquina com a wide bar attached to top pulley. Make sure that you adjust joelho(s) pad of máquina to fit seu(s) height. These pads will prevent seu(s) body de being raised by resistance attached to bar. Grab bar com palmas na direção indicada using prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, seu(s) hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than ombro(s) width. For a medium grip, seu(s) hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to seu(s) ombro(s) width e for a close grip at a distance smaller than seu(s) ombro(s) width. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding bar at chosen grip width, bring seu(s) torso costas around 30 degrees or so enquanto creating a curvature on seu(s) lower costas e sticking seu(s) peito out. This is seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, bring bar down até it touches seu(s) upper peito by drawing ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. upper torso should remain stationary e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work except for holding bar; therefore do not try to pull down bar using forearms. After a second at contracted position squeezing seu(s) ombro(s) blades together, slowly raise bar costas até a posição inicial when seu(s) arms are fully extended e lats are fully stretched. Inspire during this portion of movement. Repeat this motion for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Aberta Puxada Behind Neck
instructions: Sente-se on a pull-down máquina com a wide bar attached to top pulley. Make sure that you adjust joelho(s) pad of máquina to fit seu(s) height. These pads will prevent seu(s) body de being raised by resistance attached to bar. Grab bar com palmas na direção indicada using prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, seu(s) hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than seu(s) ombro(s) width. For a medium grip, seu(s) hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to seu(s) ombro(s) width e for a close grip at a distance smaller than seu(s) ombro(s) width. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding bar at chosen grip width, bring seu(s) torso e head forward. Think of an imaginary line de center of bar down to costas of seu(s) neck. This is seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe out, bring bar down até it touches costas of seu(s) neck by drawing ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. upper torso should remain stationary e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work except for holding bar; therefore do not try to pull down bar using forearms. After a second on contracted position squeezing seu(s) ombro(s) blades together, slowly raise bar costas até a posição inicial when seu(s) arms are fully extended e lats are fully stretched. Inspire during this portion of movement. Repeat this motion for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Aberta Rear Barra Fixa
instructions: Grab pull-up bar com palmas na direção indicada using a wide grip. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding bar, bring seu(s) torso forward e head so that there is an imaginary line de pull-up bar to costas of seu(s) neck. This is seu(s) posição inicial. Pull seu(s) torso up até bar is near costas of seu(s) neck. To do this, draw ombro(s) e upper arms down e costas enquanto slightly leaning seu(s) head forward. Expire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing costas muscles once you reach full contracted position. upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space e only arms should move. forearms should do no other work other than hold bar. After a second on contracted position, start to Inspire e Abaixe lentamente seu(s) torso costas até a posição inicial when seu(s) arms are fully extended e lats are fully stretched. Repeat this motion for prescribed amount of repetições.

name: Pegada Aberta em Pé Rosca Direta com Barra
instructions: Stand up com seu(s) torso upright enquanto holding a barra at wide outer pegadas. palm of seu(s) hands should be facing forward. cotovelo(s) should be close to torso. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto holding upper arms stationary, curl weights forward enquanto contracting biceps as you breathe out. Tip: Only forearms should move. Continue movement até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e bar is at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a second e squeeze biceps hard. Slowly begin to bring bar costas to posição inicial as seu(s) breathe in. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Wide Stance Barra Agachamento
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set bar on a rack that best matches seu(s) height. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, step under bar e place costas of seu(s) ombro(s) (slightly below neck) across it. Hold on to bar using both arms at each side e lift it off rack by first pushing com seu(s) legs e at same time straightening seu(s) torso. Step away de rack e position seu(s) legs using a wider-than-ombro(s)-width stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance, e also maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin to Abaixe lentamente bar by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até angle between upper leg e calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is point in which upper legs are below parallel to floor). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor com heel of seu(s) foot as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Wide Stance Stiff Legs
instructions: Begin com a barra loaded on floor. Adopt a wide stance, e então bend at quadril to grab bar. seu(s) quadril should be as far costas as possible, e seu(s) legs nearly straight. Mantenha as costas retas, e seu(s) head e peito up. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin movement be engaging quadril, driving them forward as you allow arms to hang straight. Continue até you are standing straight up, e então Retorne lentamente weight até a posição inicial. For successive repetições, weight need not touch floor.

name: Wind Sprints
instructions: Hang de a pull-up bar using a pronated grip. seu(s) arms e legs should be extended. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Begin by quickly raising one joelho(s) as high as you can. Do not swing seu(s) body or seu(s) legs. 3 Immediately reverse motion, returning that leg até a posição inicial. Simultaneously raise opposite joelho(s) as high as possible. Continue alternating between legs até set is complete.

name: Windmills
instructions: Deite-se de costas com seu(s) arms extended out to sides e seu(s) legs straight. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Lift one leg e quickly cross it over seu(s) body, attempting to touch ground near opposite hand. Retorne à posição inicial, e repeat com opposite leg. Continue to alternate for 10-20 repetições.

name: World's Greatest Alongamento
instructions: This is a three-part stretch. Begin by lunging forward, com seu(s) front foot flat on ground e on toes of seu(s) costas foot. com seu(s) joelho(s) bent, squat down até seu(s) joelho(s) is almost touching ground. Keep seu(s) torso erect, e hold this position for 10-20 seconds. Now, place arm on same side as seu(s) front leg on ground, com cotovelo(s) next to foot. seu(s) other hand should be placed on ground, parallel to seu(s) lead leg, to help support you during this portion of stretch. After 10-20 seconds, place seu(s) hands on either side of seu(s) front foot. Raise toes of front foot off of ground, e straighten seu(s) leg. You may need to reposition seu(s) rear leg to do so. Hold for 10-20 seconds, e então repeat entire sequence for other side.

name: Wrist Circles
instructions: Start by standing straight com seu(s) feet being ombro(s) width apart de each other. Elevate seu(s) arms to side of you até they are fully extended e parallel to floor at a height that is evenly aligned com seu(s) ombro(s). Tip: seu(s) torso e arms should form letter "T: seu(s) palms should be facing down. This is posição inicial. mantendo seu(s) entire body stationary except for wrists, begin to rotate both wrists forward in a circular motion. Tip: Pretend that you are trying to draw circles by using seu(s) hands as brush. Breathe normally as you perform this exercise. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Wrist Roller
instructions: To begin, Fique em pé ereto up grabbing a wrist roller using a pronated grip (palmas na direção indicada). seu(s) feet should be ombro(s) width apart. Slowly lift both arms até they are fully extended e parallel to floor in front of you. Note: Make sure rope is not wrapped around roller. seu(s) entire body should be stationary except for forearms. This is posição inicial. Rotate one wrist at a time in an upward motion to bring weight up to bar by rolling rope around roller. Once weight has reached bar, slowly begin to Abaixe a carga costas down by rotating wrist in a downward motion até weight reaches posição inicial. Repeat for prescribed amount of repetições in seu(s) program.

name: Wrist Rotations com Straight Bar
instructions: Hold a barra com both hands e seu(s) palmas na direção indicada; hands spaced about ombro(s) width. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. Alternating between each of seu(s) hands, perform movement by extending wrist as though you were rolling up a newspaper. Continue alternating costas e forth até failure. Reverse motion by flexing wrist, rolling opposite direction. Continue alternating motion até failure.

name: Yoke Walk
instructions: Yoke is usually done com a yoke apparatus, but is sometimes seen com refrigerators or other heavy objects. Begin by racking apparatus across costas of ombro(s). com seu(s) head looking forward e costas arched, lift yoke by driving through heels. Begin walking as quickly as possible using short, quick steps. You may hold side posts of yoke to help steady it e hold it in position. Continue for given distance as fast as possible, usually 75-100 feet.

name: Zercher Squats
instructions: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set bar on a rack that best matches seu(s) height. correct height should be anywhere above waist but below peito. Once correct height is chosen e bar is loaded, lock seu(s) hands together e place bar on top of seu(s) arms in between forearm e upper arm. Lift bar up so that it is resting on top of seu(s) forearms. If you are holding bar properly, it should look as if you have seu(s) arms crossed but com a bar running across them. Step away de rack e position seu(s) legs using a ombro(s) width medium stance com toes slightly pointed out. Keep seu(s) head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance e also maintain a straight costas. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. (Note: For purposes of this discussion we will use medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of three stances discussed in foot stances section). Begin to lower bar by bending joelho(s) as you maintain a straight posture com head up. Continue down até angle between upper leg e calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is point in which upper legs are below parallel to floor). Inspire as you perform this portion of movement. Tip: If you performed exercise correctly, front of joelho(s) should make an imaginary straight line com toes that is perpendicular to front. If seu(s) joelho(s) are past that imaginary line (if they are past seu(s) toes) então you are placing undue stress on joelho(s) e exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise bar as you Expire by pushing floor com ball of seu(s) foot mainly as you straighten legs again e go costas até a posição inicial. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Zottman Rosca
instructions: Stand up com seu(s) torso upright e a halter(es) in each hand being held at arms length. cotovelo(s) should be close to torso. Make sure palms of hands are facing each other. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. enquanto holding upper arm stationary, curl weights enquanto contracting biceps as you breathe out. Only forearms should move. seu(s) wrist should rotate so that you have a supinated (palms up) grip. Continue movement até seu(s) biceps are fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) level. Hold contracted position for a second as you squeeze biceps. Now during contracted position, rotate seu(s) wrist até you now have a pronated (palmas na direção indicada) grip com thumb at a higher position than pinky. Slowly begin to bring halter(es) costas down using pronated grip. As halter(es) close seu(s) thighs, start rotating wrist so that you go costas to a neutral (palmas na direção indicada) grip. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.

name: Zottman Rosca Scott
instructions: Grab a halter(es) in each hand e place seu(s) upper arms on top of preacher banco or incline banco. halter(es) should be held at ombro(s) height e cotovelo(s) should be flexed. Hold halter(es) com palms of seu(s) hands facing down. This will be seu(s) posição inicial. As you breathe in, slowly Abaixe a carga mantendo palms down até seu(s) upper arm is extended e seu(s) biceps are fully stretched. Now rotate seu(s) wrists once you are at bottom of movement so that palms of hands are facing up. As you Expire, use seu(s) biceps to curl weights up até they are fully contracted e halter(es) are at ombro(s) height. Again, remember that to ensure full contraction you need to bring that small finger higher than thumb. Squeeze biceps hard for a second at contracted position e rotate seu(s) wrists so that palms are facing down again. Repeat for recommended amount of repetições.
